chapters.title: Chapter 1: Welcome to Sky Island Paradise
paragraphs: "Hey guys, let’s get off work early today and play some rounds of Chenghai 3C tonight?"
"Sure, I haven’t played in a while, let’s call Han Xing to join us."
In an office building in Xinyang City, two men were talking.
Han Xing heard someone calling his name, but he didn’t respond immediately and kept his head down.
He was playing a pixel-style survival adventure game on his phone called "Sky Island Paradise", featuring fresh graphics and cheerful music.
Players start on a floating block and explore other floating blocks to search for resources and expand their territory.
But as Han Xing played, he realized the game was more than it seemed on the surface.
Players will inadvertently trigger various side quests while exploring. These quests have different options, and every choice seems to determine the story’s direction.
When the side quests are linked together, they seem to form a massive main storyline.
Besides the rich side content, the dialogue between characters in the game is also very deep.
When talking with the protagonist, the emotional authenticity unintentionally revealed by these characters made Han Xing feel like he was communicating with a real person.
As he followed the quests, pieces of forgotten history were uncovered...
All this made Han Xing wonder if this was really a pixel-style game under 100M.
Han Xing became immersed in it.
At that moment, a message appeared on the phone screen.
[This game will undergo maintenance in ten minutes. The new version will be available soon, please look forward to it...]
Maintenance? Hasn’t this game just started its closed beta a few days ago?
Han Xing was puzzled, when he saw a brawny man appear beside him.
Cheng Jianyong patted Han Xing on the shoulder and, squinting, said with a smile, "Whose video are you watching? You didn’t even hear us talking to you."
Han Xing put away his phone, saying, "I heard you."
"I was just surprised that our department’s performance has not met the target this month, and Chen Ergou is watching us every day in the office, yet you dare not work overtime?"
Cheng Jianyong chuckled heartily, "Overtime? Like hell!"
"With such a low salary, they still want me to work my ass off every day? Even if a god came down today, I’m leaving work early!"
Cheng Jianyong spoke with determination, but Han Xing looked at him skeptically.
A man in a suit next to them laughed, "Han Xing, don’t listen to this guy’s bragging."
"This guy stepped into the grave of marriage right after graduation, unlike us, who only have to worry about feeding ourselves. If he doesn’t work overtime, who will support his wife and kids?"
The man who spoke was called Shen Yun, and along with Han Xing and Cheng Jianyong, they had all graduated from the same university.
During the four years of college, they were assigned to the same dormitory, shared similar interests, and after graduation, they joined the same company. They were Han Xing’s only friends.
Cheng Jianyong, feeling a bit embarrassed at Shen Yun’s remark, muttered softly, "Just one day, it’s no big deal..."
Seeing him like this, Han Xing and Shen Yun exchanged a knowing smile.
"Speaking of which, we haven’t played games together in a long time," Han Xing said.
Shen Yun’s face also showed a reminiscent expression, "Yeah, I really miss those college days..."
Just then, a shadow appeared behind the three of them.
"If you miss those school days so much, why don’t you go back to school?"
Hearing this voice, the three of them had an ominous feeling.
It was the department manager, Chen Huai Bo.
In private, Han Xing and the others called him Chen Ergou, as he was a loyal lapdog of the boss.
Chen Huai Bo looked at them with a black face, questioning, "What are you three discussing? You haven’t completed your performance, and all you’re thinking about is playing games?"
"A bunch of good-for-nothings, complaining about a few extra days of work like you’re pampered princesses!"
"Tell me, do you want to quit? If you do, get lost early! Don’t occupy this spot without doing anything."
"Right now, there are plenty of recent graduates out there without jobs. If you don’t want it, there are plenty of others who do! You uncouth bunch!"
Shen Yun stepped forward and said coldly, "Watch your mouth."
His voice wasn’t loud, but it carried an undeniable firmness.
The office suddenly fell silent, and a few other employees cautiously peered out, seemingly unable to believe anyone would dare confront Chen Huai Bo.
"What did you say?" Chen Huai Bo’s face turned ugly, "Do you believe I can call the boss right now and have you pack up and leave immediately!"
Shen Yun just wanted to speak, but Han Xing waved his hand to stop him.
Han Xing looked at Chen Huai Bo, "Stop barking, you just want to kick us out so you can bring in your relatives, right?"
"Chen Huai Bo, do you think we don’t know about your little schemes?" Han Xing scoffed.
"What you, you can go ahead and report us to the boss. Let’s see if he will fire us."
Han Xing was confident, knowing that even if the department’s performance was lacking, the three of them were still the top contributors.
Chen Huai Bo was furious, shaking with anger, seemingly not expecting Han Xing, who was usually low-key, to stand up to him like this.
He just wanted to reach out and grab Han Xing’s collar, but saw Cheng Jianyong suddenly standing in front.
"Chen Ergou, are you planning to lay hands here?" Cheng Jianyong squinted, his tone carrying a threatening undertone, and his tall and sturdy presence was quite intimidating.
Chen Huai Bo retracted his outstretched hand, looking at the three united front with a face as dark as a stormy sky.
Han Xing pulled Cheng Jianyong back, about to advise him not to fight here, when everything suddenly went black.
At that moment, everyone heard a system notification.
"The new version update of the game is complete. In three minutes, all humans on Blue Star will enter this game."
"Game notice: This is a world without land, where countless islands float in the sky, each hiding opportunities and dangers, but first, everyone needs to figure out how to survive."
"Later, a piece of floating land will be generated for each player, which is your core territory and the foundation for future Sky Island construction. If it’s destroyed, you will lose everything."
"You can control your territory to move in the air, approach those cloud-covered islands, explore them to obtain survival materials, and you can also occupy these islands to expand your territory."
"Islands contain opportunities, but they might also harbor terrible dangers. Each of you has only one chance to survive. The consequence of failure is death, so choose cautiously..."
"Elderly and children, as vulnerable groups, will be placed with their respective relatives a month after the game starts..."
"Now, welcome to ’Sky Island Paradise’."
When Han Xing’s vision returned, he discovered he was floating at an unknown altitude, looking down into a vast emptiness with no land in sight.
High in the sky, a gentle breeze blew, and clouds floated by.
Immense fear filled his heart.
At this moment, a personal panel appeared before Han Xing.
[Name: Han Xing]
[Race: Human Race]
[Profession: None]
[Level: LV0]
[Power: 3, Agility: 2, Spirit: 4, Physical Strength: 5]
[Skills: None]
[Talent: None]
Then, a system notification came again.
"Please choose your career path swiftly."
"Currently, there are five major paths: Warrior, Mage, Holy Profession, Hunter, Stalker. Once players reach a certain level, they can advance their profession through Professional Scrolls."
Han Xing was momentarily stunned, his fear gradually turning into joy.
You can actually choose a profession!
Not only that, these five major profession paths are exactly like the game he played on his phone!
Although he didn’t play that mobile game for long, compared to others, Han Xing had a deeper understanding of these professions.

From the names of these five professions, it’s clear what they excel at. Warriors focus on melee combat, and at a certain level, they can change into Swordsmen or Berserkers, with advanced paths to Sword Master and Mad War God...
Mages control elements with magic to deal damage to enemies, later transitioning into Elemental Masters and Illusionists, with advanced paths to Elemental Tutor and Weaver...
The other three professions are similar, each having two transition paths and advancement routes.
If there’s nothing unexpected, most people can only choose from these ten professions.
"I played as a Hunter before, I should continue choosing Hunter to leverage my advantage."
"Moreover, the crucial thing is, when I was playing that mobile game, I heard from npc dialogues about a hidden profession for Hunter..."
That hidden profession is called Wild Ranger!
If the early game process is still the same as the one on his phone with no changes, Han Xing can get a head start and secure this hidden profession first!
Thinking of this, Han Xing had already made a decision. Just as he was about to choose the Hunter profession, a solemn notification rang in his mind.
[Detected that player ’Han Xing’ has a destiny compatible with this world, personal talent Divine-level Artisan has been activated.]
[Divine-level Artisan (SSS-level, Hidden Unique): You will never fail when crafting any items. The probability of creating high-quality items is greatly increased.]
Han Xing stood frozen for a moment, shocked, murmuring, "What the heck???"

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Territory Fusion
paragraphs: "Successfully chosen profession, ’Hunter’, initial equipment has been issued."
"Personal territory has been generated successfully."
System prompt ends.
In the sky tens of thousands of meters high up, a floating square block of earth with dimensions of 1 meter by 1 meter by 1 meter suddenly appeared.
Han Xing stood on top of it, as if standing on grass, but the high elevation made his legs weak.
A faded wooden bow had somehow appeared in his hands, and a quiver now hung at his waist with 10 wooden arrows inside.
Information about the items appeared before him.
[Wooden Longbow (White): Quality - Rough, Attack Power 6~8, Attached Effect - None.]
[Note: A weapon made from oak and animal sinew, fully drawn it can damage standard 1-Star level creatures.]
[Arrow *10 (White): Quality - Rough, Attack Power 1~2, Attached Effect - None.]
[Note: Arrows made by sharpening sticks.]
Han Xing tightly grasped the longbow in his hands, feeling a bit of confidence now that he had a weapon.
Looking around, he noticed that many clouds of various sizes and colors had appeared in the nearby sky.
Some clouds were as large as a mountain range, while others were only the size of a table, similar to Han Xing’s territory.
He knew the rules of the game: within these clouds lay hidden sky islands from which players must acquire all resources, including food and drinking water, in the early stages.
He needed to explore other sky islands for resources as soon as possible, otherwise, he would soon die of thirst or hunger.
Han Xing started to move the block beneath his feet forward.
After about ten minutes, Han Xing’s lips had become somewhat dry.

Though the clouds seemed close, the actual distance was far, and with the speed of this basic block, the fastest he could go was about 10 kilometers per hour, which translates to less than 3 meters per second in movement speed.
While the sky island’s speed would increase with level advancement, right now it was still very slow.

Another ten minutes passed before Han Xing managed to guide his territory close to a cloud that appeared small, with electricity sparking around it. The system prompt sounded: "Inside is a cluster of active Thunder Elemental Power. Enter?"
Thunder Elemental Power? Are there monsters inside?
After a moment’s consideration, Han Xing decided to pass up the opportunity.
After all, this was not a mobile game where you could revive after dying. The system had clearly warned them each person had only one life.
Han Xing directed his block to change course, continuing to drift forward.
As he drifted toward a gray cloud, the system prompt sounded again: "It seems there’s a cluster of evil power hidden inside. Enter?"
Danger! Abstain!
Once again, Han Xing altered his direction, continuing to drift for another twenty minutes.
It had been an hour since he entered the game, and floating through the sky island not only consumed physical strength, but it also drained a significant amount of spiritual power.
Suddenly, Han Xing felt dizzy, and his throat started to dry.
Glancing at his personal info, he noticed the state column had changed.
[State: Thirsty, Spirit Exhausted.]
[Note: You need to rest quickly. Driving while exhausted is not good.]
"Rest? In a place this high, how do you expect me to rest!"
Han Xing gritted his teeth and cursed.
Furthermore, even if he could overcome his fear of heights, the initial territory space of 1 meter by 1 meter left no room to stretch, and a small misstep could send him falling off.
It’s not only Han Xing who’s in such a predicament; others are facing even worse situations.
In less than an hour in this world, at least hundreds of thousands had fallen from the sky, losing their lives.
"This won’t do, I have to explore the sky islands, expand my territory quickly!"
Han Xing shook his head, lifted his spirits, and continued scanning the surrounding clouds.
Just then, he spotted a cloud drifting in from behind, similar in size to his territory, with a faint green hue shimmering across it.
A few minutes later, Han Xing finally neared this cloud, and the system prompt came: "Inside is a faint cluster of Life Force. Enter?"
Hmm? There’s hope!
Feeling a surge of joy, Han Xing entered without hesitation.
The cloud dissipated, revealing square soil wrapped in green grass before him.
In the center of the soil grew a tree less than a meter high, yet its trunk was as thick as a grown man’s thigh. Its lush canopy was adorned with numerous red fruits.
[Juicy Fruit Tree: Shrub-type plant. The berries on the tree can be eaten directly and restore hydration and satiety.]
Han Xing felt as if he was seeing his parents reborn, tears of excitement almost falling.
He rushed to the berry tree and began stuffing the red berries into his mouth.
The fresh red juice burst in his mouth, with a slightly sweet and sour taste, just like a refreshing rain.
After a few berries, the hunger and thirst he felt began to dissipate.
Han Xing counted; there were still over twenty red berries on the tree, each the size of a strawberry. Eating sparingly, he could last at least two days!
Just then, the system prompt appeared.
[Would you like to merge this plot of land into your territory?]
Han Xing clicked yes immediately.
[Merge successful, your territory size has expanded.]
System prompt ends.
Han Xing found that his 1 meter by 1 meter by 1 meter square block had now transformed into a 2 meter by 1 meter by 1 meter rectangle block, with one of the segments hosting a berry tree.
Now that he resolved his hunger and thirst, his spiritual state remained exhausted.
Han Xing leaned against the berry tree canopy and slowly lay down.
Half an hour later, Han Xing woke up.
He had rolled unknowingly to the territory’s edge in his sleep, with one arm dangling in mid-air, nearly about to fall!
"Gasp!!!"
Han Xing took a deep breath suddenly, cleared up instantly, and felt a surge of fear.
"Damn it, how can anyone sleep peacefully like this? How does anyone who moves in their sleep survive?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but complain inwardly, while regaining a sense of crisis.
People can’t avoid sleeping, and no one can guarantee that they won’t unconsciously move in their sleep.
The initial territory was too small, even a slight move could lead to a fatal fall from high up.
Thus, their current priority is exploring these clouds to expand territory safely.
With this thought, Han Xing once again scanned the surrounding clouds.
Earlier, he explored the nearby clouds and found most contained danger, typically monsters.
Han Xing knew that for survival, he would eventually face these monsters, so it’s better to take initiative while his state is still relatively good.
"However, now I can leverage my advantage to increase my combat power!"

paragraphs: Han Xing had played this game before, although not for long, but he knew what his advantage was.
It was the SSS-level talent he activated upon entering the game, the Divine-level Artisan!
This talent allows him to never fail when crafting quest items, and there’s a high probability of producing higher-quality items.
In this game, as long as you have blueprints, you can craft your own profession’s equipment.
In other words, Han Xing could now craft equipment of higher quality than what the system provided!
When Han Xing chose the Hunter profession, two equipment blueprints were automatically recorded: [Wooden Longbow] and [Wooden Arrow].
"The Wooden Longbow requires logs and beast tendons as materials, which I don’t have now."
"However, the method to make Wooden Arrows is relatively simple, requiring only some branches."
Thinking of this, Han Xing looked at the Juicy Fruit Tree behind him.
Han Xing broke off a dozen branches from the Juicy Fruit Tree.
[Obtained Branch*17.]
After the system prompt ended, Han Xing took a deep breath and then clicked on "Craft All."
Progress bars appeared one after another, crafting an arrow nearly every second.
White light flashed continuously, and arrows appeared in front of him one by one.
[Sharpened Arrow (White)*17: Quality - Refined, Attack Power: 2~3, Attached Effect - Sharp.]
[Sharp: When attacking, there is a higher probability of penetrating the target’s body, causing severe injury status to the enemy.]
Although still whiteboard equipment, the attack power had an obvious improvement, and most importantly, a special effect appeared!
It’s known that even for green equipment, the probability of a special effect appearing is extremely low.
Now, a few branches casually picked from the tree have become rare special effect equipment, thanks to the ’Divine-level Artisan’ talent!
No wonder it’s an SSS-level talent, truly terrifying!
Han Xing picked up a Wooden Arrow, its tip was polished to a very smooth finish, almost as if it had been polished.
A quiver can hold up to thirty arrows; if spatial items can be obtained in the future, he can carry more things with him.
After placing all seventeen newly crafted arrows into the quiver, the weight on his waist gave him more confidence.
He set his sights on a cloud not far away, glowing with a faint green light, and as he advanced for more than ten minutes, the sky gradually darkened.
Han Xing looked up at the sky and said strangely, "Does it also have day and night here?"
Shaking his head, he temporarily decided not to think about it and focused all his energy on the cloud in front of him.
When he was less than a meter away from the cloud, a system prompt appeared: "There seems to be a mass of invisible elemental power active inside. Enter?"
Han Xing took a deep breath and drew a ’Sharpened Arrow’ from the quiver, nocked it, and drew the bowstring!
With the bowstring fully drawn, Han Xing was ready to attack.
He clicked enter.
As the cloud dispersed, a transparent, ball-shaped Slime bounced up and down in front of him.
[Slime (One-Star Creature)]
[Level: 1]
[Power: 6, Agility: 3, Spirit: 4, Constitution: 5]
[Skills: Spit.]
Whoosh!
As soon as he saw the Slime, Han Xing immediately shot the arrow in his hand.
The Wooden Arrow flew with a tearing sound and pierced into the jelly-like body of the Slime.
Suddenly attacked, the Slime, as if frightened, jumped several meters high.
Han Xing did not hesitate, the second arrow quickly followed, hitting the target precisely.
Having taken two arrows, the Slime finally reacted.
It seemed extremely angry, opening its mouth, and a mass of invisible elemental power began brewing inside.
However, before it could attack.
The third arrow was already on its way.
Thud!
This arrow seemed to trigger a special effect, as the Sharpened Wooden Arrow, upon hitting the Slime, continued drilling into its body without losing momentum.
It was the Razor-sharp special effect of the ’Sharpened Wooden Arrow’!
The attack the Slime was brewing stopped mid-air, and its body started trembling uncontrollably.
With a squelching sound, the Slime’s body suddenly burst, and transparent slime scattered like fireworks.
Han Xing instinctively stepped back a couple of steps, still shaking off a mass of glue-like sticky liquid from his hand, with some even splattering onto his face.
"Yuck! What the hell is this, freaking disgusting!"
Just as the words left his mouth, a system prompt appeared in front of him.
[Successfully killed Slime lv1, your level has increased.]
[Current Level lv1.]
Before Han Xing could react, the system’s cold announcement sounded in his ear.
"Announcement: The first player to kill a Sky Island monster in this area has appeared, and the regional channel is now open."
"Based on regions, every ten thousand players are divided into the same area, current players can communicate, trade, and gain more survival opportunities in the regional channel."
Opening the panel, Han Xing found himself assigned to the 107 regional channel.
However, just as Han Xing was about to enter the regional channel, the system’s voice sounded again.
"As you are the first player to kill a Sky Island monster in this area, you have received a first-kill reward: Spirit Core*50, Space Backpack (White)*1, Space Backpack Blueprint (White)*1."
[Space Backpack (White): Quality - Common, Storage Space +20, Attached Effect - None.]
"Whoa, it’s a spatial item!" Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim.
With twenty storage spaces, Han Xing tried it out, and putting thirty arrows inside only filled one storage unit.
This means, if completely filled with arrows, he could carry six hundred arrows with him!
And that’s not the main point; the crucial part is that he also has the Space Backpack blueprint.
[Space Backpack Blueprint (White)]
[Crafting Requirements: One-star Beast Hide*1, Spirit Core*10, Ether*20]
[Crafting Success Rate 20% (Increased to 100% due to Divine-level Artisan talent)]
"Indeed, the success rate is still 100%!"
"Doesn’t this mean I can mass-produce Space Backpacks and then trade with other players?"
Space Backpacks are very valuable. Even with all his time playing on his phone, Han Xing had never encountered two.
If these appear in the trading channel, they will definitely cause a frenzy among players!
However, he also knows it’s not the right time yet.
In the early stages of the game, the most scarce resources are still food and water.
Even if a Space Backpack appears, they can’t afford it.
Han Xing entered the 107 regional channel, and a system prompt appeared.
[Would you like to use the default name ’Han Xing’ to enter the regional channel?]
"No."
Han Xing directly refused, then changed his name in the regional channel’s personal information to "Star River."
The regional channel hadn’t been open for long when the chat section was already flooded with over a thousand messages; this was the 107 channel, messages sent by over ten thousand humans!

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Bargaining and Bartering Supplies
paragraphs: "Is there anyone here? Can someone tell me what’s happening? How did I end up in the sky?"
"Amitabha, oh God! Didn’t they say you’d only go to heaven after death? Am I dead already? I haven’t even paid off my mortgage yet!"
"Shen Mengting, where are you? I’m your husband, Wang Hongrui, please answer if you see this."
"Wait a minute, where’s my husband?"
Too much information, many people lost their minds, crying and shouting blindly. Many were also searching for their families and relatives, hoping for some comfort.
Han Xing filtered through this information, knowing that suddenly coming to such an unfamiliar world is indeed hard to accept.
But if they don’t adapt quickly, what awaits them is the fate of running out of resources and either dying of thirst or hunger.
Of course, among the thousands of survivors in area 107’s channel, there were also some calm people who had already started exploring this unknown world.
Someone started seeking help: "Help! I just touched a cloud, and the system indicated that there was a foul odor inside. Does this mean there is a monster inside?"
"You’re asking us, we don’t know either. Just go in and see for yourself!"
"Okay, I’ll go in and check."
Two seconds later, a terrified cry for help came from the chat channel: "Damn, it’s a Mud Slime!"
"Help! The slime jumped on me, it’s trying to absorb me into its body, I... glug... glug..."
The chat channel fell into a moment of silence, then someone cautiously asked: "That guy, is he going to be suffocated by the Mud Slime?"
No one responded, but the possibility was high.
"Help! I also encountered a monster here!"
"Me too, there are a lot of monsters in the clouds!"
"These monsters are terrifying, how did that guy who got the first kill in the whole game do it?"
Despite these people’s good adaptability, they were still a few steps slower than Han Xing.
When he had already completed the server’s first kill, most people had just touched their first cloud.
Of course, not everyone had bad luck; some clouds didn’t have any danger at all.
"Hahaha, a bunch of unlucky folks! I didn’t encounter any monsters and even found food inside. If you want some, bring me water to trade!"
"I didn’t encounter any monsters either, and just opened a wooden box that had a Stalker’s green weapon inside, feeling ecstatic! Don’t ask me how to trade, I only want water and food!"
Han Xing pondered, realizing that the most scarce resources now should be water and food.
He entered the trading channel, where hundreds of trading messages appeared densely.
"20 Stone Blocks, can be thrown as hidden weapons, need food!"
"10 Slime Mucus, magic materials, for 200 milliliters of water!"
"1 One-star Beast Hide, fine leather, can be used to make equipment, for 3 units of water or food!"
"Beast Hide!" Han Xing’s eyes lit up, one of the materials his newly obtained backpack blueprint required was a One-star Beast Hide.
In "Sky Island Paradise," each player can equip two backpacks, and Han Xing can still equip one more now.
Moreover, with his ’Divine-level Artisan’ talent boost, the backpack he makes is likely to be stronger than the system-rewarded backpack just like the Wooden Arrow!
If he’s lucky, it might even have a special effect, greatly enhancing his survival capability!
However, the person selling the beast hide was asking for an exorbitant price, wanting 3 units of water, which is 3000 milliliters.
They had all just arrived in this world, who could readily provide so much water resource?
Han Xing knew this guy was deliberately setting the price so high, a kind of bargaining trick, so he clicked on private chat. The person’s username was ’Emperor Beifeng.’
Star River: "Brother, three juicy fruits for a One-star Beast Hide."
Emperor Beifeng: "Three? Are you treating me like a beggar?"

Star River: "Three is not too little, you can’t craft anything with the beast hide now, it’s better to convert it into usable resources quickly. In this world, ensuring your own survival is the most important thing."
Han Xing started persuading, but the other party was unmoved.
Emperor Beifeng: "No way! It took me tremendous effort, nearly losing my life, to get this One-star Beast Hide. At least ten juicy fruits, or no deal!"

Upon hearing this, Han Xing suddenly chuckled, "Heh, you’re bluffing, right? Beast hides can only be looted from at least a One-star Beast. With your current attributes, there’s no way you could take on a One-star Beast. I bet you got lucky and found it on another Sky Island."
Emperor Beifeng was a bit shocked: "How do you know this well?"
Han Xing laughed lightly, of course, he wouldn’t tell the other party that he had actually played this game before.
Han Xing continued, "So, a One-star Beast Hide isn’t some rare material. By tomorrow, if you want to sell it, it might not even be worth three juicy fruits."
Of course, Han Xing was lying; beast hides, being main materials, are always in demand.
Emperor Beifeng seemed intimidated by Han Xing, cautiously asking: "Re... really?"
He was a bit convinced by Han Xing, "But three juicy fruits are still too few, how about... you add a bit more?"
"Alright, five juicy fruits, no more than that."
"Deal!"
The other party hurriedly agreed.
[The survivor ’Emperor Beifeng’ has initiated a trade request with you.]
Han Xing clicked agree, both parties placed the items in the trade window and confirmed the trade.
In his backpack, five juicy fruits disappeared, and a brand new beast hide appeared on the territory ground.
A trace of delight appeared on Han Xing’s face, "Great, now I have two of the materials needed to make the space backpack, now just missing Ether."
Ether is a material that only drops from some magic monsters.
Han Xing checked the trading channel, finding that those selling this material were also asking for water and food.
On his territory’s juicy fruit tree, there were 19 juicy fruits left. To prevent unexpected situations, he couldn’t trade away any more of them.
However, while the juicy fruits couldn’t be traded, he had another ’big weapon’ in his hand.
[Sharpened Wooden Arrow!]
In a recent battle, Han Xing had already confirmed the power of the wooden arrow.
After three arrows triggered the special effect, it directly took down a level 1 monster Slime.
In the regional channel with tens of thousands of people, certainly many chose the Hunter profession, and they must be able to see the effect of the wooden arrow.
Sure enough, when Han Xing posted the consignment message, it instantly sparked a sensation in the chat channel.
"Damn! Refined quality wooden arrow, and with special effects!"
"Hiss! Its attack power is nearly double that of my wooden arrows, that’s really awesome!"
"Good news for those who chose the Hunter profession, get me some of these arrows, and I’d dare to challenge the monsters in the clouds!"
"Who has Ether materials on hand, go trade! This big shot is trading 10 Ether for one arrow now!"
In less than three minutes, all five wooden arrows Han Xing consigned were traded out, receiving a total of 50 pieces of Ether.
"Great, now I have all the materials needed to make the space backpack!" Han Xing’s lips curved into a smile.
Just as he was about to make the space backpack, two system notifications appeared in front of him.
[The survivor ’Cheng Jianyong’ requests to add you as a friend.]
[The survivor ’Shen Yun’ requests to add you as a friend.]

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Crafting a Backpack
paragraphs: Shen Yun: "Huh? You can really add someone as a friend just by their name!"
Cheng Jianyong: "Brother Xing, I finally found you. I’ve been searching for you so hard!"
Han Xing said with a speechless expression: "If I remember correctly, it’s been less than half a day since we last met, right?"
"Half a day! It feels like it’s been more than half a year, Brother Xing, you have no idea what I’ve been through!"
Cheng Jianyong sounded like a complaining wife, and Han Xing didn’t want to listen to his long-windedness, so he said directly: "Let’s talk in the discussion group."
After adding Han Xing as a friend, the three of them created a common discussion group.
As soon as they entered, Han Xing asked directly: "How are your situations now?"

Shen Yun replied immediately: "I’m okay. Since entering the game, I’ve been approaching those islands covered by clouds. I gave up entering when I sensed danger, and I just found an island without danger and have now expanded my territory."
Han Xing nodded: "I’m at a similar progress."

Cheng Jianyong was a bit surprised after listening: "Damn, you two have already started merging islands? The islands I encountered along the way all had monsters, and the system prompted that I was in a state of hunger and dehydration. Now I’m feeling parched, and my head is almost unclear!"
"You’re too weak." Shen Yun scorned: "When we were in school, you were the worst at playing games. Now that we’re in another world, you’re still like this."
Cheng Jianyong chuckled a bit awkwardly.

Han Xing said: "Jian Yong, remember to carefully differentiate the system’s tips when you approach those clouds. You need to expand your territory quickly, or it’ll be dangerous once your mental state deteriorates."
Han Xing spoke seriously, and Cheng Jianyong straightened up immediately: "Danger, as in falling to death after passing out?"
"Yes."
"Shit! I don’t want to die yet, I have a wife and kids. Brother Xing, Brother Yun, save me!"
Cheng Jianyong’s cries echoed in the discussion group.
Shen Yun scoffed: "Alright, both Brother Xing and Brother Yun are here, do you think we’ll let you die? Look at this."
In the local network, Shen Yun sent an item info.
[Spring Water: 600ml, drinkable directly]
"Holy crap, it’s water!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Quick, let me have a couple of sips, I’m dying of thirst!"
Shen Yun laughed: "You want water? Sure, but what do you have to call me?"
Cheng Jianyong instantly understood, feeling a bit embarrassed: "Brother Yun, this... isn’t it a bit inappropriate? I’m a married man..."
"Will you call me or not? If not, I’ll drink it myself."
"Godfather!"
Cheng Jianyong compromised immediately.
Shen Yun laughed heartily, then traded 200ml of spring water to Cheng Jianyong.
At this moment, Han Xing also received Shen Yun’s trade request.
"Brother Xing, have some water for now."
Han Xing accepted without hesitation. Though water is an incomparably precious resource right now, there’s no need to fuss about it with the bond they share.
Besides, he did need to replenish water; while berries are sweet, they can’t satisfy the body’s need for water.
Once the trade was complete, a small puddle appeared in Han Xing’s territory.
Without a container, he had to drink the spring water on the ground as soon as possible.
Han Xing finished the spring water on the ground in one gulp, feeling instantly clearer in the head.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed: "Damn, I feel alive again. It’d be great if there was something to eat now."
"I have food here, I’ll trade it to you guys."
Han Xing picked ten berries from the juicy fruit tree, giving five each to them.
"Thanks to Brother Xing!"
"Thank you, Brother Xing."
Han Xing smiled, the scene was somewhat familiar, evoking some memories.
It was during their school days, the times the three of them teamed up for gaming.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong felt it too.
Shen Yun remarked: "I never thought there would come a day when all of humanity would cross over to another world."
"Yeah, and even more unexpected is that even in this new world, the three of us can still team up together."
Cheng Jianyong said emotionally: "Ever since graduating, it’s been an endless stream of work and overtime every day, I almost forgot what gaming feels like."
Han Xing chuckled: "Alright, everyone, we should hurry and explore other Sky Islands, gather resources, and strengthen ourselves."
He didn’t tell them that he had played this game before; it didn’t matter if he did or not.
At this point, Han Xing glanced at the function panel.
He opened the blueprint section.
The three materials needed to craft the ’Space Backpack’ were all gathered, now it could be made!
Han Xing was a bit anticipative, wondering what special effects the Space Backpack Blueprint would have with his ’Divine-level Artisan’ talent boost!
He reached out and clicked to craft.
In front of him, a ten-second progress bar appeared.
Then there was a flash of white light, and the system prompt came through.
[Successfully crafted Space Backpack (White) *1]
[Space Backpack (White), Quality - Refined, Storage Space - 30, Effect - Vitality (Constitution +4)]
"Incredible!" Han Xing praised sincerely upon seeing the attributes.
This new backpack, compared to the space backpack given as a first-kill reward, not only has a larger capacity but also a special effect of increased constitution.
And not just by one or two points, it increased by a whole 4 points!

You know, after defeating that Slime and leveling up to 1, his constitution only increased by two points, and this backpack increased it by 4 points, equivalent to leveling up twice, which is terrifyingly impressive!
Han Xing happily equipped the new backpack, and his attribute panel changed.
[Name: Han Xing]
[Race: Human Race]
[Profession: Hunter]
[Level: LV1]
[Power: 4, Agility: 5, Spirit: 4, Physical Strength: 7+4]
[Skills: Basic Bow Mastery.]
[Talent: Divine-level Artisan (SSS)]
[State: Good]
His physical strength value directly broke into double digits!
At this moment, Han Xing felt he had endless strength, even considering performing a chest smash a big stone act on the spot.
Handling creatures like Slime would be much easier now.
He controlled the Sky Island to continue moving forward.
After leveling up to 1, the speed of the Sky Island Territory had increased to 5 meters per second, in the early stages, each level up increased this speed by 2 meters per second.
Even though it’s still a bit slow, it’s enough for now.
Soon, Han Xing reached a gray cloud.
"There seem to be signs of biological activity inside, enter?"
As usual, before confirming entry, Han Xing drew his bowstring fully, which was one of the advantages of the Hunter profession.
The cloud dispersed, revealing two blocks, and a creature with thick gray-brown fur appeared, its slender limbs and exposed fangs indicating it was a wolf.
[Forest Wolf (One-Star Creature)]
[Level: LV1]
[Power: 5, Agility: 7, Spirit: 4, Constitution: 8]
[Skill: Tearing Bite!]
Compared to the Slime he encountered before, this Forest Wolf was obviously much stronger.
Its body over 1.5 meters in length was quite imposing, with sharp eyes full of murderous intent.
As soon as it saw Han Xing, the Forest Wolf lunged swiftly!
But as fast as it was, Han Xing was faster!
Swoosh!
As soon as it pounced in the forest, a sharpened arrow shot out swiftly.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Green Equipment Blueprint
paragraphs: Swoosh!
The arrow shot out, precisely hitting the right eye of the Forest Wolf.
At this moment, Han Xing’s Sky Island was less than three meters away from the Sky Island where the Forest Wolf was, with a gap area in between.
The Forest Wolf let out a tragic howl as its eye suddenly received severe damage. It abruptly halted, nearly falling from high altitude.
In the early stage of the game, the Hunter has very few skills, so it’s crucial not to let the enemy get too close during combat.
Han Xing quickly maneuvered the Sky Island Territory to retreat, increasing the distance.
The system prompt appeared.
"Notice: The alert range of a One-Star Creature is ten meters. Beyond this distance, it will disengage from battle, and the Sky Island will revert to an unexplored state."
The unexplored state is the kind of state where the outside is shrouded by the Cloud Layer. Before entering, any attacks from outside cannot affect the Sky Island inside.
"Ten meters, huh? That’s enough!" Han Xing controlled the territory, quickly retreating.
"Huff..."
Exhaling lightly, an arrow appeared out of thin air in his hand, and Han Xing strung the bow and shot again!
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
Three arrows in succession, two hitting the target, one veering off into the air.
The Forest Wolf constantly howled in pain, but it was stuck in a 2-cubic-sized block, unable to advance or retreat.
In the current situation, it was clear Han Xing had kited the Forest Wolf.
This is also a common tactic used by Hunters.
Han Xing continued to shoot arrows.
Another four arrows were fired. Two hit the target, two missed.
Han Xing was quite satisfied with this hit rate.
Considering he’s currently nine meters away from the Forest Wolf, maintaining such high accuracy while ensuring safety was already commendable.
Choosing the Hunter Profession, the system’s initial skill ’Basic Bow Mastery’ gave him an innate familiarity with the Bow and Arrow.
In the future, as he levels up and his agility increases, his hit rate can improve further.
At this moment, the Forest Wolf was pierced with five arrows, looking quite miserable, yet it still hadn’t fallen.
Monsters on the Sky Island have strong life force. Previously, Han Xing was lucky with the Slime; the third arrow triggered the ’Sharp’ effect.
However, with two more arrows from Han Xing, the Forest Wolf finally whimpered and fell down.
[Successfully killed Forest Wolf lv1, gained 10 Experience Points.]
Seeing the prompt, Han Xing let out a sigh of relief.
He maneuvered the Sky Island to approach the Forest Wolf’s body.
[Do you want to disassemble the Forest Wolf’s body?]
"Yes."
[Successfully disassembled ’Forest Wolf body’, recovered Arrows*7, obtained One-star Beast Hide*1, obtained Wolf Meat 37kg, obtained Beast Bones 102 pieces.]
The Forest Wolf’s body disappeared, leaving behind a Beast Hide, a large pile of red Wolf Meat, and a mountain of white bones on the ground.
"So much Wolf Meat!" Han Xing exclaimed.
kilograms of Wolf Meat is enough to feed an adult for several days. If he eats sparingly, it could last half a month!
Killing a Forest Wolf essentially resolved Han Xing’s food crisis.
Even if he can’t finish it all, he could trade it with other players.
Currently, in channel 107, Han Xing was probably the only one capable of soloing a One-star Beast. Meat, as a food resource, is undoubtedly scarce and incredibly sought after!
After putting all the loot into his backpack, Han Xing merged these two territories with his own territory.
The area of his Sky Island expanded again, becoming a T-shaped space with a size of five cubic meters.
Now, even if he lay down directly, he wouldn’t have to worry about falling over.
At this moment, someone suddenly sent him a private message in the local chat channel.
Celestial Phoenix: "Master, I see the arrows you have listed on the trading platform. Are you a Hunter Profession?"
"Yes," Han Xing replied with a message.
Celestial Phoenix: "Master, I have something, are you interested?"
"Let me see it."
Han Xing didn’t like beating around the bush, and the other party promptly sent over the item information.
[Refined Iron Arrowhead Blueprint (Green)]
A green equipment, and it’s an arrowhead blueprint!
Han Xing’s pupils constricted, and a desire for this blueprint rose instantly in his heart.
But he quickly curbed his excitement, steadied himself, and said: "I can take it, what’s your price?"
The other person, named Celestial Phoenix, also breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this.
He had seen Han Xing’s listings on the trading platform and deduced his profession.
Celestial Phoenix straightforwardly said: "I want water, a large quantity, not less than 2 units!"
Upon hearing his condition, Han Xing was stirred but remained calm and said: "2000 milliliters of water, do you know how precious water resources are right now?"

Celestial Phoenix: "I know, but this is a green equipment blueprint! Although I don’t quite understand this world yet, I know that such items become more valuable later on, and when that time comes, even 20,000 milliliters of water might not be enough to trade it."

Han Xing sneered, "You said it yourself, they become more valuable later, but right now, what everyone lacks most are survival resources. I don’t have water, but I do have some food. If you really want to sell, just state a price I can accept."
After Han Xing finished speaking, the Survivor named ’Celestial Phoenix’ knew his initial price was somewhat outrageous, so he made some concessions: "Food is fine too, but no less than 10 units."
Han Xing continued to sneer: "5 units at most, 5 kilograms of food, that’s enough for you to last two or three days.
Celestial Phoenix hesitated for a moment, but finally gritted his teeth and said: "Fine, 5 kilograms it is!"
Both parties quickly completed the transaction.
Even though 5 kilograms of food is a lot, no matter how you look at it, Han Xing still came out ahead.
[Successfully acquired ’Refined Iron Arrowhead Blueprint’, learn it?]
Han Xing immediately chose to learn it.
In the next moment, the blueprint section showed a new green equipment blueprint.
[Refined Iron Arrow (Green)]
[Materials needed for crafting: Refined Iron*2, Feather*1.]
Han Xing pondered for a moment, "Refined Iron, this material, can only be obtained from some chests in the early stages of the game. I wonder if there is any in the trading channel now."
He entered the trading channel, then input the keyword ’Refined Iron’, and quickly filtered seven listings.
All these people were asking for water and food in exchange. Han Xing initiated private chats, bargaining each one down.
Finally, he traded 3 kilograms of Wolf Meat and 4 Berries for 12 pieces of Refined Iron.
One of the materials for crafting arrows was gathered, now only feathers were needed.
Han Xing asked in the group chat: "Can anyone lend me some feathers? I need to make something."
"Feathers? Brother Xing, I got some for you!" Cheng Jianyong said in the group chat.
"Let’s trade."
After the transaction, the system prompt came through.
[Successfully received fur of some primate*23.]
Looking at the few black strands of hair in his hand, Han Xing couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth twice.
"Cheng Jianyong, are you insane? Who needed your leg hair?"
"Damn! Didn’t you ask for hair? You didn’t specify!" Cheng Jianyong said angrily.
Han Xing threw those strands of leg hair away, "I meant bird feathers, feathers from birds!"
To prevent further misunderstandings from Cheng Jianyong, Han Xing deliberately emphasized the latter part.

Seeing their chat, Shen Yun couldn’t help but laugh, "Brother Xing, when I was exploring the Cloud Layer just now, I found a large bird’s nest, but there were no creatures inside. I managed to grab a few feathers, just for you."
"Great."
After completing the transaction, Han Xing’s backpack had 9 gray-white feathers.
[Feathers of Big-beaked Bird (Common Material)]
With the materials gathered, he opened the blueprint and started crafting.
Flashes of white light passed continuously.
[Successfully crafted Refined Iron Arrow (Green)*6.]

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Asking for the Moon
paragraphs: [Successfully crafted Refined Iron Arrow (Green) *6.]
[Refined Iron Arrow (Green), Quality - Fine, Attack Power 5~7, Special Effect - Armor Piercing.]
[Armor Piercing: When attacking enemies with high defense, there is a certain chance to trigger the effect, ignoring parts of the opponent’s defense to cause damage.]
Wow! Directly ignoring defense, this armor piercing effect is truly powerful!
Fine quality refined iron arrow, the attack power bonus alone is above 5, almost catching up with the additional attack power of his wooden longbow.
Keep in mind, the wooden longbow is his main weapon, and now just one arrow is almost on par with it.
Plus the added armor piercing effect, one can imagine how much damage this thing causes when hitting an enemy!
After crafting the refined iron arrows, Han Xing continued to browse the trading channel.
His goal is a Hunter’s weapon or blueprint, wanting to replace this whiteboard longbow he has, by then his attack power can increase several levels more.
After browsing around, he didn’t find any suitable target.
Though there are Hunter’s weapons for sale, most are similar to the whiteboard equipment Han Xing has, he even saw some survivors putting up weapons gifted by the system for sale.
As Han Xing was about to exit the trading channel, he suddenly saw a Hunter’s weapon blueprint.
[Sandalwood Longbow Blueprint (White)]
Although it’s whiteboard equipment, if crafted himself, with the blessing of the ’Divine-level Artisan’ talent, it could be quite an improvement compared to the wooden longbow in hand.
Han Xing clicked to private chat, the other person’s name was Levi.
That guy, actually didn’t choose anonymous chatting, but directly used his real name.
"How much for the longbow blueprint?" Han Xing got straight to the point.
Levi: "20 units of food, or 10 units of water."
Look, what’s called a lion’s big mouth, this is what it is!
Han Xing frowned, "Your price is too high, lower it a bit."
If someone truly wanted to trade, they would make some concessions here following Han Xing’s suggestion.
But the opposite was someone using their real name to chat, not someone easy to deal with.
Levi sneered, "This is the price, no change, buy it if you want."
"Farewell." Han Xing didn’t indulge him, directly exited, preparing to close the private chat window.
Levi suddenly sent a message: "Wait!"
"You’re Star River? The one selling special effect wooden arrows?"
Han Xing didn’t know what trick he wanted to pull, but still replied, "That’s me."
Upon Han Xing’s admission, Levi’s attitude immediately changed.
"To come up with such items so quickly at the beginning, you’ve got some skills. Are you interested in joining our Lei Group?"
"Lei Family? From Xinyang City?" Han Xing asked.
Levi: "Seems like you’ve heard of us, oh right, I almost forgot, most people on this channel are from Xinyang City, it’s no wonder they know our Lei Group."
Since arriving in this world, about ten hours have passed, everyone also figured out the rules for area division.
According to regions, ten thousand adjacent people are grouped into the same channel, meaning the ten thousand people in channel 107 are mostly from the same place.

Levi continued, "Our Lei Group has some influence in Xinyang City, and this channel has some members from the Lei Group, we’ve already formed a discussion group and established an elite team, everyone helps each other and shares survival experiences."
"How about it, want to join us?" Levi stated his intentions.
Han Xing directly declined, "No need."
Levi was silent for a moment, seemingly puzzled, someone could refuse his invitation at such a time.
One must know, humans are social animals, especially in such an unfamiliar world where life isn’t guaranteed, they’d want companion’s support for comfort.
Levi continued, "You should understand, this is a world completely different from before, human lives are fragile as paper, and I built this team to unite everyone for better survival."
What Levi said sounded noble, without other considerations, generally at this time joining them would indeed be a good choice.
But Han Xing knew, Levi was one of Lei Group’s major shareholders, at the essence, this guy was just a businessman.
Businessmen always seek profit, after years of social grinding post-graduation, Han Xing had seen through these people’s nature.
The so-called organizations and teams are just to grasp control of discourse for gaining more benefits.
And Levi’s initial lofty attitude just made Han Xing very uncomfortable.
He directly declined.
Han Xing refused for a second time, Levi instantly got anxious: "You short-sighted guy! Do you know right now in the entire 107 area, besides us, many organizations are forming teams."
"It’s inevitable for survivors to unite together, if you don’t join us, only a dead end awaits you!"
"Join our Lei Group, and contribute the method for special effect wooden arrows, I could even give you the blueprint at a lower price!"
Levi started threatening with inducements, but the conditions offered made Han Xing feel like this guy was stupid.
Trying to buy him with just a whiteboard weapon, what’s he thinking?
Of course, it could be he’s used to calling the shots in Xinyang City, subconsciously considering others as fools.
Han Xing smirked, "I said, I don’t want to join your organization, don’t think of using your tricks to deceive me, no more nonsense I’ll hang up now."
"Damn kid! If you don’t join Lei Group, don’t think about getting this weapon blueprint, soon the entire 107 channel won’t have a place for you!"
Han Xing disdainfully smiled, "You keep the blueprint, a mere whiteboard weapon, only you treat it as treasure, idiot."
Levi wanted to say more, but Han Xing had already closed the private chat window.
At this moment, in the discussion group, Shen Yun said.
"Brother Xing, Jian Yong, have you received any group invitations? Wanting us to join?"
Cheng Jianyong replied, "Yes, just now some CEO from a company invited me, I refused."
Han Xing: "Yeah, I refused too."
Shen Yun didn’t reply, seemingly pondering about something, after a moment asked: "Brother Xing, what’s your opinion on joining these organizations?"
Han Xing said, "No need, this world’s rules were made clear upon entry, we just need to explore other Sky Islands to expand our territory."
The two thought for a bit and agreed.
Just then, Cheng Jianyong suddenly said, "Seems like there’s some drama on the intranet, that Lei Group seems to be causing trouble for someone named ’Star River’."
Star River? Isn’t that my name?
Lei Group, could it be that Levi?
Han Xing hadn’t told them his virtual name, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun added him via real name.
Opened the chat channel, indeed saw Levi mentioning him on the intranet.
Levi: "@Star River, damn kid, you dare insult me! Ungrateful wretch, I’m telling you, from today onwards, don’t even think of trading materials with anyone from Lei Group!"
Bamboo Mouse: "Support the boss, our Lei Conglomerate collectively shuts you out."
Slow Walking Cloud: "Support!"
Old Six: "@Star River, kid, come out and speak!"

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Huge Profit!
paragraphs: Han Xing was speechless. He had just had a brief argument with this Levi, but he never expected that guy to be so petty as to put him on the local network.
However, when he saw them talking about banning him and refusing to trade materials with him, Han Xing couldn’t help but chuckle.
He opened the consignment channel and put up an item.
A few seconds after the item was up for consignment, the entire Channel 107 was in an uproar.
Consignment item information: [Space Backpack - White], required item: any Blue Equipment Blueprint.
Consignor: Star River.
Chat channel.
"Holy crap! Space Backpack?"
"Which master is this, who got such a powerful item so quickly?"
"The consignor seems to be Star River, isn’t that the person the Lei Group just tagged to blacklist?"
The atmosphere in the local network was a bit strange.
At this moment, someone else said: "Wait, the master seems to have put up more stuff!"
"Hiss... It’s actually Rare Quality Iron Arrows and a lot of Wolf Meat!"
"So much Wolf Meat! Check quickly what he needs!"
"He wants Green Equipment Blueprints, Beast Hide, Spirit Core, and Water, as well as Refined Iron! Whoever has these, quickly go and trade with the master!"
After Han Xing put up the consignment information continuously, those from the Lei Group suddenly stopped speaking. Even if they wanted to, they would have been drowned out by the bustling chat.
Mainly because the items Han Xing brought out are just too powerful for the current stage.
The Space Backpack, needless to say, was the full server first boss kill reward. Although he now has something better, for these players, this item is practically a divine artifact.
Then there are the Fine Quality Iron Arrows, with an arrow’s attack power nearly matching the main weapon, what concept is this? Even those with no sharp eye can see its power.
Plus, there’s the special effect that is enough to make those who haven’t chosen the Hunter profession envious.
Then Han Xing consigned 10 kilograms of Wolf Meat in one go, which was also the most scarce resource for everyone!
The chat channel was instantly filled with a frenzy of grabbing.
"Hahaha! I got it, traded one Beast Hide for an Iron Arrow!"
"I got it too, traded 5 Spirit Cores for 300g of Wolf Meat, finally got something to eat, sob sob."
"Brothers, is it a huge profit to trade 10 Refined Irons for an Iron Arrow?"
The fervor in the chat channel continued until Han Xing’s consigned items were fully traded, then it gradually subsided.
Now, there’s only the [Space Backpack] left that hasn’t been traded.
After all, Blue Equipment Blueprints are considered extremely precious; at this early stage, there might not even be one in all of Channel 107.
In a certain Sky Island Territory, a middle-aged man with a face full of flesh looked at the information on the local network, his face growing increasingly grim.
He is the president of the Lei Group, Levi.
At this moment, Levi is looking at the messages in his discussion group.
Someone asked cautiously: "President Lei, is this kid named Star River challenging us?"
Levi snorted coldly and said nothing more, merely silently remembering the name Star River in his heart.
Han Xing looked at the dazzling array of items on the Sky Island Territory, unable to hide the smile on his face.
[Obtained Spirit Core*17, One-star Beast Hide*3, Refined Iron*32, Ether*108, Drinking Water 400ml...]
These were the materials Han Xing traded for using 4 Iron Arrows and 10 kilograms of Wolf Meat, a huge profit!
Although it seemed to cost a lot, Han Xing knew that by converting these materials into combat power, he could gain more.
Initially, he planned to exchange these foods for the resources he needed.
Then use these resources to continue crafting equipment to strengthen himself, creating a virtuous cycle.
As for suppressing those from the Lei Group, it was merely a side action; Han Xing didn’t take them to heart at all.

Unfortunately, he didn’t obtain a Green Equipment Blueprint this time, but it’s already good enough, considering other Survivors are not fools, and those holding Green Equipment are scarce at this time.
"Let me see... the current materials are enough to make 11 Fine Iron Arrows and 3 Space Backpacks!"
"Not bad, not bad." Han Xing clapped his hands.
Then, he clicked to craft all these items in one breath.
Green and white lights flashed in succession.
When the crafting success prompt appeared, Han Xing was pleasantly surprised by the attributes of the Space Backpack.
[Space Backpack (White), Quality - Fine, Storage Space - 30, Special Effect - Sturdy (Power +4)]
Unlike the previous backpack, this backpack’s special effect added four power points, and Han Xing saw that of the other two, one also added power, and the other added agility.
"Oh? Are the special effect attributes of the backpack randomly increased in four dimensions?"
Han Xing equipped the backpack with the agility bonus, immediately feeling a peculiar force emerge in his body.
The agility attribute was enhanced.
"Although only two backpacks can be equipped, it still significantly boosts attributes, making it easier to deal with regular Level 1 wild monsters now."
"Too bad I haven’t found a good weapon." Han Xing felt slightly disappointed, then shook his head and stopped thinking about it.
As for what to do with the other two extra backpacks, Han Xing pondered for a moment and then opened the discussion group.
As soon as he entered, he heard Cheng Jianyong shouting inside.
"Brothers, I seem to have discovered a treasure!"
"What is it?" Shen Yun asked.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, directly saying: "Bronze Treasure Chest!"
"No way!"
Both Han Xing and Shen Yun were greatly surprised.

Based on Han Xing’s understanding of the game Sky Island Paradise, treasure chests are divided into Wooden Box, Bronze Treasure Chest, Silver Treasure Chest, Golden Treasure Chest, and Diamond Treasure Chest levels.
The probability of finding a treasure chest on an unowned Sky Island is very low, especially in the early game, coming across even a Wooden Box is considered lucky.
And now Cheng Jianyong had directly found a Bronze Treasure Chest; his luck was exceptionally good!
Shen Yun: "Quickly open it and see what’s inside?"
"Alright!" Cheng Jianyong readily agreed.
Han Xing and Shen Yun silently waited, and shortly after, they suddenly heard Cheng Jianyong shout: "It’s out! I got it!"
"Damn it! What did you get?" Shen Yun demanded, "Speak up!"
"Good stuff!" Cheng Jianyong directly posted the details of what he got into the discussion group.
[Spirit Core*4, Refined Iron*8, Rare Earth*13, Dried Beast Meat*7 kilograms, Drinking Water 400ml, Refined Iron Longbow Blueprint (Green)]
"Hiss!!!"
Upon seeing the information, both Han Xing and Shen Yun gasped.
Shen Yun: "Those materials and food aside, even being able to find a Green Weapon Blueprint, this guy’s luck is really outrageous..."
Han Xing: "Indeed..."
Listening to their praise, Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily.
Then, Han Xing suddenly received a trade request from Cheng Jianyong.
"Brother Xing, it’s a Longbow Blueprint, I’m a Warrior Profession, Brother Yun chose Holy Profession, neither of us can use it, you take it."
Shen Yun stayed silent, as everyone knew just how precious a Green Weapon Blueprint is in the early game.
That Levi dared to ask sky-high prices for a Whiteboard Weapon Blueprint; if Cheng Jianyong’s Green Weapon Blueprint appeared in the trading channel, it would definitely cause quite a stir.
But some things cannot simply be measured by value.
Han Xing deliberated for a second, then clicked accept.
[Obtained Refined Iron Longbow Blueprint (Green)]
Han Xing directly clicked to learn it, and now his blueprint list has a fourth blueprint.
Then, Han Xing initiated a trade with each of them.
When Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun saw what Han Xing put in the trade window, they both shouted out in unison.
"Holy crap!"

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Powerful Equipment Attributes!
paragraphs: Han Xing traded the spare backpack to them.
Cheng Jianyong: "Whoa, a Space Backpack! And it comes with special effects!"
Shen Yun: "Brother Xing, this thing is too precious, you..."
Han Xing directly interrupted them, saying, "Shh, remember not to spread the word."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun solemnly agreed, also understanding how absurd it was for a Space Backpack with special effects to appear right now.
Shen Yun looked at the trading channel, at the listing for [Space Backpack (White)], and then connected it to Han Xing’s name, a thoughtful look on his face.
After the discussion group closed.
Han Xing looked at the fourth blueprint in the blueprint list, barely able to suppress his smile.
He had just mentioned needing a suitable weapon, and in no time, Cheng Jianyong had found one. It wasn’t just like getting a pillow when sleepy—it was like finding a restroom after finishing a meal!
Han Xing gleefully looked at the blueprint interface.
[Refined Iron Longbow Blueprint (Green)]
[Materials needed: Refined Iron*15, Spirit Core*5, Rare Earth*20, One-Star Beast Tendon*1.]
[Production success rate 20% (affected by ’Divine-level Artisan’) Talent, success rate reached 100%.]
"Hunter main weapon, and it’s a green equipment, I’m thrilled!"
Han Xing was extremely excited, even wanting to make one right then and there.
However, he didn’t have enough materials, mainly lacking the new material Rare Earth and the One-Star Beast Tendon.
But that was fine; he could look in the trading channel.
After browsing around, Han Xing quickly found his target and started negotiating prices skillfully.
It seemed that due to the recent listing event, the name ’Star River’ was already known by many survivors on channel 107.
The negotiation process went very smoothly.
He used only 1 kilogram of Wolf Meat to trade for 2 One-Star Beast Tendons, and then another kilogram for 47 Rare Earths.
He had enough materials to make two Refined Iron Longbows.
Han Xing opened the blueprint interface and began crafting immediately.
Green light began to flash, and a thirty-second progress bar appeared before him.
When the progress bar completed, a Refined Iron Longbow crafted from black Refined Iron appeared in the territory, over a meter in length.
The item information appeared before him.
[Refined Iron Longbow (Green), Quality-Refined, Attack 15~20, Attached Effect-Strong Strike]
[Strong Strike: After pulling the bowstring fully, it begins to charge, with a charge limit of 1 second, causing 30%~50% additional damage]
"So strong!"

Han Xing sincerely praised, "As expected from a green weapon, its attack power alone is more than double that of a whiteboard weapon, plus the weapon’s special effect, this arrow could probably one-shot those Level 1 wild monsters!
Han Xing was very satisfied, and at this moment, he seemed to remember something.
"Based on my previous experience, green weapon blueprints can produce rare quality equipment at most, yet this main weapon is refined, indicating there is still room for improvement."
Looking at the materials in his backpack, Han Xing hesitated for a moment, then clicked on crafting again.
This was his advantage; he didn’t have to worry about failure, nor about crafting poor quality or ordinary garbage weapons and wasting materials.
This time, at the moment crafting began, a dazzling green light appeared.
As the progress bar moved, the green light became increasingly piercing.
"Hmm? Such a commotion, could it be..."
As soon as he spoke, snap!
A weapon dropped in front of Han Xing.
[Refined Iron Longbow (Green), Quality-Rare, Attack Power 20~25, Attached Effect-Strong Strike, Attached Effect 2-Precision]
[Strong Strike: After pulling the bowstring fully, it begins to charge, with a charge limit of 1 second, causing 30%~50% additional damage]
[Precision: Increases hit rate by 10% and critical strike rate by 20% when attacking]
"Rare quality!"
At this moment, Han Xing felt his heart skip a beat.
Simply because the attributes of this Refined Iron Longbow were too powerful!
Powerful attack, along with two special effects, even the usual Blue Armor doesn’t have the attributes of this Refined Iron Longbow.
Without hesitation, Han Xing equipped the rare quality Refined Iron Longbow, significantly boosting his damage once more.
With the longbow on his back, it appeared stable and full of deterrence, its curved body, tight bowstring, and formidable tension and lethality were all on display.
Compared to a few hours ago, Han Xing was like a new person, his strength significantly enhanced.
He casually listed the discarded Wooden Longbow on the consignment channel and also put up another Refined Iron Longbow.
Although not as good as the one in his hand, its powerful attributes still caused quite a stir among the hunters.
However, because Han Xing marked the consignment conditions as green equipment blueprints, no one could trade it for now.
At this moment, Han Xing looked up at the sky.
Moon shadows slanted, cold lights overlapping.
"It’s almost deep night; after exploring a few more Sky Islands, I’ll prepare to rest," Han Xing thought.
In this world, although humans’ physical fitness had improved, they still needed rest, and exploring Sky Islands at night was more dangerous than during the day.
Thinking of this, Han Xing quickened his pace.
As he approached a cloud only two cubic meters in size, a system prompt came: "There’s the sound of wind inside... enter?"
Upon entering, he found a patch of green Wind Chime Grass growing on top, which Han Xing collected into his backpack.
[Obtained Wind Chime Grass*23, territory area expanded...]
"There are intermittent echoes inside... enter?"
Enter.
[Obtained Amplification Stone*3, territory area expanded...]
[Obtained One-Star Beast Hide*1, obtained Rare Earth*3, obtained Flash Stone*7...]
Han Xing moved forward without stopping, interacting with four or five smaller clouds nearby.
During this time, he encountered three monsters, but with their most 1-Level attributes, they were essentially one-shot, instant kills for the current Han Xing!
Han Xing had crushed them with his powerful equipment.
Meanwhile, his territory expanded rapidly.
After a whole day of exploration, the small patch of ground beneath his feet had become a platform measuring 4 meters by 4 meters, a total of 16 square meters!
"Phew..."
Han Xing took a breath, then turned back to find that the dozens of kilometers of small clouds in the nearby area had been explored.
Now, only a not far away cloud emitting faint red light had not been contacted.
Compared to the others, this cloud was slightly larger, roughly estimated to be 2 meters by 2 meters, 4 square meters in size.
When he first descended upon this world, Han Xing deliberately avoided it because he sensed a hint of danger from it.
But now, he thought it was worth trying to interact with it.
Thinking of this, Han Xing opened his backpack, drank two sips of water, and picked three berries from a tree, putting them in his mouth.
After these preparations, the Sky Island Territory began moving towards the cloud.
A moment later, the system prompt came: "There’s a hot power brewing inside... enter?"
"A hot power? Could there be a fire source inside?"
Han Xing suddenly felt some anticipation.
In the early stages of Sky Island Paradise, while fire sources weren’t as scarce as water and food, they were still essential things.
Whether for lighting a fire or keeping warm, they had great use.
Thinking of this, Han Xing clicked to enter directly.
The next moment, a creature all red and chubby was bouncing in front of Han Xing.
[Flame Slime (One-Star Creature)]
[Level: LV2]
[Power: 9, Agility: 5, Spirit: 7, Constitution: 6]
[Skills: Fireball Spray]

sentences.text: Han Xing traded the spare backpack to them.
Cheng Jianyong: "Whoa, a Space Backpack!
And it comes with special effects!"
Shen Yun: "Brother Xing, this thing is too precious, you..."
Han Xing directly interrupted them, saying, "Shh, remember not to spread the word."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun solemnly agreed, also understanding how absurd it was for a Space Backpack with special effects to appear right now.
Shen Yun looked at the trading channel, at the listing for [Space Backpack (White)], and then connected it to Han Xing’s name, a thoughtful look on his face.
After the discussion group closed.
Han Xing looked at the fourth blueprint in the blueprint list, barely able to suppress his smile.
He had just mentioned needing a suitable weapon, and in no time, Cheng Jianyong had found one.
It wasn’t just like getting a pillow when sleepy—it was like finding a restroom after finishing a meal!
Han Xing gleefully looked at the blueprint interface.
[Refined Iron Longbow Blueprint (Green)]
[Materials needed: Refined Iron*15, Spirit Core*5, Rare Earth*20, One-Star Beast Tendon*1.]
[Production success rate 20% (affected by ’Divine-level Artisan’) Talent, success rate reached 100%.]
"Hunter main weapon, and it’s a green equipment, I’m thrilled!"
Han Xing was extremely excited, even wanting to make one right then and there.
However, he didn’t have enough materials, mainly lacking the new material Rare Earth and the One-Star Beast Tendon.
But that was fine; he could look in the trading channel.
After browsing around, Han Xing quickly found his target and started negotiating prices skillfully.
It seemed that due to the recent listing event, the name ’Star River’ was already known by many survivors on channel 107.
The negotiation process went very smoothly.
He used only 1 kilogram of Wolf Meat to trade for 2 One-Star Beast Tendons, and then another kilogram for 47 Rare Earths.
He had enough materials to make two Refined Iron Longbows.
Han Xing opened the blueprint interface and began crafting immediately.
Green light began to flash, and a thirty-second progress bar appeared before him.
When the progress bar completed, a Refined Iron Longbow crafted from black Refined Iron appeared in the territory, over a meter in length.
The item information appeared before him.

[Strong Strike: After pulling the bowstring fully, it begins to charge, with a charge limit of 1 second, causing 30%~50% additional damage]

Han Xing sincerely praised, "As expected from a green weapon, its attack power alone is more than double that of a whiteboard weapon, plus the weapon’s special effect, this arrow could probably one-shot those Level 1 wild monsters!

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Dark Fire Stone Mine
paragraphs: Flame Slime, Level 2 creature, also with Elemental Attributes!
Compared to the Level 1 ordinary slime, this Flame Slime has a noticeably stronger desire to attack.
In the instant it saw Han Xing appear, it opened its O-shaped little mouth, and a scorching flame seemed to be brewing within.
Han Xing did not underestimate it and quickly distanced himself.
The next second, the charged Fine Iron Arrow burst forth instantly.
Buzz!
The bowstring tightened, emitting a trembling sound in the air.
The arrow shot out swiftly and accurately hit the forehead of the Flame Slime.
Puff!
Attack landed.
The two round eyes of the Flame Slime suddenly widened, seemingly frightened by something.
"Pop pop!"
Two fireballs shot towards Han Xing at a speed not inferior to the arrows.
At this moment, Han Xing moved.
With a flash, he instantly dodged the Flame Slime’s attack.
The special effect of the Space Backpack played its role at this moment.
The additional 4 points of agility increased his Agility Attribute to 8 points!
This was almost the attribute that a typical Level 3 Hunter could possess!
Pah! Pah!
The fireballs missed, exploding on the ground under Han Xing’s feet, charring two patches of earth.
Han Xing continued to draw his bow and began charging.
One second later, the Strong Strike special effect of the Fine Iron Longbow took effect.
Han Xing clearly felt that this arrow had more destructive power than before.
The Flame Slime was still brewing a second wave of fireball attacks.
Buzz!
The ’Strong Strike’ special effect of the Bow and Arrow was triggered, and the Fine Iron Arrow fiercely pierced into the body of the Flame Slime, causing it more damage.
Moreover, with an undiminished force, the arrow went straight through its body with a puff!
This arrow also triggered the ’Armor Piercing’ special effect of the arrow, dramatically increasing the damage.
The Flame Slime’s attack was abruptly halted, its recent attack leaving it in a severely wounded state.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
Strike while it’s down; take its life!
Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh!
One Fine Iron Arrow after another was successively shot out.
The Level 2 Flame Slime, though powerful, couldn’t withstand Han Xing’s repeated assaults.
When the seventh arrow hit, the Flame Slime stayed in place and then began to swell.
"Oh no, it’s going to explode!"
Han Xing’s expression changed instantly, and having had this experience before, he sprinted back without any hesitation.
He directly retreated to the edge of the territory.
At this moment, the body of the Flame Slime had swollen to its limit, like a red balloon about to explode.
Then, with a pop, it exploded!
Sparks flew everywhere as the slime exploded into pieces.
[You have slain Flame Slime lv2, gaining 20 Experience Value.]
Finally, it’s taken care of. Han Xing glanced at his experience bar, which had already reached 80% of Level 1.
Han Xing began approaching the territory of the Flame Slime.
Where it self-destructed, a few fiery red stones and several clusters of transparent substances were left.
Those transparent substances were Ethereal Materials, only dropped from Magic Creatures like slimes.
Picking up the things on the ground, the system prompted.
[Obtained Fire Stone*4, obtained Ether*8, obtained Slime Mucus*17.]
[Fire Stone: A type of ore that contains scorching energy, seemingly usable for creating certain special devices, and can also serve as a fire starter]
Han Xing merged this 4-cubic Sky Island into his territory, increasing its area to 4 meters by 5 meters, with a total of 20 cubic meters.
This space might not be very large but not very small either; in some first-tier cities on Blue Star, it could be considered a large house.
However, his current territory was somewhat barren, with only a short Juicy Fruit Tree serving as decoration.
As Han Xing was observing his territory, he inadvertently noticed some differences in the four blocks of land recently merged in.
These were several blocks of rocky terrain.
On the blue-gray stones, there seemed to be some dark red spots, and as Han Xing approached, he could clearly feel the temperature steadily rising.
"Oh?" Han Xing showed some curiosity and walked onto these rocks, discovering their secret.
It was those dark red spots buried beneath the stones that were continually emitting heat.
"Could it be some kind of ore?"
Han Xing’s curiosity was piqued, and he wanted to try digging out these dark red stones.
Mining would destroy the area’s territory, and if severe, the block could even disintegrate into pieces suspended in mid-air, reducing the territory size.
But if the stones were valuable minerals, sacrificing a few blocks of land might be worthwhile.
Han Xing decided to mine but needed a pickaxe, and he didn’t have one in his backpack.
He entered the trading channel to exchange some materials with others for a few iron pickaxes.
Then, Han Xing rolled up his sleeves and started digging.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
In the high sky, the sound of metal striking stone echoed continually.
"Eighty! Eighty!
Keeping with the rhythm, Han Xing chanted a slogan.
Bits of stone flew around, and a few minutes later, the dark red stones hidden beneath the rocks were exposed.
The system prompted.
[Dark Fire Stone: A rare ore that seems to contain some peculiar energy, capable of continually emitting heat and providing energy for certain devices.]
[Note: When Dark Fire Stones reach a certain quantity in the same area, they may give rise to some kind of peculiar Elemental Creatures.]
Seeing the introduction above, Han Xing understood.
The slime was likely spawned from the Dark Fire Stone, and by absorbing the heat, it kept growing stronger.
But evidently, it hadn’t grown strong enough before Han Xing targeted it.
Han Xing picked up the stones on the ground.
[Obtained Dark Fire Stone*12.]
After mining, Han Xing felt an emptiness washing over him.
This was the body’s biological clock reminding him to rest.
The night was as desolate as water, and the high-altitude temperature suddenly dropped significantly.
A light breeze blew, causing one to shrink their neck unconsciously.
The first day for humans in this world was about to end, and many had territories of 3 to 4 cubic meters; though still relatively small, they were at least large enough to lie down and sleep.
Of course, if you were restless in your sleep, you could only rely on luck.
Many survivors curled up, shivering from the cold in mid-air.
Compared to them, Han Xing was much better off.
In his 20-square-meter territory, there was no risk of falling off.
He placed two Dark Fire Stones on either side of the territory, not only providing illumination but also continually emitting heat, just like lighting a furnace on a cold day, incredibly warm.
In the territory’s center stood a Juicy Fruit Tree stripped of many branches, swaying silently, its canopy rustling in the breeze.
Han Xing leaned against the Juicy Fruit Tree, lying on the ground, gazing at the vast starry sky.
Sleeping at such a height was a unique feeling.
It seemed as though with an outstretched hand, he could touch the sky, with clouds floating around.
Before sleeping, Han Xing kept his habit from Blue Star, which was to scroll through information.
Without a phone, he could still access the local network to check other Survivors’ chats.
Most survivors had finished their day’s explorations, and the local chat channel became more lively.
They were all discussing how to sleep on the first night.
"Shovel, does anyone need a shovel? You can dig a hole in the ground and bury yourself, so you don’t have to worry about falling off while sleeping at night."
"Rope! I have rope here; you can tie yourself up to prevent rolling around in your sleep!"
"Anyone need glue made from Slime Mucus?"
