chapters.title: Chapter 11: Skill Book and Barbecue
paragraphs: Looking at the chat channel information, a slight smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
Indeed, humanity’s adaptability is quite strong. After a day, everyone has more or less accepted the fact that they’ve come to a whole new world.
Turning off the local network, sleepiness hit, and in the warm environment, Han Xing fell into a deep sleep...
However, before he could sleep for long, Han Xing was suddenly awakened by a friend’s message.
It was from Shen Yun.
Shen Yun: "Brother Xing, are you asleep?"
"Hmm, just slept for a bit." Han Xing replied.
"This..." Shen Yun seemed a bit awkward, apologizing, "Sorry, Brother Xing."
Han Xing jokingly scolded, "What’s there to be sorry about? Didn’t you guys make noise to disturb my sleep often enough back in the dorms?"
Shen Yun laughed, "That’s true, but speaking of it, didn’t you guys disturb my sleep even more often?"
"Really? I forgot, haha." Han Xing changed the subject, "What’s up?"
Shen Yun: "Not much, I just came across something and wanted to show you."
"Hmm? What is it?" Han Xing was a bit curious.
In the middle of the night, Shen Yun couldn’t wait to contact him, it must be something good.
Shen Yun directly sent a trade request.
Then, Han Xing saw him put up a white book with the words ’Double Arrow’ on it.
"Skill Book!" Han Xing recognized it at once, feeling incredibly shocked inside!
"Yes, it’s for the Hunter profession. I think you could make use of it." Shen Yun said happily.
Han Xing was silent for a moment.
At this stage, skill books are harder to come by than equipment or blueprints.
Even though it’s just a basic skill for the five major professions, everyone currently only knows some basic weapon handling and simple chopping movements during combat.
The value of a skill book is even higher than his space backpack.
"Brother Xing, go ahead and take it." Shen Yun urged, directly confirming the trade.
Han Xing accepted, and the trade was completed.
[Skill Book Acquired: Double Arrow (Hunter Exclusive)]
"Thank you." Han Xing said solemnly.
With this skill, Han Xing’s strength would increase to another level.
"No need to be polite, didn’t you give me a backpack?"
Han Xing said no more. He knew Shen Yun was the kind of person who, even if he didn’t say it, would remember it well and when he had the ability, would return the favor as soon as possible.

It’s not about being unfeeling, but a principle of being human. As the saying goes, even close brothers should keep accounts clear; no matter how good the relationship, one side shouldn’t constantly be the one giving.
Cheng Jianyong is the same way, which is why Han Xing is willing to be friends with them.
At this time, Han Xing said, "It’s late, you should get some rest too."
Shen Yun laughed, "Brother Xing, I want to sleep too, but I can’t fall asleep!
"Can’t sleep?" Han Xing was puzzled.
"Yes."

Shen Yun was a bit embarrassed, "Because I’m too excited! I never thought there would be a day when I could break free from repetitive work and boring life, just like I always fantasized, starting anew in another world."
"Brother Xing, maybe you think there’s something wrong with my mind, but this is my true inner thought."
"Although this world is unsafe and life could be in danger at any moment, only now do I feel truly alive..."
After ending the chat with Shen Yun, Han Xing went back to sleep.
The next day.
When Han Xing opened his eyes, the sun was already high in the sky.
According to Blue Star time calculation, it was already past ten o’clock.
At this point, he suddenly understood what Shen Yun meant.
Right, since stepping into society, when had he ever woken up naturally like today?
Every day wasn’t he woken by the repetitive alarm, even holidays disturbed by calls from clients and bosses.
While Han Xing was lamenting, his expression suddenly changed.
"Damn, need to poop!"
The first thing in the morning is to clear the bowels; this is a lifestyle habit Han Xing maintained.
He quickly stood up, took a round of the Sky Island Territory, but couldn’t find a suitable spot.
At this point, his face had turned a bit red from holding it in.
"Damn, can’t hold it anymore, I’ll just do it here!"
Han Xing quickly dug a hole in the soil at the edge of the territory.
A moment later, Han Xing let out a long sigh of relief...
After solving this top priority, Han Xing dusted his hands and stood up.
At this time, a system prompt appeared.
[Fertilization Successful, this plot of land will provide more nutrients for crops.]
Han Xing was filled with question marks.
Damn, even fertilization was done.
Han Xing shook his head, forget it, he didn’t bother thinking about these minor details.
Because now he had to solve another major life issue.
That is eating.
Having eaten berries all day yesterday, his mouth was about to go bland, he desperately wanted to eat some meat.
So, Han Xing took out two fire stones and two pieces of wood.
With a snap!
The two fire stones lightly struck, and sparks flew onto the wood, soon igniting it.
At the center of the territory, Han Xing set up a campfire, constantly adding firewood to it.
When the fire got stronger, he took out a small piece of wolf meat from his backpack, directly skewered it on an arrow and placed it on the fire to roast.
A dozen minutes later, the aroma of the roasted meat began to spread.
Until the piece of wolf meat was roasted to a golden brown, oozing golden grease on the surface, Han Xing wrapped the arrow tail with a piece of beast hide and took out the roast meat.
The rich aroma of meat wafted to his nose, Han Xing took a deep breath.
"Ah, smells great!"
He directly started to feast on it.
The wolf meat was very chewy, each bite needed to be chewed for a long time before swallowing.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but think, if only there were some seasonings.
After finishing one piece, he took out a few iron arrows and started roasting more meat.
While roasting, he opened the area channel, which had over a hundred private messages.
He had listed three items in the trade channel, besides the wooden longbow, there was a fine quality fine iron longbow and a space backpack.
Each one, at this stage, was incredibly precious, thus attracting many survivors.
He casually opened a few messages.
"Bro, is the space backpack for sale? I’ll trade fertile soil for it."
"God, can I trade 1 unit of water for the fine iron longbow?"
"Little brother, can you give me the space backpack..."
After skimming through, Han Xing was speechless.
Up to now, none of these offers appealed to him.
After all, it’s understandable since it was just after the first day.
Shaking his head, Han Xing put out the campfire and carried his longbow.
"I’ve almost explored this cloud area, today I need to go explore further places."
Han Xing controlled the territory to move forward slowly.
An hour later.
A car-sized cloud appeared ahead, roughly estimated to be 8 cubic meters.
With the system prompt appearing, Han Xing directly clicked to enter.
When the cloud dispersed, a field of golden wheat appeared in front of him, growing well.
"Wheat?"
Han Xing controlled the territory to approach, then harvested all the wheat on these 8 plots of land.
[Obtained Wheat*67, Obtained Wheat Seeds*14]
"Seeds too?" Han Xing exclaimed, "Doesn’t this mean I can now start farming mode?"

sentences.text: Looking at the chat channel information, a slight smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
Indeed, humanity’s adaptability is quite strong.
After a day, everyone has more or less accepted the fact that they’ve come to a whole new world.
Turning off the local network, sleepiness hit, and in the warm environment, Han Xing fell into a deep sleep...
However, before he could sleep for long, Han Xing was suddenly awakened by a friend’s message.
It was from Shen Yun.
Shen Yun: "Brother Xing, are you asleep?"
"Hmm, just slept for a bit." Han Xing replied.
"This..." Shen Yun seemed a bit awkward, apologizing, "Sorry, Brother Xing."
Han Xing jokingly scolded, "What’s there to be sorry about?
Didn’t you guys make noise to disturb my sleep often enough back in the dorms?"
Shen Yun laughed, "That’s true, but speaking of it, didn’t you guys disturb my sleep even more often?"
"Really?
I forgot, haha." Han Xing changed the subject, "What’s up?"
Shen Yun: "Not much, I just came across something and wanted to show you."
"Hmm?
What is it?" Han Xing was a bit curious.
In the middle of the night, Shen Yun couldn’t wait to contact him, it must be something good.
Shen Yun directly sent a trade request.
Then, Han Xing saw him put up a white book with the words ’Double Arrow’ on it.
"Skill Book!" Han Xing recognized it at once, feeling incredibly shocked inside!
"Yes, it’s for the Hunter profession.
I think you could make use of it." Shen Yun said happily.
Han Xing was silent for a moment.
At this stage, skill books are harder to come by than equipment or blueprints.
Even though it’s just a basic skill for the five major professions, everyone currently only knows some basic weapon handling and simple chopping movements during combat.
The value of a skill book is even higher than his space backpack.
"Brother Xing, go ahead and take it." Shen Yun urged, directly confirming the trade.
Han Xing accepted, and the trade was completed.
[Skill Book Acquired: Double Arrow (Hunter Exclusive)]
"Thank you." Han Xing said solemnly.
With this skill, Han Xing’s strength would increase to another level.
"No need to be polite, didn’t you give me a backpack?"
Han Xing said no more.
He knew Shen Yun was the kind of person who, even if he didn’t say it, would remember it well and when he had the ability, would return the favor as soon as possible.
It’s not about being unfeeling, but a principle of being human.
As the saying goes, even close brothers should keep accounts clear; no matter how good the relationship, one side shouldn’t constantly be the one giving.
Cheng Jianyong is the same way, which is why Han Xing is willing to be friends with them.
At this time, Han Xing said, "It’s late, you should get some rest too."
Shen Yun laughed, "Brother Xing, I want to sleep too, but I can’t fall asleep!
"Can’t sleep?" Han Xing was puzzled.
"Yes."
Shen Yun was a bit embarrassed, "Because I’m too excited!
I never thought there would be a day when I could break free from repetitive work and boring life, just like I always fantasized, starting anew in another world."
"Brother Xing, maybe you think there’s something wrong with my mind, but this is my true inner thought."
"Although this world is unsafe and life could be in danger at any moment, only now do I feel truly alive..."

According to Blue Star time calculation, it was already past ten o’clock.
At this point, he suddenly understood what Shen Yun meant.
Right, since stepping into society, when had he ever woken up naturally like today?
Every day wasn’t he woken by the repetitive alarm, even holidays disturbed by calls from clients and bosses.
While Han Xing was lamenting, his expression suddenly changed.
"Damn, need to poop!"

He quickly stood up, took a round of the Sky Island Territory, but couldn’t find a suitable spot.
At this point, his face had turned a bit red from holding it in.
"Damn, can’t hold it anymore, I’ll just do it here!"
Han Xing quickly dug a hole in the soil at the edge of the territory.

Damn, even fertilization was done.

That is eating.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Wheat Seeds and the Bronze Treasure Chest
paragraphs: When personal territory development reaches the middle stage, if the game doesn’t change much, many Survivors will definitely choose to enter farming mode.
After all, compared to fighting monsters to obtain resources, farming is indeed a more stable way to develop, at least without life-threatening dangers.
Of course, to farm, a large land area is also needed.
"However, this farming mode doesn’t suit me, let’s see if they need it."
Han Xing opened the discussion group and directly asked, "Guys, do you want seeds?"
Cheng Jianyong: "Seeds? I want, I want, send me a set quickly!"
Shen Yun: "Whose are they, send me a set too."
Han Xing: "..."
"It’s wheat seeds, what were you two thinking?"
Both of them sighed in disappointment after hearing that.
Cheng Jianyong: "Sigh... I thought I could see those classic masterpieces in this world too."
Shen Yun: "Yeah... I was looking forward to it for so long."
Han Xing was speechless: "Do you want them or not?"
Cheng Jianyong: "No, my place is as small as a palm, I would be guilty of high-altitude littering just going to the bathroom, there’s no space for farming."
Shen Yun: "I don’t want it either."
"Alright."
Han Xing closed the discussion group interface.
The Sky Island continued moving forward.
This time, Han Xing had targeted a cloud about the same size as before.
The system prompted: "There are signs of multiple creatures inside, they seem to be guarding something."
"Hmm?"
Han Xing keenly noticed that this system prompt was different from before.
Multiple creatures indicated there was more than one monster inside, and what they were guarding was likely some kind of precious material, or maybe even a treasure chest!
It’s worth checking out!
Han Xing drew his bowstring, preparing for battle.
But this time was different from before; between his fingers were two Iron Arrows.
[Skills: Double Arrow (can shoot two arrows simultaneously, with a five-second cooldown after activation.)]
Han Xing focused intently; at a time like this, he wouldn’t let his guard down.
When the cloud dissipated, three long green figures appeared inside.
Each of them was over two meters long, with bodies as thick as logs covered in green scales.
These physical traits indicated that these were three pythons.
[Jungle Green Python (One-Star Creature)]
[Level: 2]
[Power: 7, Agility: 8, Spirit: 5, Constitution: 6]
[Skills: Assault, Neurotoxin]
A One-Star Creature with two skills, and three of them appeared at once.
This was the most formidable wave of enemies Han Xing had faced since arriving in this world!
The three pythons, upon seeing Han Xing, immediately arched their bodies and sprang out like springs.
"Hiss!"
The Green Pythons made low hissing noises, and Han Xing could even see their wide-open mouths with the two curved venomous fangs in their upper and lower jaws.
Han Xing didn’t panic but instead aimed at his target.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The Double Arrow skill triggered, and two iron arrows were simultaneously released.
One of the Jungle Green Pythons was instantly pierced by an iron arrow, while the other was shot in the tail.
"Hiss!!!"
After being shot, the two Jungle Green Pythons recoiled in pain, raising their snake heads and letting out painful hisses.
But one python still managed to break through, crossing several meters in an instant and leaping onto Han Xing’s territory.
Han Xing frowned.
This was the first time he let a monster rush into his territory, the situation was a bit critical.
Suppressing his inner fear, he pulled an arrow from his backpack, preparing for a second wave of attacks.
The Jungle Green Python’s Agility Attribute was very high, and even with a backpack equipped, Han Xing just barely matched it.
In the next moment, the Green Python writhed its agile body, rapidly lunging towards Han Xing; the distance between them was less than two meters.
Han Xing took a deep breath, fixing his gaze on the open mouth of the Green Python.
Then, an underpowered Fine Iron Arrow launched directly.
"Puff!"
As the sound of penetration came, Han Xing’s face lit up.
He clearly saw this shot hit the Green Python’s throat, piercing through its mouth into the throat, then through the other side.
Armor Piercing!
Precision!
Both special effects triggered simultaneously, plus hitting a vital spot, this arrow’s damage was off the charts!
The Green Python was seriously injured, its massive body convulsing madly on the ground.
Without wasting time, after hitting that Green Python, Han Xing swiftly pulled out another arrow.
Aiming at the two Green Pythons already hit by his Double Arrow.
They were still trying to mimic the first python, rushing onto Han Xing’s territory.
Han Xing shot an arrow immediately.
Thud!
The Iron Arrow pinned down the fastest moving Green Python’s head, halting its advance.
With the increased Agility Attribute and the precision effect of the Longbow, Han Xing’s hit rate increased significantly.
Now, both Green Pythons were severely injured by his arrows, losing their combat abilities, and for the remaining one, there was naturally no suspense.
After the battle ended, a system prompt appeared.
[Defeated Jungle Green Python LV2*3, received 60 Experience Value, your Level has increased]
[Current Level: LV2]
"Leveled up!"
Han Xing clenched his fist, a bit excited.
He felt a surge of power from within his body, with all Attributes improving.
Looking at the panel, Agility increased by 2 points, Power by 1 point, and both Constitution and Spirit by 1 point each.
For a Hunter, the most important Attribute is Agility; including the backpack bonus, it finally reached double digits.
"Time to deal with the loot..."
Han Xing walked to the corpses of the three Green Pythons and began to disassemble them one by one.
[Successfully disassembled ’Jungle Green Python corpses’ *3, retrieved Fine Iron Arrow *7, received One-star Snake Hide *3, received Snake Meat 58kg, received Poisonous Venom Gallbladder *3...]

The items from the Green Python’s bodies were mediocre, but the 58 kilograms of snake meat replenished his food reserves to a full state again, and the three Poisonous Venom Gallbladders surprised Han Xing a bit.
[Poisonous Venom Gallbladder: Special material, seemingly some kind of Alchemy Material, can also be applied directly to weapons, adding a Neurotoxin Effect to them.]
"Interesting."
Han Xing looked at the three dark green, fist-sized Poisonous Venom Gallbladders on the ground,
which stated they can be directly applied to weapons, meaning his arrows can also gain toxin effects.
Truly deadly arrows, hitting anyone meant death.
After taking care of the three Green Pythons’ corpses, Han Xing turned his gaze towards the distant Sky Island.
It was a 3m*3m platform, with a bronze-colored treasure chest placed at its center.
"Bronze Treasure Chest!"
Han Xing exclaimed, feeling somewhat fortunate.
However, considering the security provided by three Level 2 Jungle Green Pythons, having a Bronze Treasure Chest inside was reasonable.
Han Xing walked to the front of the Bronze Treasure Chest, excitedly rubbing his hands.
"This is my first time opening a treasure chest, may the Emperor of Luck bless me, let it be something exquisite!"
"Blueprints, weapons, equipment will all do!"
With eager anticipation, Han Xing opened the treasure chest.
Right before his eyes, a dazzling array of materials appeared, and below them, he saw a white book!
[Items Acquired: Spirit Core *5, Refined Iron *9, Rare Earth *11, Drinking Water 300ml, Holy Light Healing (Holy Profession exclusive)]
"No way! It’s a Skill Book!"

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Water Crisis
paragraphs: [Skill Book Acquired: Holy Light Healing (Holy Profession Exclusive)]
Although it wasn’t a Hunter’s skill book, Han Xing remembered that Shen Yun seemed to choose the Holy Profession.
At this moment, someone suddenly private messaged him in the trading channel, saying they wanted to trade for his green longbow.
"Oh? Has someone finally got a green equipment blueprint?"
Han Xing opened the private message and found it was from someone named ’Clever Little Sheep’.
A piece of voice message appeared in the private chat window, and Han Xing clicked play.
"You... hello... I want to trade for your weapon, do you have a moment?"
It sounded like a young girl’s voice, soft and tender, yet natural, not affected; it seemed to be her original voice.
Han Xing replied, "I do, what are you planning to use to trade with me?"
Clever Little Sheep: "I... I see you need a green equipment blueprint, and I just happen to have one... should, should I show you?"
She seemed a little afraid of Han Xing, or maybe she didn’t know how to communicate with people properly.
"Send it to me to take a look," Han Xing said straightforwardly.
"Sure... okay..."
[Survivor ’Clever Little Sheep’ has sent you a trade request.]
Han Xing: "..."
"Weren’t you going to let me see the blueprint? Why are you directly initiating a trade?"
Clever Little Sheep quickly said, "Ah? Don’t you have to have the item to see its attributes?"
Han Xing: "..."
"What are you saying? If you give me the item, the trade is completed directly. If I run away with your stuff, who will you trade with?"
Clever Little Sheep: "???"
"No... won’t happen... you wouldn’t run away with my stuff, right?"
Han Xing found it ridiculous; this woman seemed to be a bit dense.
He really wanted to say, I would.
But after thinking about it, he said, "Forget it, put the item in the trading bar, let me check its attributes."
"Ah? Oh... okay!" Clever Little Sheep replied hesitantly.
Then, Han Xing saw a green blueprint added to the trading bar.
[Beast Hide Coat Blueprint (Green)]
Indeed, it was a green equipment blueprint, and it was a piece of clothing.
Han Xing instantly had the thought of acquiring it.
In the past, Han Xing usually would negotiate for a while, trying to make the other party offer more.
But considering this woman seemed a bit slow, he directly abandoned the idea.
Han Xing directly placed the refined longbow he had, then completed the trade.
[Beast Hide Coat Blueprint (Green) acquired, learn it?]
"Learn."
A fifth blueprint appeared in the blueprint section, and a slight smile of satisfaction appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
At this moment, Clever Little Sheep sent Han Xing a message.
"Th...thank you..."
Han Xing replied, "No need to thank me; we each get what we need. Next time, remember not to trade items so casually with others."
Clever Little Sheep: "Mm-mm! Thank you!"
After closing the private chat.
Han Xing’s expression changed, and he looked at the blueprint section again, feeling excited.
[Materials required to make the Beast Hide Coat: One-star Beast Hide*3, Spirit Core*20, Ether*50, Warrior Badge*1.]
The materials needed for the Beast Hide Coat were quite a lot, especially the three one-star beast hides. However, the three snakeskins he just had decomposed could substitute for them.
It also requires 20 Spirit Cores, 30 Ethers, and one Warrior Badge.
He had the first two types of materials, but Han Xing hadn’t heard of the ’Warrior Badge’.
So, he dove into the trading channel to search for relevant information.
Quickly, he found a survivor named ’Cola’, just happened to be selling a Warrior Badge, the condition was 500g of food.
The price was still acceptable, so Han Xing directly opened a private chat.
"500g of snake meat for a Warrior Badge."
In two seconds, Cola immediately responded, "Bro, I don’t need food anymore. Do you have water? Give me 400 ml, no, 300 ml will do!"
Han Xing checked his backpack’s drinking water; removing his own consumption, there were less than 600 ml left.
Come to think of it, after exploring for so long, he indeed hadn’t found much drinking water.
This was even with Han Xing’s constant exploration and fighting; other survivors could find even less water resources.
Han Xing estimated that everyone was likely in a severe state of water scarcity right now.
A glance at the trading channel indeed showed a lot of people changing their trade information to water.
The chat channel was also full of wailing.
"I’m so thirsty... so thirsty..."
"Me too; this world’s water resources are too scarce, like this, we’re all going to die of thirst!"
"Does anyone have water? I can’t hold on much longer..."
Han Xing suddenly remembered that while playing this game on his phone, he also faced a near-death situation due to water shortage, almost leading to game failure.
It was only after several difficult days that a sudden rain shower from the sky solved his subsequent water resource issue.
Han Xing didn’t know the situation in other regional channels, but at least for channel 107, it would take a heavy rain to solve the water problem completely.
However, how many could hold on until then?
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly told the survivor named Cola, "Bro, I don’t have much water here either; I can only give you 200 ml at most."
Han Xing had to consider himself; trading out 200 ml would just barely sustain him for another day.
He expected the other party would bargain with him, but surprisingly, Cola excitedly agreed, "Alright! 200 ml it is, let’s trade immediately!"
As if fearing Han Xing would go back on his word, the other quickly sent a trade request to Han Xing.
[Trade complete, you’ve acquired 1 Warrior Badge, and lost 200 ml of drinking water.]
Holding a leather badge in his hand, Han Xing pondered.
Meanwhile.
In a certain Sky Island Territory, Levi was looking grim while staring at the discussion group he had formed.
Many were opposing the decision he had just made.
As a major shareholder of the Lei Group, Levi stood and said, "Everyone, let me say something; our Lei Group is a big family. Once you’re part of us, we’re family."
"I know water resources are quite tight now. I’m asking you to hand them all over not to hoard but to distribute them fairly to our family members without, on the verge of dying from thirst."
"In these difficult times, our Lei Group must unite to overcome the challenges together."
"You must believe in my character, Levi; anyone contributing water now will be noted for their contributions, and you’ll be well-rewarded in the future."
There was a silence in the discussion group, and the atmosphere was somewhat awkward.

Then, a person named Chen Anjiang voiced, "President Lei, when you asked us to hand over materials, gear before, everyone complied, including quite some food. That was because everyone believed you could lead us to develop and survive."
"However, water now is our lifeblood, not even enough for ourselves..."

sentences.text: [Skill Book Acquired: Holy Light Healing (Holy Profession Exclusive)]
Although it wasn’t a Hunter’s skill book, Han Xing remembered that Shen Yun seemed to choose the Holy Profession.
At this moment, someone suddenly private messaged him in the trading channel, saying they wanted to trade for his green longbow.
"Oh?
Has someone finally got a green equipment blueprint?"
Han Xing opened the private message and found it was from someone named ’Clever Little Sheep’.
A piece of voice message appeared in the private chat window, and Han Xing clicked play.
"You... hello...
I want to trade for your weapon, do you have a moment?"
It sounded like a young girl’s voice, soft and tender, yet natural, not affected; it seemed to be her original voice.
Han Xing replied, "I do, what are you planning to use to trade with me?"
Clever Little Sheep: "I...
I see you need a green equipment blueprint, and I just happen to have one... should, should I show you?"
She seemed a little afraid of Han Xing, or maybe she didn’t know how to communicate with people properly.
"Send it to me to take a look," Han Xing said straightforwardly.
"Sure... okay..."
[Survivor ’Clever Little Sheep’ has sent you a trade request.]
Han Xing: "..."
"Weren’t you going to let me see the blueprint?
Why are you directly initiating a trade?"
Clever Little Sheep quickly said, "Ah?
Don’t you have to have the item to see its attributes?"
Han Xing: "..."
"What are you saying?
If you give me the item, the trade is completed directly.
If I run away with your stuff, who will you trade with?"
Clever Little Sheep: "???"
"No... won’t happen... you wouldn’t run away with my stuff, right?"
Han Xing found it ridiculous; this woman seemed to be a bit dense.
He really wanted to say, I would.
But after thinking about it, he said, "Forget it, put the item in the trading bar, let me check its attributes."
"Ah?
Oh... okay!" Clever Little Sheep replied hesitantly.
Then, Han Xing saw a green blueprint added to the trading bar.
[Beast Hide Coat Blueprint (Green)]
Indeed, it was a green equipment blueprint, and it was a piece of clothing.
Han Xing instantly had the thought of acquiring it.
In the past, Han Xing usually would negotiate for a while, trying to make the other party offer more.
But considering this woman seemed a bit slow, he directly abandoned the idea.
Han Xing directly placed the refined longbow he had, then completed the trade.
[Beast Hide Coat Blueprint (Green) acquired, learn it?]
"Learn."
A fifth blueprint appeared in the blueprint section, and a slight smile of satisfaction appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
At this moment, Clever Little Sheep sent Han Xing a message.
"Th...thank you..."
Han Xing replied, "No need to thank me; we each get what we need.
Next time, remember not to trade items so casually with others."
Clever Little Sheep: "Mm-mm!
Thank you!"
After closing the private chat.
Han Xing’s expression changed, and he looked at the blueprint section again, feeling excited.
[Materials required to make the Beast Hide Coat: One-star Beast Hide*3, Spirit Core*20, Ether*50, Warrior Badge*1.]
The materials needed for the Beast Hide Coat were quite a lot, especially the three one-star beast hides.
However, the three snakeskins he just had decomposed could substitute for them.
It also requires 20 Spirit Cores, 30 Ethers, and one Warrior Badge.
He had the first two types of materials, but Han Xing hadn’t heard of the ’Warrior Badge’.
So, he dove into the trading channel to search for relevant information.
Quickly, he found a survivor named ’Cola’, just happened to be selling a Warrior Badge, the condition was 500g of food.
The price was still acceptable, so Han Xing directly opened a private chat.
"500g of snake meat for a Warrior Badge."
In two seconds, Cola immediately responded, "Bro, I don’t need food anymore.
Do you have water?
Give me 400 ml, no, 300 ml will do!"
Han Xing checked his backpack’s drinking water; removing his own consumption, there were less than 600 ml left.
Come to think of it, after exploring for so long, he indeed hadn’t found much drinking water.
This was even with Han Xing’s constant exploration and fighting; other survivors could find even less water resources.
Han Xing estimated that everyone was likely in a severe state of water scarcity right now.
A glance at the trading channel indeed showed a lot of people changing their trade information to water.
The chat channel was also full of wailing.
"I’m so thirsty... so thirsty..."
"Me too; this world’s water resources are too scarce, like this, we’re all going to die of thirst!"
"Does anyone have water?
I can’t hold on much longer..."
Han Xing suddenly remembered that while playing this game on his phone, he also faced a near-death situation due to water shortage, almost leading to game failure.
It was only after several difficult days that a sudden rain shower from the sky solved his subsequent water resource issue.
Han Xing didn’t know the situation in other regional channels, but at least for channel 107, it would take a heavy rain to solve the water problem completely.
However, how many could hold on until then?
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly told the survivor named Cola, "Bro, I don’t have much water here either; I can only give you 200 ml at most."
Han Xing had to consider himself; trading out 200 ml would just barely sustain him for another day.
He expected the other party would bargain with him, but surprisingly, Cola excitedly agreed, "Alright!
200 ml it is, let’s trade immediately!"
As if fearing Han Xing would go back on his word, the other quickly sent a trade request to Han Xing.
[Trade complete, you’ve acquired 1 Warrior Badge, and lost 200 ml of drinking water.]
Holding a leather badge in his hand, Han Xing pondered.
Meanwhile.
In a certain Sky Island Territory, Levi was looking grim while staring at the discussion group he had formed.
Many were opposing the decision he had just made.
As a major shareholder of the Lei Group, Levi stood and said, "Everyone, let me say something; our Lei Group is a big family.
Once you’re part of us, we’re family."
"I know water resources are quite tight now.
I’m asking you to hand them all over not to hoard but to distribute them fairly to our family members without, on the verge of dying from thirst."
"In these difficult times, our Lei Group must unite to overcome the challenges together."
"You must believe in my character, Levi; anyone contributing water now will be noted for their contributions, and you’ll be well-rewarded in the future."
There was a silence in the discussion group, and the atmosphere was somewhat awkward.
Then, a person named Chen Anjiang voiced, "President Lei, when you asked us to hand over materials, gear before, everyone complied, including quite some food.
That was because everyone believed you could lead us to develop and survive."
"However, water now is our lifeblood, not even enough for ourselves..."

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Fallen Ones’ Camp
paragraphs: Chen Anjiang’s meaning was clear to everyone; he didn’t want to turn over the water resources.

Levi was somewhat displeased but forced his tone and said, "Chen Anjiang, I remember you were the manager of the Operations Department at our Lei Group before, right? You’ve been with me for so many years, and yet you still don’t believe in my character?"

Chen Anjiang seemed not to intend to hide any longer and directly said, "President Lei, when you asked us to turn over food, you also said that resources would be shared. But when we asked you to list the details of the offered materials, you were unwilling."

"To be honest, President Lei, we’ve privately calculated the accounts. After deducting the food distributed to the brothers, there are still at least dozens of units of food resources in your hands. Why not exchange these things for water to help everyone through the crisis?"
Chen Anjiang’s words exposed Levi’s secrets completely.

Levi was not a person with a good temper. Seeing Chen Anjiang giving no face, he angrily said, "Chen Anjiang, you heartless and ungrateful bastard, what nonsense are you spewing here!? If you refuse to contribute the resources, then get out of our discussion group and stop spouting nonsense here. The Lei Group will not welcome you in the future either!"
The atmosphere in the discussion group became very oppressive.

Before this, Levi’s threatening methods had always been effective. Others in the discussion group were also angry but dared not speak up, as nobody wanted to detach from the group in this unfamiliar world.
Nevertheless, the situation had already changed.
A moment later, a message notification appeared.
[Chen Anjiang has left the discussion group...]
Not only that, but Chen Anjiang’s departure seemed to trigger a chain reaction.
Wang Peng, Liu Feirui, Zhang Yamin...
One familiar name after another departed the discussion group.
Levi’s expression was as dark as could be, seeming to drip water, as the discussion group fell silent; no one dared to speak.
Similar situations unfolded in many teams both big and small.
When it truly comes to life and death, who cares if you’re a president or a manager?
The sky is vast, and one’s own life is paramount.
The teams formed by those people are extremely fragile in the face of crisis.
The chat channels even saw battles of insults unfold among multiple parties, leading to chaotic situations.
Han Xing watched their quarreling, amused.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly sent a message in the discussion group.
"Guys, try to conserve water; I see people on the chat channel are going crazy fighting over just a little water."
"I still have 800 milliliters of water here. If anyone is lacking, just speak up; hang in there, and let’s endure this tough time together."
Shen Yun then said, "I still have five or six hundred milliliters, no problem getting through today; how about you, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing replied, "I’ve got a few hundred milliliters left too, don’t worry about me; just conserve what you have."
The two agreed solemnly, encouraging each other.
Then, Han Xing found Shen Yun and traded the newly acquired skill book with him.
[Holy Light Healing], as the sole healing skill for the Holy Profession early on, could be life-saving at a critical moment.
Shen Yun naturally understood the value of this skill book and expressed deep gratitude.
Han Xing closed the discussion group.
He saw the badge attributes he had just traded for.
[Warrior Badge: A badge awarded by a certain tribe to warriors of the tribe, increases strength attribute by +1 when worn]
"There’s even an attribute effect?"
Han Xing was somewhat surprised; he initially thought it was simply a regular crafting material, not expecting this pleasant surprise.
At this moment, the materials to craft the Green Beast Hide Cloak were gathered, and Han Xing directly clicked to craft.
A green light flashed before his eyes, and a thirty-second progress bar appeared.
When the progress bar finished, the system notification appeared.
[Successfully crafted Beast Hide Cloak (Green)]
[Beast Hide Cloak (Green)], Quality - Refined, Defense 3~5, Strength +1 (Warrior Badge granted), Agility +2, Attached Effect - Basic Magic Resistance.
[Basic Magic Resistance: Reduces magic damage received by 10% during spell damage.]
"Nice attributes!" Han Xing sincerely praised.
He equipped it directly.
In the next moment, Han Xing suddenly felt a cold leather coat on his shoulders.
This coat was made from the Jungle Green Python’s skin, so the surface was covered in green scales.
At the chest area, a leather badge was sewn, bearing the image of an ancient tree.
Although it looked somewhat intimidating, wearing it filled Han Xing with a sense of safety.
With the equipment ready, Han Xing decided to continue exploring.
In front of him were two clouds, one large and one small.
The large one was about the size of a helipad, roughly estimated to be at least thirty square meters, even bigger than Han Xing’s territory.
The small one was only five or six square meters.
Han Xing eyed the smaller cloud.
However, when he passed near the large cloud, he seemed to faintly hear the sound of flowing water.
"Is there water?"
Han Xing immediately stopped and listened closely.
Gurgle gurgle...
"There’s water for sure!"
Han Xing confirmed he didn’t mishear; the sounds within the cloud suggested the presence of fresh water, and in considerable quantity!
He attempted to approach, triggering a system notification.
"Inside there’s a group of fallen beings conducting some sort of evil ritual, attempting to summon an ancient entity... Do you want to enter?"
Fallen beings? Summoning ritual?
From the system’s notification, Han Xing detected a hint of unusual information.
In other words, there might be unforeseen risks inside.
Nonetheless, while Han Xing sensed danger within the cloud, it wasn’t as intense as anticipated.
Currently, he was caught in a dilemma.
Undoubtedly, water was the most critical resource for nearly ten thousand survivors on channel 107, including Han Xing himself, even surpassing food in urgency.
In the trading channel, water was priced ridiculously high, with various equipment and blueprints listed.
Anyone who possessed water effectively held decision-making power over the entire trading arena.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, finally gritting his teeth and saying, "Let’s do it!"
"If I manage to take over this place, I shouldn’t have to worry about drinking water for a while!"
"Moreover, if the resources are ample, I might even go on a spree buying various materials and equipment from the trading channel, laying the foundation for future development!"
With these thoughts, Han Xing took a deep breath and clicked ’enter.’"
The mist dissipated, revealing several humanoid figures inside.
Long ears, slender limbs, and that dark skin, these characteristics made Han Xing instantly recognize them.
"Dark Elves!"

Legends say that hundreds of years ago, the strongest race in this world was the Elf Race. With the support of a sacred artifact among the tribe, they collected countless fragments of the world and forged a vast continent.
Numerous members of the Elf Race thrived and multiplied on that continent, with a grand civilization rising.

But this prosperous scene didn’t last long. Later, due to certain reasons and several significant historical events, the Elf Race lost their sacred artifact, with countless elves dying in horrifying wars.
Until a pivotal historical turning point, the Elf Continent was ravaged by war and collapsed directly.
To survive, some elves chose to sacrifice themselves to the Abyss, giving rise to the Fallen Elf tribe, known as Dark Elves.
These background stories were something Han Xing heard while playing ’Sky Island Paradise’ from NPCs at random, with their authenticity open to examination.
At this moment, Han Xing refocused his attention on the impending battle.
Dark Elves are a group of evil, extremist beings harboring intense hatred towards all things in the world.
Thus, upon spotting Han Xing, the group of Dark Elves immediately grabbed different weapons, including magic staffs, bows and arrows, big hammers, longswords...
"It’s a Human!"
"Don’t let him disrupt the Monarch’s descent."
"Kill him!"

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Fierce Battle with the Dark Elves!
paragraphs: The Dark Elves charged towards Han Xing.
Their expressions were fierce, their mouths uttering a series of complex syllables, but strangely, Han Xing could actually understand what they were saying.
At this moment, Han Xing was counting silently in his heart.
"One... two..."
A total of six Dark Elves.
Among them, one Dark Elf Hunter, two Dark Elf Mages, plus two Dark Elf Warriors, and an additional Dark Elf Saint.
This configuration is extremely formidable, and as of now, no human survivor could withstand two rounds against this group of Dark Elves.
Han Xing took a deep breath.
If it were a direct confrontation, he would also not be a match for so many Dark Elves.
But he knew what his advantage was; it was his attack power far exceeding others of the same level!
Compared to wild monsters, the Dark Elves’ defense was noticeably weaker.
Moreover, this group of Dark Elves lacked cooperation, which gave Han Xing an opportunity.
The next moment, the two arrows that had been prepared for a long time shot out instantly.
Double Arrow!
Charged Strong Strike!
Swoosh! Swoosh!
The two Dark Elf Warriors rushing forward first seemed to not expect that this weak human would suddenly burst with such formidable strength, the speed of the arrows too fast for them to react.
But it must be said, these Dark Elf Warriors had very rich combat experience, and in an instant, they made the correct choice in their hearts, which was to sidestep and dodge!
The next moment, the fine iron arrows tinged with green hit their targets.
One of the Dark Elf Warriors was hit in the shoulder, while the other was hit in the abdomen.
Luckily, neither was a vital point.
The two Dark Elf Warriors felt a sense of narrow escape from death, then they looked angrily at Han Xing.
"Damn human! I’m going to chop your head off and use it as a chamber pot!"
However, at this moment, a smirk appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
These two guys thought that avoiding vital points meant they’d be fine?
Little did they know, his iron arrows were pre-coated with Green Python Poison...
Now, the neurotoxin was entering their bodies through the wounds, starting to exert its toxicity.
Sure enough, the next moment, the two Dark Elf Warriors’ expressions changed.
They suddenly felt a tingling sensation from their wounds; the surrounding flesh quickly turning black and purple, starting to spread.
The two Dark Elf Warriors were filled with fear, shouting loudly, "Cunning human! You coated the arrows with poison..."
The weapons in their hands fell with a clatter, losing combat effectiveness.
At this time, a wooden arrow and a fireball simultaneously shot towards Han Xing from afar,
It was the Dark Elf Hunter and Mage, who had completed charging their attacks while Han Xing dealt with the two Dark Elf Warriors.
The two attacks rapidly enlarged before him, and the angles were tricky.
In the critical moment, Han Xing suddenly ducked his head.
The wooden arrow whizzed past overhead, but there was no avoiding the fireball attack.
Pow!
A blast sounded, the fireball exploded in front of Han Xing’s chest, charring his python hide cloak black.
The impact of the explosion caused him to roll back several meters.
Han Xing quickly propped himself up, secretly relieved.
Fortunately, he crafted this beast hide cloak before entering the battle.
Otherwise, just that fireball would have been enough to seriously injure him!
Swoosh!
As he got up, the bow and arrow in Han Xing’s hands released another arrow.
The Dark Elf Mage who had just launched the fireball attack seemed not to have expected Han Xing’s counterattack to come so quickly.
Even as the arrow pierced through his forehead and out the back, he hadn’t reacted.
The body of this Dark Elf Mage dropped limply to the ground.
The remaining Dark Elves glared angrily, wanting nothing more than to butcher Han Xing.
"My Holy Light..."
The Dark Elf Saint raised his wooden hammer high, gathering some kind of light, seemingly intending to heal the two Dark Elf Warriors and dispel the poison in their bodies.
However, Han Xing wasn’t about to let him have his way.
When life is threatened, humans can unleash unprecedented potential, just like Han Xing in his current battle state.
His mind was working swiftly, keeping an eye on the long-range attacks from distant Dark Elves while focusing on his skill panel.
At this time, the five-second cooldown for Double Arrow had passed.
He quickly grabbed two arrows in his hand, drawing the bowstring.
"Go!" Han Xing shouted softly!
Thud! Thud!
The arrows hit the body of the Dark Elf Saint, who was wearing wooden plate armor, but against Han Xing’s formidable attack power, this armor was as fragile as paper.
Both arrows penetrated, and the Dark Elf Saint perished.
Instant kill!
This was Han Xing’s current formidable attack power.
With 12 agility points, 9 power points, and a rare quality green longbow, he had the strength to instantly kill level 2 monsters.
In a flash, four Dark Elves had lost combat ability.
On the field, one Dark Elf Mage and one Dark Elf Hunter remained, still holding their ground, seemingly stunned.
These two Dark Elves hadn’t expected the battle situation to change so quickly. From a position of overwhelming advantage, it had been overturned by this human Hunter in an instant!
This human’s capability and reaction speed had exceeded their expectations entirely!
When Han Xing’s eagle-like gaze swept over, these ferocious Dark Elves instinctively took a step back.
But the ingrained hatred in their bones once again robbed them of reason.
"Human... die!"
The two Dark Elves launched an attack simultaneously.
But Han Xing’s bow and arrow were faster.
At the cost of taking another attack from the Dark Elf Mage, Han Xing shot an arrow that struck the Dark Elf Hunter.
At this point, there was no longer any suspense in the battle.
When the last remaining Dark Elf Mage fell, the battle was over, and the system notification arrived.
[Killed Dark Elf *6, gained 120 experience points.]
[You destroyed a small Dark Elf territory, Elf Race affinity +1.]
At this moment, Han Xing sat on the ground, panting heavily.
The battle just now seemed brief, but it had massively drained his physical strength and spiritual power.
He felt as if his body was close to exhaustion.
"Elf Race affinity? What’s that supposed to mean?"
When Han Xing played on his phone, there was no mention of such an affinity.
"Could it be a new feature unique to this world?"
Standing up, Han Xing looked at the wreckage of the battle around him and breathed a sigh of relief: "As dangerous as it was, it was all worth it!"
He approached the corpses of the Dark Elves and attempted to dismantle them.
But the system gave him a different prompt.
[Humanoid creatures cannot be dismantled. (Tip: You might find unexpected surprises by searching them.)]
Cannot dismantle? Does the last sentence mean he can loot the corpses?
Han Xing thought for a moment and then understood.
After all, Dark Elves resemble the Human Race too much; even if they were broken down into various pieces of meat and human tissues, he wouldn’t dare to consume them.
So, he began crouching down, searching the bodies of the Dark Elves.

Double Arrow!
Charged Strong Strike!
Swoosh!
Swoosh!
The two Dark Elf Warriors rushing forward first seemed to not expect that this weak human would suddenly burst with such formidable strength, the speed of the arrows too fast for them to react.
But it must be said, these Dark Elf Warriors had very rich combat experience, and in an instant, they made the correct choice in their hearts, which was to sidestep and dodge!
The next moment, the fine iron arrows tinged with green hit their targets.
One of the Dark Elf Warriors was hit in the shoulder, while the other was hit in the abdomen.
Luckily, neither was a vital point.
The two Dark Elf Warriors felt a sense of narrow escape from death, then they looked angrily at Han Xing.
"Damn human!
I’m going to chop your head off and use it as a chamber pot!"
However, at this moment, a smirk appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
These two guys thought that avoiding vital points meant they’d be fine?
Little did they know, his iron arrows were pre-coated with Green Python Poison...
Now, the neurotoxin was entering their bodies through the wounds, starting to exert its toxicity.
Sure enough, the next moment, the two Dark Elf Warriors’ expressions changed.
They suddenly felt a tingling sensation from their wounds; the surrounding flesh quickly turning black and purple, starting to spread.
The two Dark Elf Warriors were filled with fear, shouting loudly, "Cunning human!
You coated the arrows with poison..."
The weapons in their hands fell with a clatter, losing combat effectiveness.
At this time, a wooden arrow and a fireball simultaneously shot towards Han Xing from afar,
It was the Dark Elf Hunter and Mage, who had completed charging their attacks while Han Xing dealt with the two Dark Elf Warriors.
The two attacks rapidly enlarged before him, and the angles were tricky.
In the critical moment, Han Xing suddenly ducked his head.
The wooden arrow whizzed past overhead, but there was no avoiding the fireball attack.
Pow!
A blast sounded, the fireball exploded in front of Han Xing’s chest, charring his python hide cloak black.
The impact of the explosion caused him to roll back several meters.
Han Xing quickly propped himself up, secretly relieved.
Fortunately, he crafted this beast hide cloak before entering the battle.
Otherwise, just that fireball would have been enough to seriously injure him!
Swoosh!
As he got up, the bow and arrow in Han Xing’s hands released another arrow.
The Dark Elf Mage who had just launched the fireball attack seemed not to have expected Han Xing’s counterattack to come so quickly.
Even as the arrow pierced through his forehead and out the back, he hadn’t reacted.
The body of this Dark Elf Mage dropped limply to the ground.
The remaining Dark Elves glared angrily, wanting nothing more than to butcher Han Xing.
"My Holy Light..."
The Dark Elf Saint raised his wooden hammer high, gathering some kind of light, seemingly intending to heal the two Dark Elf Warriors and dispel the poison in their bodies.
However, Han Xing wasn’t about to let him have his way.
When life is threatened, humans can unleash unprecedented potential, just like Han Xing in his current battle state.
His mind was working swiftly, keeping an eye on the long-range attacks from distant Dark Elves while focusing on his skill panel.
At this time, the five-second cooldown for Double Arrow had passed.
He quickly grabbed two arrows in his hand, drawing the bowstring.
"Go!" Han Xing shouted softly!
Thud!
Thud!
The arrows hit the body of the Dark Elf Saint, who was wearing wooden plate armor, but against Han Xing’s formidable attack power, this armor was as fragile as paper.
Both arrows penetrated, and the Dark Elf Saint perished.
Instant kill!
This was Han Xing’s current formidable attack power.
With 12 agility points, 9 power points, and a rare quality green longbow, he had the strength to instantly kill level 2 monsters.
In a flash, four Dark Elves had lost combat ability.
On the field, one Dark Elf Mage and one Dark Elf Hunter remained, still holding their ground, seemingly stunned.
These two Dark Elves hadn’t expected the battle situation to change so quickly.
From a position of overwhelming advantage, it had been overturned by this human Hunter in an instant!
This human’s capability and reaction speed had exceeded their expectations entirely!
When Han Xing’s eagle-like gaze swept over, these ferocious Dark Elves instinctively took a step back.
But the ingrained hatred in their bones once again robbed them of reason.
"Human... die!"
The two Dark Elves launched an attack simultaneously.
But Han Xing’s bow and arrow were faster.
At the cost of taking another attack from the Dark Elf Mage, Han Xing shot an arrow that struck the Dark Elf Hunter.
At this point, there was no longer any suspense in the battle.
When the last remaining Dark Elf Mage fell, the battle was over, and the system notification arrived.
[Killed Dark Elf *6, gained 120 experience points.]
[You destroyed a small Dark Elf territory, Elf Race affinity +1.]
At this moment, Han Xing sat on the ground, panting heavily.
The battle just now seemed brief, but it had massively drained his physical strength and spiritual power.
He felt as if his body was close to exhaustion.
"Elf Race affinity?
What’s that supposed to mean?"
When Han Xing played on his phone, there was no mention of such an affinity.
"Could it be a new feature unique to this world?"
Standing up, Han Xing looked at the wreckage of the battle around him and breathed a sigh of relief: "As dangerous as it was, it was all worth it!"
He approached the corpses of the Dark Elves and attempted to dismantle them.
But the system gave him a different prompt.
[Humanoid creatures cannot be dismantled. (Tip: You might find unexpected surprises by searching them.)]
Cannot dismantle?
Does the last sentence mean he can loot the corpses?
Han Xing thought for a moment and then understood.
After all, Dark Elves resemble the Human Race too much; even if they were broken down into various pieces of meat and human tissues, he wouldn’t dare to consume them.
So, he began crouching down, searching the bodies of the Dark Elves.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: The Horror Descends!
paragraphs: Han Xing felt his way around the corpses of these Dark Elves one by one.
[Acquired Damaged Wooden Plate Armor (White) *1, Acquired Wooden Hammer (White) *1, Acquired Spirit Core *1, Acquired Fallen Blood *1...]
[Acquired Damaged Wooden Staff, Acquired Spirit Core, Acquired Wooden Bow, Acquired Fallen Blood *1...]
These Dark Elves didn’t have much worth taking, aside from some Whiteboard Equipment, a few Spirit Cores, and a drop of peculiar blood.
"Fallen Blood? What’s this thing?"
Seeing the few drops of bluish-black blood newly added to his backpack, Han Xing felt puzzled.
But the material had no annotations, so he decided to put it aside for now.
Han Xing continued to rummage through the corpses. When he reached the final Dark Elf, the Mage he had shot through the head with an arrow, his eyes suddenly lit up.
He found a booklet in the waist pouch of this Dark Elf.
[Skill Book: Fireball Technique.]
"It’s actually a Mage’s Skill Book!"
Han Xing was instantly thrilled.
As Mages have been permanent professions in many games on Blue Star, at the start, they made quite a few people fall into traps unwittingly.
In their imagination, Mages are beings capable of controlling lightning and fire, calling forth wind and rain.
But they quickly realized that this Mage was not at all what they imagined.
In the early stages, human survivors other than having a standard Air Burst Skill, had no other means of attack.
Only when they learned their first skill could they perform basic Elemental Attacks, and at that point, the damage level increased several tiers.
Therefore, Fireball Technique and Ice Arrow Skill are skills that Mages desperately need in the early stages.
This Fireball Technique Skill Book, once placed in the trading channel, would definitely attract many Mages scrambling for it.
Of course, the Skill Book was just an unexpected delight.
Han Xing’s initial target was the possible water source in this Dark Elf territory.
Upon closer inspection, right in the middle of this 5 meters by 6 meters platform, there was a puddle the size of a table.
Estimates showed it was at least four square meters.
Although the depth was less than forty centimeters, a quick calculation showed it contained at least over 1500 liters of water!
Yes, 1500 liters, not milliliters!
Han Xing felt his breathing becoming somewhat heavy.
"This is huge... I’m going to be rich this time..."
This much water, how long would it be enough for him to drink?
If taken to the trading channel, how much resource could it be exchanged for?
Han Xing could hardly imagine!
However, after the excitement subsided, Han Xing felt something unusual about this water pool.
The water surface was bubbling and occasionally black smoke rose up.
Han Xing suddenly remembered the system seemed to give a hint before entering.
This group of Dark Elves seemed to be summoning something.
Could it be that this pool is their summoning medium?
Looking closer, the system prompt indeed appeared.
[Spiritual Spring Water polluted by Dark Aura, no longer drinkable.]
Han Xing’s throbbing heart instantly turned to disappointment.
However, the feeling of disappointment didn’t last long, because suddenly, dense black mist began to rise from the pool and spread quickly around.
"There’s something strange!" Han Xing took several steps back sharply.
Immediately, a second system prompt appeared.
[The Dark Elves’ evil ritual is reaching its end, a powerful being from the Abyss has been summoned, human survivor, two choices now stand before you.]
[1: Continue to invest "Fallen Blood" in the ritual, completing the summoning ceremony.]
[2: Invest Spirit Core into the ritual to purify the Dark Aura from the Spiritual Spring Water.]
[Please make your choice quickly.]
"Summoning ritual or purification?" Han Xing furrowed his brow.
Having played Sky Island Paradise for a period, he quickly realized he might have triggered a side quest.
And merely from the introduction, this side quest sounded quite significant.
Han Xing knew his next choice would likely dictate the quest’s direction.
"Abyss... powerful being." Han Xing contemplated the system’s cue.
At that moment, the black smoke emitted from the ground spring became increasingly dense, spreading rapidly.
Han Xing was unsure what kind of being the first option’s summoning would bring forth.
But given the circumstances, for safety’s sake, he immediately made up his mind.
"I choose, option 2, purification!"
The system prompt displayed a series of ellipses.
An ominous feeling suddenly surged within Han Xing, a sight he had never experienced before.
"System, what’s wrong... speak up... you’re scaring me!" Han Xing shouted with trembling voice.
At that moment, he suddenly saw the Dark Elf corpses on the ground disappear without a trace after being enveloped in black smoke.
The next moment, the system prompt before him sent his heart plummeting to rock bottom.
[Summoning ceremony complete, Great Demon Monarch Julius is about to descend...]
"What!?" Han Xing had a face full of bewilderment.
Simultaneously, a dreadful murmur and whispering sound began to ring in his ears.
Hatred, anger, fear, malice...
Various negative emotions rushed into Han Xing’s mind like a tide.
He only felt his head about to burst, his vision growing increasingly dark. He even saw the silhouettes of countless Vengeful Spirits, weeping despairingly.
Torn space,
Heart-piercing wailing,
The mental barrier was easily shredded at this moment.
"Fuck..."
Han Xing cradled his head, struggling to remain conscious.
"No... must leave here quickly..."
"Otherwise, will truly die..."
Han Xing took a deep breath, gathering his last ounce of spirit, steering his territory away from here.
However, when he unintentionally glanced backward, his heart sank completely.
From that black smoke-emitting spring emerged a towering white bone horn.
Merely showing a tiny tip of the horn, Han Xing already found his breathing difficult.
Powerful aura began to spread.
At this moment, the sky over hundreds of kilometers seemed to darken, evil aura staining all the clouds black.
Under this fearsome force, Han Xing felt insignificant.
Then he heard a burst of wild laughter.
"Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha!"
"After three thousand five hundred years, finally, the illustrious Great Demon Monarch is coming out again from damnable Land of the Abyss!"
"Wretched Elves, weep, wail, I will make you relive the fear and pain of the past! Ha ha ha ha!"
Rumble!
Han Xing felt the ground of his territory shaking constantly, as if something was about to break through the earth.
At this point, the terrible existence revealed a complete horn.
The horn reached nearly twenty meters in length and about two meters thick. Just from this colossal horn, one could see how enormous this creature was.
The dreadful existence continued its rampant laughter, dark aura growing ever denser.
Death’s shadow consumed him entirely!
At this moment, only two words sprang forth in Han Xing’s mind.
It’s over...

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Great Demon Monarch
paragraphs: The demon’s laughter penetrated straight into his mind, and the scent of death was spreading continuously.
Han Xing clenched his teeth, desperately controlling the Sky Island to flee.
Before him, the massive white bone horn trembled slightly, and the demon sneered, "Ha, there’s actually a puny Human Race here. Fine, I’ll make you the first blood sacrifice for this king’s descent!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s face changed dramatically, the white bone horn quivered violently, the demon was about to descend!
Just when he thought he was surely doomed, the trembling of the white bone horn abruptly halted.
Han Xing was stunned, the scene now was like the calm before the storm, oppressive and terrifying.
He thought the other side was brewing something and had already prepared to face the demon head-on.
However, after waiting a few seconds, the terrifying presence remained unmoving.
"Hmm?"
Han Xing clearly felt something was off.
He looked up, at the horn pointing skyward, at least twenty meters high, and in his mind, he estimated the size of the fearsome being below.
According to calculations, the size of this demon, just in height, would not be less than a hundred meters.
In comparison to its huge body, the four-square-meter summoning array on the ground seemed entirely out of place.
It was like a human sticking an arm into a small pipe, trying foolishly to emerge from it.
At that moment, Han Xing had a strange guess in his heart.
"Could this guy be stuck?"
Han Xing unknowingly voiced his thoughts aloud.
The demon horn, originally motionless, suddenly trembled upon hearing Han Xing’s words.
The demon sneered, "Hmph, insignificant human, how could you possibly understand the greatness of the Great Demon Monarch!"
Hearing the demon’s response, Han Xing was convinced in his heart that it was indeed stuck...
The ever-present sense of doom in his heart dissipated completely at this moment.
Han Xing’s lips twitched a few times, then he couldn’t help but burst into loud laughter.
"Haha! Hahaha! I’m dying of laughter!"
"This is the first time I’ve heard of a demon getting stuck in a summoning array, it’s killing me, hahaha!"
Han Xing laughed so hard that he doubled over, "You’re really embarrassing the Demon Race..."
"Human! Shut up! Or I’ll crush you like a bug!" the Great Demon Monarch shouted angrily.
However, Han Xing was already certain that this demon couldn’t get out, so he was even more unrestrained.
"I’m just saying, I’m just saying, so embarrassing! Hahaha!"
Han Xing, hands on hips, jeered while letting out unrestrained laughter.
"Damn it!" The Great Demon Monarch seemed to be breaking down a bit from his laughter, angrily said, "Human, don’t let me catch you, or I’ll imprison your soul in the Abyss for eternal suffering!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s laughter suddenly stopped.
He wasn’t scared by the Great Demon Monarch’s threat, but instead, he turned his eyes glaring, "Damn, you embarrassing thing, you still dare to threaten me?"
"Your name is Julius, right? Just wait! I’m going to record this scene and tell everyone that a dignified Great Demon Monarch got stuck in a summoning array!"
"And, I’ll tell the Elves too!" Han Xing threatened.
Every survivor’s system interface came with recording and photographing functions, Han Xing indeed had started recording when the demon descended.
"Don’t tell the Elves! Those lowly beings don’t deserve to see this Monarch!" The Great Demon Monarch, a bit panicked, quickly said.
"You say ’don’t tell,’ so I won’t? I’m telling the Elves!" Han Xing resolutely insisted.
The Great Demon Monarch seemed to be quite vexed by this human, a moment later, he sighed and said, "Alright, human, you win."
"State your conditions."
Han Xing was taken aback but immediately understood the meaning behind the other’s words.
This guy wants to use benefits to shut him up?
Darn it, am I, Han Xing, that kind of person?
He was very indignant, righteously declared, "I’m telling you, don’t think you can sway me with benefits!"
"Unless, you give me blueprints! A massive amount of Divine Artifact Equipment blueprints!"
The Great Demon Monarch on the opposite side was also a bit stunned, a moment later, he asked, "The Divine Artifacts you speak of, are those toys crafted by the Dwarfs?"
Han Xing looked puzzled; he didn’t quite understand the world’s background, so he replied, "Probably... yes?"

The Great Demon Monarch sneered disdainfully, "Those toys crafted by the Dwarfs are nothing compared to our Abyssal Magical Artifacts. Moreover, the strongest aspect of us Demon Race is our own flesh bodies; we disdain using such things, so I don’t have the blueprints you desire."
"You don’t?" Han Xing continued to ask, "Then what conditions are you still talking about with me?"
"Farewell, I’ll just go spread the recording among the Elf Race."
Having said that, he directly turned around, about to leave.
In fact, Han Xing didn’t want to entangle with this guy any longer; after all, this guy was quite terrifying.
With this being’s immense power, he could probably kill him thousands of times with just a slight release of power.

Feeling that Han Xing’s presence was gradually departing, the Great Demon Monarch became a bit anxious; he hurriedly yelled, "Human Race, come back! You can tell others if you wish, but first, help me cancel the summoning ritual before you leave!"
Yet, Han Xing turned a deaf ear.
It was then that the Great Demon Monarch finally said, "Human Race, as long as you help me remove the summoning ritual, I can directly give you a drop of Demon Blood!"
Still, Han Xing pretended not to hear.
He didn’t know what Demon Blood was anyway.
The Great Demon Monarch became even more anxious, "I also have a Great Sword that I used, and right, I also picked up an Exotic Beast Egg in the Alternate Space just now, which I can give to you!"
Finally, Han Xing stopped, and when he turned around, a system prompt appeared before him.
[You have triggered an additional side quest, the Great Demon Monarch’s Request.]

[Quest Introduction: The Great Demon Monarch is trapped in an alternate space, unable to invade your world. Only by canceling the summoning ritual can he return to the abyss. Noble Julius is now bowing his head, requesting you to aid his escape.]
[Quest Rewards: ’Demon Blood’, ’Demon Monarch’s Greatsword’, ’Unknown Beast Egg’, choose one of the three.]
[Please note, this quest is not system-issued, survivors please be cautious and verify task information.]
"I actually triggered a quest?"
Han Xing’s eyes flickered; he had always been wary of this creature, thinking it was deliberately luring him closer.
Now he realized that the Demon Monarch seemed genuinely stuck.
The current situation for the other party was very awkward, unable to enter Han Xing’s world nor return to his abyss territory.
At the same time, Han Xing also examined the attributes of the three quest rewards.

[Demon Blood: Heart blood of a high-level demon, merge with it to change to a demon bloodline, granting powerful Power of the Demon, all attributes increased tenfold, upgrade attributes tripled, automatic transition to the hidden Profession, Demon Hunter.]

[Demon Monarch’s Greatsword (Red), Abyssal Magical Artifact, Quality - Epic, Attack Power 10784~15462, All Attributes +3333, Attached Effect - Dominion (Wielding this weapon, demon race creatures below high-level demon rank will be unable to harm you), Attached Effect - Judgment (As a high-level demon, you have supreme authority, dealing triple damage to creatures ranked below you), Attached Effect - Demonic Flame (Upon attack hit, applies a lasting 10s demonic flame burning effect), Attached Effect...]
Equipment Requirement: Level 60.
[Unknown Beast Egg: Attributes unknown, race unknown, but capable of traversing through alternate space, seems to possess a portion of Void abilities.]
"Hiss..."
Seeing the quest rewards, Han Xing sharply inhaled a breath of cold air.
Not because of anything else, but because the attributes of each of these three reward items are simply too overpowered...
Among them, Demon Blood seems to be an item related to a hidden profession. Just by merging with it, one can directly transition into a powerful Demon Hunter.
The Demon Monarch’s Greatsword is even more extraordinary, apparently the sword wielded by this demon, and its attributes are incredibly formidable!
As for the final Exotic Beast Egg.
The system’s explanation is somewhat vague, but without a doubt, anything that catches the eye of the Great Demon Monarch must be exceptional.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the sky-piercing horn, finally stirred!
