I’m going to record this scene and tell everyone that a dignified Great Demon Monarch got stuck in a summoning array!"
"And, I’ll tell the Elves too!" Han Xing threatened.
Every survivor’s system interface came with recording and photographing functions, Han Xing indeed had started recording when the demon descended.
"Don’t tell the Elves!
Those lowly beings don’t deserve to see this Monarch!" The Great Demon Monarch, a bit panicked, quickly said.
"You say ’don’t tell,’ so I won’t?
I’m telling the Elves!" Han Xing resolutely insisted.
The Great Demon Monarch seemed to be quite vexed by this human, a moment later, he sighed and said, "Alright, human, you win."
"State your conditions."
Han Xing was taken aback but immediately understood the meaning behind the other’s words.
This guy wants to use benefits to shut him up?
Darn it, am I, Han Xing, that kind of person?
He was very indignant, righteously declared, "I’m telling you, don’t think you can sway me with benefits!"
"Unless, you give me blueprints!
A massive amount of Divine Artifact Equipment blueprints!"
The Great Demon Monarch on the opposite side was also a bit stunned, a moment later, he asked, "The Divine Artifacts you speak of, are those toys crafted by the Dwarfs?"
Han Xing looked puzzled; he didn’t quite understand the world’s background, so he replied, "Probably... yes?"
The Great Demon Monarch sneered disdainfully, "Those toys crafted by the Dwarfs are nothing compared to our Abyssal Magical Artifacts.
Moreover, the strongest aspect of us Demon Race is our own flesh bodies; we disdain using such things, so I don’t have the blueprints you desire."
"You don’t?" Han Xing continued to ask, "Then what conditions are you still talking about with me?"
"Farewell, I’ll just go spread the recording among the Elf Race."
Having said that, he directly turned around, about to leave.
In fact, Han Xing didn’t want to entangle with this guy any longer; after all, this guy was quite terrifying.
With this being’s immense power, he could probably kill him thousands of times with just a slight release of power.
Feeling that Han Xing’s presence was gradually departing, the Great Demon Monarch became a bit anxious; he hurriedly yelled, "Human Race, come back!
You can tell others if you wish, but first, help me cancel the summoning ritual before you leave!"
Yet, Han Xing turned a deaf ear.
It was then that the Great Demon Monarch finally said, "Human Race, as long as you help me remove the summoning ritual, I can directly give you a drop of Demon Blood!"
Still, Han Xing pretended not to hear.
He didn’t know what Demon Blood was anyway.
The Great Demon Monarch became even more anxious, "I also have a Great Sword that I used, and right, I also picked up an Exotic Beast Egg in the Alternate Space just now, which I can give to you!"
Finally, Han Xing stopped, and when he turned around, a system prompt appeared before him.
[You have triggered an additional side quest, the Great Demon Monarch’s Request.]
[Quest Introduction: The Great Demon Monarch is trapped in an alternate space, unable to invade your world.
Only by canceling the summoning ritual can he return to the abyss.
Noble Julius is now bowing his head, requesting you to aid his escape.]
[Quest Rewards: ’Demon Blood’, ’Demon Monarch’s Greatsword’, ’Unknown Beast Egg’, choose one of the three.]
[Please note, this quest is not system-issued, survivors please be cautious and verify task information.]
"I actually triggered a quest?"
Han Xing’s eyes flickered; he had always been wary of this creature, thinking it was deliberately luring him closer.
Now he realized that the Demon Monarch seemed genuinely stuck.
The current situation for the other party was very awkward, unable to enter Han Xing’s world nor return to his abyss territory.
At the same time, Han Xing also examined the attributes of the three quest rewards.

[Demon Blood: Heart blood of a high-level demon, merge with it to change to a demon bloodline, granting powerful Power of the Demon, all attributes increased tenfold, upgrade attributes tripled, automatic transition to the hidden Profession, Demon Hunter.]

[Demon Monarch’s Greatsword (Red), Abyssal Magical Artifact, Quality - Epic, Attack Power 10784~15462, All Attributes +3333, Attached Effect - Dominion (Wielding this weapon, demon race creatures below high-level demon rank will be unable to harm you), Attached Effect - Judgment (As a high-level demon, you have supreme authority, dealing triple damage to creatures ranked below you), Attached Effect - Demonic Flame (Upon attack hit, applies a lasting 10s demonic flame burning effect), Attached Effect...]
Equipment Requirement: Level 60.
[Unknown Beast Egg: Attributes unknown, race unknown, but capable of traversing through alternate space, seems to possess a portion of Void abilities.]
"Hiss..."
Seeing the quest rewards, Han Xing sharply inhaled a breath of cold air.
Not because of anything else, but because the attributes of each of these three reward items are simply too overpowered...
Among them, Demon Blood seems to be an item related to a hidden profession.
Just by merging with it, one can directly transition into a powerful Demon Hunter.
The Demon Monarch’s Greatsword is even more extraordinary, apparently the sword wielded by this demon, and its attributes are incredibly formidable!
As for the final Exotic Beast Egg.
The system’s explanation is somewhat vague, but without a doubt, anything that catches the eye of the Great Demon Monarch must be exceptional.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the sky-piercing horn, finally stirred!

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Three Choices, Shocking Gains!
paragraphs: Facing the reward offered by the Great Demon Monarch, Han Xing took a deep breath.
He admitted, his heart was indeed moved.
But he didn’t completely trust the demon’s words, so he asked.
"I can help you, but how can I trust that you won’t break your promise and just leave after getting free?"
The Great Demon Monarch sneered, "Are you doubting this king’s credibility?"
"Yes."
Han Xing nodded directly, "After all, you’re already in such a disgraceful state, what does credibility even matter to you."

The Great Demon Monarch was quite annoyed, but still held back his anger, saying, "This king can sign a True Name Contract with you, as long as you break the Summoning Array, I will definitely reward you!"
True Name Contract?
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, knowing that for the Demon Race, the most important thing is their true name.
Though it wasn’t like in the stories where knowing the true name would mean control over life and death, vowing on one’s own name was still quite sincere.
"Alright, let’s sign it." Han Xing agreed readily.
A system prompt appeared.
[The Great Demon Monarch Julius swears by his true name, requesting your help to break the summoning ritual. As a reward, you may choose an item. Do you accept the contract?]
"Accept!"
Han Xing immediately agreed and then asked, "How do I break the summoning ritual?"
The demon’s tone returned to calm, "Throw in the Spirit Core, purify the darkness in the Spiritual Spring Water, and the summoning ritual will naturally end."
Han Xing nodded. He didn’t doubt the words of the Great Demon Monarch because, initially, option 2 of the system task was also this method.
Han Xing was very cautious; even after accepting the task, he did not try to approach the Summoning Array.
Because he wasn’t sure if the demon had other tricks up its sleeve.
He drew a Wooden Arrow, then tied a Spirit Core to the tip with a string, using the bowstring to shoot the Spirit Cores into the water one by one.
The Great Demon Monarch sneered at Han Xing’s wariness.
As one Spirit Core after another was thrown into the pool, the dark aura stopped spreading and turned clear instead.
The horn that reached into the sky also began to fade at this moment, as if it was about to disappear from this space.
It wasn’t until Han Xing shot the thirty-seventh arrow that the black smoke in the Spiritual Spring Water stopped coming out.
The Great Demon Monarch’s horn slowly sank into the water, about to disappear.
At this moment, Han Xing hurriedly called out, "Demon, my reward!
The Great Demon Monarch wanted to renege, but thinking of the True Name Contract he signed, he still said, "Human, state your desired reward."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing quickly analyzed the advantages and disadvantages of the three rewards in his mind, finding it difficult to decide momentarily.

"You’d better decide quickly; otherwise, once the ritual dissipates, you will no longer be able to communicate with this king, and it won’t be this king breaking the contract then." The demon let out a sinister smile.
Thinking of this guy’s cunning nature, Han Xing gritted his teeth and quickly made a decision.
"I’ll choose the Exotic Beast Egg!"
The demon opposite seemed stunned for a moment; the Great Demon Monarch asked, "Are you sure you don’t want my Sword or Demon Blood?"
Han Xing nodded, "I’m sure, give it to me quickly!"
The demon coldly laughed, "As you wish."
A moment later, as the Great Demon Monarch completely disappeared, the previously dark sky brightened again.
At this moment, Han Xing, as if he had just gone through a great battle, collapsed to the ground.
Just then, a system prompt appeared.
[The Great Demon Monarch Julius has returned to the Abyss Realm. Survivor, you have completed a great banishment, increasing world influence by 32, and you’ve earned 10 Legendary Points.]
"Legendary Points, what’s that?"
Han Xing felt a bit confused; he looked at the character interface and indeed, there was an additional Legendary Point.
However, there was no indication of what the Legendary Points were for.
Shaking his head, Han Xing decided to set it aside for now.
Because, at this moment, his eyes had already spotted a pitch-black giant egg floating on the clear pool in the center of the Dark Elf territory.
Han Xing widened his eyes, quickly approached the pool, and grabbed the giant egg in his hand.
A system prompt appeared.
[An Unknown Race ’Exotic Beast Egg’ has been obtained, would you like to start hatching it?]
[Please note: Once you choose to hatch, the creature inside the Exotic Beast Egg will automatically bind as your pet. At the current stage, each Survivor can only bind one pet, so choose carefully.]
Hearing the system prompt, Han Xing pondered, "I can only bind one pet?"
"I don’t even know what kind of creature is inside. Although anything fancy could suggest good potential, there’s always a chance of misluck..."
For no reason, Han Xing suddenly felt a twinge of regret.
"Was I supposed to choose the Demon Blood or the Monarch’s Greatsword instead of this Exotic Beast Egg?"
But the next moment, as he realized something, his facial expression changed dramatically.
When choosing the reward, the demon seemed more inclined for him to pick either Demon Blood or the Monarch’s Greatsword, even confirming it with Han Xing.
That creature couldn’t have been so kind-hearted, so the only possibility is, the demon had a scheme!

With a trembling voice, Han Xing said, "I remember... the introduction for Demon Blood mentioned that after fusion, one gains the Power of the Demon, but would also change into Demon Bloodline, meaning I’d turn into a member of the Demon Race"
"And demons are strictly hierarchical creatures; higher tier demons have absolute power over lower-tier ones."
"If I become a demon, wouldn’t I then be under its control as well?"
"Also, that Demon Monarch’s Greatsword, being its weapon for years, likely had methods placed on it, possibly directly mind-controlling me via soul control, taking over my flesh body!"
"Damn!" Han Xing suddenly realized.
He realized, his guess was probably correct, the demon’s initial target was to control him!
He broke out in a cold sweat, gritting his teeth, "Crafty devil!"
Simultaneously, he felt immensely grateful, "Thankfully... I unintentionally made the best choice."
When Han Xing looked again at the pitch-black giant egg in front, he no longer felt any regret.
After all, compared to his own life, what do these other things matter?
Thinking this, Han Xing clicked hatch without hesitation,
A system prompt appeared.
[Would you like to hatch the ’Unknown Exotic Beast Egg’? The hatching process will take 100 hours.]
"100 hours, that long?"
The time required is very lengthy.
Han Xing clicked confirm, then said with eager anticipation, "I hope it hatches into a powerful pet, I wouldn’t mind getting a dragon!"
Although, Han Xing also knew he was just wishfully thinking.
The giant egg’s appearance and size couldn’t possibly relate to a dragon, with a very low chance of it being one.
[Hatching in progress, remaining time 99 hours, 59 minutes, and 58 seconds.]
After handling the giant egg, Han Xing eagerly looked toward the water pool ahead.
He hadn’t forgotten his original goal; challenging this group of Dark Elves was initially for the territory’s central water resource!
Despite the twists and turns, and even a gamble with such terrifying existences, he finally succeeded!
Now, as long as he merges this territory, he will directly own a large amount of water resources, completely solving the water crisis.
Not only that, but if this batch of Spiritual Spring Water enters the trading market, it will certainly cause a frenzy in District 107.
And he, would be able to reap immense profits from it!

chapters.title: Chapter 19: Striking It Rich!
paragraphs: Looking at so many water resources, Han Xing was thrilled and couldn’t wait to annex this Sky Island Territory.
[You have successfully merged the Dark Elf Territory, and the territory area has expanded.]
[You have obtained territory resources, Spiritual Spring Water 1532 liters.]
[Spiritual Spring Water: A pure drinking water that seems to contain some kind of life essence, drinking it can slowly heal injuries.]
Seeing that note, Han Xing was instantly shocked!
He originally thought this was just ordinary drinking water, but the attribute at the end instantly elevated the status of this pool of water by several levels.
What does healing injuries mean?
In this world, there are no doctors, nor are there healing skills from the Holy Profession.
If you accidentally get hurt, you either rely on your constitution to recover, or you just wait for death.
Currently, many human survivors are injured from fighting monsters but cannot receive effective medical treatment.
Some severely injured survivors, when injured at this time, mean they lose their combat power, equivalent to being sentenced to death by this world.
Especially among those close combat professions, the casualty rate is even higher.
But the appearance of this Spiritual Spring Water has given them new hope.
One can imagine, when the Spiritual Spring Water appears in the trading channel, what a huge sensation it will cause!
This isn’t just a pool of water; this is simply a pool of gold!
Han Xing was very excited and couldn’t wait to taste it first.
The cool spring water went down his throat, and Han Xing instantly felt a refreshing chill from head to toe.
"So refreshing!"
The places on his arms recently burned by the Large Fireball’s splash damage started to feel itchy.
"The injuries are healing, such an obvious effect!"
After verifying the efficacy of the Spiritual Spring Water, Han Xing suddenly had an idea.
Right now is when everyone lacks water the most, this is a perfect trading opportunity.
Thinking of this, Han Xing decided not to delay, and start acquiring a batch of resources right away.
He opened the chat channel to observe the current market situation.
However, contrary to expectations, the scene of everyone frantically buying water resources did not appear, instead, many people were discussing a survivor selling water.
The chat channel was flooded with information.
"Look quickly! The Enchanter boss is selling water again!"
"This time it’s 100 milliliters, he needs the Stalker’s green weapon."
"Who has weapons, hurry and trade!
The trading channel was once again triggered into a frenzy, many people began to privately message the survivor called ’Enchanter’, and this 100 ml of water was almost sold instantly.
"Hmm? Someone found a large water source?"
Han Xing keenly realized that someone might have beaten him to selling water.
Checking the chat information, Han Xing confirmed his guess.
Indeed, a survivor named ’Enchanter’ was selling water.
However, his asking price was outrageous, 100ml of water for ten Spirit Cores, or 5 kilograms of food, or green equipment.
Any of these items was enough to empty the pockets of current human survivors.
Their hard-collected items from some safe Sky Islands must be traded away, just to get a sip of water.
But even so, many people were still willing to scramble to purchase.
After all, these things are nothing compared to their life.
Han Xing thought deeply, "Selling only 100 milliliters at a time, is this hunger marketing?"
"They say, this is the seventh time the Enchanter has sold water resources, so he should still have quite a water reserve."
"But definitely not more than mine."
You should know, Han Xing now has as much as 1500 liters of water in hand, which converts to 1.5 million milliliters!
He believes it’s impossible for anyone on Channel 107 to have more than him at this stage. If they had, they would have already put it out for mass selling.
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly opened the trading channel and posted a trade message.
[Consignment Item Information]: Spiritual Spring Water, can replenish water, has a slight injury healing effect.
[Stock Reserve]: Large amount.

[Trade Conditions]: 1 Spirit Core for 10 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, 1 block of Refined Iron for 5 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, 1 Beast Hide for 100 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, etc...
[Consigner]: Star River.
Han Xing kept entering various material information while setting all kinds of trading rules.
From various minerals to equipment, skill books, blueprints, even unopened treasure chests, all clearly marked prices!
He knew this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
Once Channel 107’s survivors get through this time and solve the water issue, mass purchases later will be impossible.
These materials are stored up, and Han Xing absolutely won’t suffer losses.
Moreover, as time goes on, they will continue to appreciate!
Han Xing even thought, even if he doesn’t use them all, he can make them all into equipment and then sell them to people in Channel 107, continuously harvesting their resources for a positive cycle.
By then, maybe he will be the sole provider of equipment for nearly ten thousand people on Channel 107.
And Han Xing would profit immensely!
When the consignment information for the Spiritual Spring Water was uploaded, many survivors cautiously wiped their eyes, as if thinking they had seen mistakenly.
Though filled with doubt, they still clicked to trade without hesitation, fearing if they’re a second late it will be snatched away by others.
When the first survivor exchanged 5 Spirit Cores, 8 blocks of Refined Iron, and 30 Rare Earths to get 120 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, he was so excited that he almost jumped up.
He shouted excitedly on the local network: "Holy crap! I got it! I got it!"
"Someone is selling water on the trading channel, you can trade any materials to get it, hurry!"
"What!?"
With the first one, the second quickly followed, and Han Xing’s Spiritual Spring Water soon caused a rush.
At the same time, the local network chat channel was swept up in an unprecedented frenzy.
Many survivors were extremely excited inside.
"Damn, really got it, thank you benefactor..."
"Wow, not just ordinary water! It’s Spiritual Spring Water"
"Better than ordinary drinking water, has healing function too!"
"Family, charge! Getting it means earning, late-comers will miss out!"
The chat channel went completely crazy.
At this time, Han Xing was already bombarded by dense system notifications.
[Trade succeeded, you received Refined Iron*6, you lost Spiritual Spring Water 30ml...]
[You received Bronze Treasure Chest*1, you lost Spiritual Spring Water 500ml...]
[Received Mage Robe Blueprint (green)*1, you lost Spiritual Spring Water*300ml...]
Han Xing’s set trade amount was very user-friendly, even if you only had 1 material, you could trade with him for Spiritual Spring Water.
Because of the clearly marked prices, Han Xing spared himself the bargaining with people, those desperately lacking water survivors started frantically buying.
Following system notifications constantly rolling by, large quantities of materials entered the backpack.
In just five minutes, his Refined Iron stock broke through a thousand, the number of Spirit Cores exceeded five hundred, Rare Earth, Ether, and other materials surpassed three thousand.
And this number is still growing at a terrifying speed...
The 60-grid Space Backpack quickly filled up.
Han Xing could only pile these materials directly onto the ground.
Before long, small mountains formed out of materials appeared in front of him.
At this point, Han Xing’s facial expression nearly blossomed into a smile.
"I’m rich, rich! This time I’m truly rich!"

Thinking of this, Han Xing directly opened the trading channel and posted a trade message.
[Consignment Item Information]: Spiritual Spring Water, can replenish water, has a slight injury healing effect.
[Stock Reserve]: Large amount.

[Trade Conditions]: 1 Spirit Core for 10 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, 1 block of Refined Iron for 5 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, 1 Beast Hide for 100 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, etc...
[Consigner]: Star River.
Han Xing kept entering various material information while setting all kinds of trading rules.
From various minerals to equipment, skill books, blueprints, even unopened treasure chests, all clearly marked prices!
He knew this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
Once Channel 107’s survivors get through this time and solve the water issue, mass purchases later will be impossible.
These materials are stored up, and Han Xing absolutely won’t suffer losses.
Moreover, as time goes on, they will continue to appreciate!
Han Xing even thought, even if he doesn’t use them all, he can make them all into equipment and then sell them to people in Channel 107, continuously harvesting their resources for a positive cycle.
By then, maybe he will be the sole provider of equipment for nearly ten thousand people on Channel 107.
And Han Xing would profit immensely!
When the consignment information for the Spiritual Spring Water was uploaded, many survivors cautiously wiped their eyes, as if thinking they had seen mistakenly.
Though filled with doubt, they still clicked to trade without hesitation, fearing if they’re a second late it will be snatched away by others.
When the first survivor exchanged 5 Spirit Cores, 8 blocks of Refined Iron, and 30 Rare Earths to get 120 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, he was so excited that he almost jumped up.
He shouted excitedly on the local network: "Holy crap!
I got it!
I got it!"
"Someone is selling water on the trading channel, you can trade any materials to get it, hurry!"
"What!?"
With the first one, the second quickly followed, and Han Xing’s Spiritual Spring Water soon caused a rush.
At the same time, the local network chat channel was swept up in an unprecedented frenzy.
Many survivors were extremely excited inside.
"Damn, really got it, thank you benefactor..."
"Wow, not just ordinary water!
It’s Spiritual Spring Water"
"Better than ordinary drinking water, has healing function too!"
"Family, charge!
Getting it means earning, late-comers will miss out!"
The chat channel went completely crazy.
At this time, Han Xing was already bombarded by dense system notifications.
[Trade succeeded, you received Refined Iron*6, you lost Spiritual Spring Water 30ml...]
[You received Bronze Treasure Chest*1, you lost Spiritual Spring Water 500ml...]
[Received Mage Robe Blueprint (green)*1, you lost Spiritual Spring Water*300ml...]
Han Xing’s set trade amount was very user-friendly, even if you only had 1 material, you could trade with him for Spiritual Spring Water.
Because of the clearly marked prices, Han Xing spared himself the bargaining with people, those desperately lacking water survivors started frantically buying.
Following system notifications constantly rolling by, large quantities of materials entered the backpack.
In just five minutes, his Refined Iron stock broke through a thousand, the number of Spirit Cores exceeded five hundred, Rare Earth, Ether, and other materials surpassed three thousand.
And this number is still growing at a terrifying speed...
The 60-grid Space Backpack quickly filled up.
Han Xing could only pile these materials directly onto the ground.
Before long, small mountains formed out of materials appeared in front of him.
At this point, Han Xing’s facial expression nearly blossomed into a smile.
"I’m rich, rich!
This time I’m truly rich!"

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Monopolistic Windfall!
paragraphs: Han Xing excitedly rubbed his hands together, his voice trembling, "How long can these materials last me, and how much equipment can I make?"

So far, he had traded for 1052 Spirit Cores, 4362 Rare Earths, 3742 Refined Irons, 5763 Ethers, 3 Skill Books, 5 unopened Bronze Treasure Chests, 32 unopened Wooden Boxes, 7 Green Equipment Blueprints, and thousands of various other miscellaneous materials.
And all Han Xing had spent was just 37 liters of Spiritual Spring Water...
His remaining Spiritual Spring Water reserve was 1502 liters.
He hadn’t even used up his spare amount...
"Is this the benefit of monopoly? It’s absolutely wonderful!" Han Xing marveled.
Currently, throughout region 107, he was the only one selling water resources in large quantities, with no competitors whatsoever.
If it continues, Han Xing could gather all the gains from nearly ten thousand people in the 107 channel in the past two days into his own hands.
It’s like they were all working for Han Xing in the past two days.
Seeing the materials piling up more and more on the ground, Han Xing thought for a moment and temporarily removed the consignment information of the Spiritual Spring Water.
The lively atmosphere in the consignment channel abruptly ended after ten minutes.
Those survivors still waiting for trade suddenly found themselves dumbfounded.
"What’s happening? Why did it suddenly go off the shelf?"
"@Star River, God, is the water reserve insufficient? I haven’t traded yet!"
"@Star River, bro, is something wrong? Please let us know, I’m so scared..."
Many people were frantically mentioning Han Xing in the chat channel, but at this moment, Han Xing was busy organizing his territory and hadn’t checked the messages.
With Han Xing not responding, the group became even more anxious.
Especially those who were still observing, hesitating whether to exchange their belongings, felt deep regret and wanted to slap themselves for missing such a perfect opportunity.
If Han Xing stops selling, where will they get water?
"It’s over... The God isn’t responding; maybe he really sold out..."
"Damn, I initially thought his prices were too high, not worth exchanging, but now, I want to slap myself!"
"Me too..."
The survivors who missed out were heartbroken, while those who exchanged first when Han Xing listed Spiritual Spring Water were secretly delighted and mocked in the chat channel.
"Hahaha, a bunch of idiots, no matter how good materials and equipment are, can they compare to life?"
"You can get equipment again, but once you’re dead, you’re truly dead!
"Exactly, and this Spiritual Spring Water can heal injuries, in emergencies, it’s like having an extra life, it’s definitely worth it!"
Listening to their taunts, the group of hesitant survivors was filled with regret.
However, some were still not giving up, trying to summon Han Xing, hoping he would list some Spiritual Spring Water again.
Misu: "@Star River, God, please list a bit more, just a little, I swear I won’t hesitate."
Three-View Mountain: "@Star River, Bro, you’re our savior, the entire 107 channel relies on you, sell some more water."
Vortex Potato: "@Star River, Dad!!!"
Yu Stone: "The guy upstairs, you’re really ruthless... @Vortex Potato."
Vortex Potato: "What did I do? If someone’s willing to sell water now, they’re my lifesaver, my rebirth parent! He’ll be my Star River dad from now on!"
Just then, a familiar name appeared in the chat channel.
Star River: "Ahem... What happened?"
Han Xing awkwardly coughed a couple of times, and when he spoke, the entire 107 channel instantly paused.
Vortex Potato: "@Star River, Dad! Did I summon you?"
Primordial Spirit Expert: "The God finally came out, we beg you, list some more Spiritual Spring Water."
At this moment, Han Xing browsed through the chat records and finally understood what was happening in the chat channel.
He smiled and said, "Everyone, don’t worry, there’s still Spiritual Spring Water left, I’ll be listing another batch soon."
Bean Sprouts: "@Star River, really, God, I’m waiting for your Spiritual Spring Water to save my life!"
Lost: "Great, this time I won’t hesitate at all!"
In the chat channel, many survivors sighed in relief from the bottom of their hearts.
They originally thought that Han Xing had run out of Spiritual Spring Water, missing out on an excellent opportunity, but unexpectedly, he said he still had more.
"Star River God, how much Spiritual Spring Water do you still have in reserve, is the price the same as before?"
Han Xing replied, "Don’t worry about that, I will list more Spiritual Spring Water later, but the trading conditions will change a bit."
Hearing Han Xing say this, the survivors in channel 107 thought Han Xing was going to raise prices, and their hearts raced.

Han Xing seemed to understand their concern and directly said, "Relax, no price increase, just adding some exchange conditions, anyone with furniture, houses, territory facilities, etc., can trade them for Spiritual Spring Water with me, and the price will be favorable."
"By the way, anyone with a Storage Box or its blueprint can prioritize trading for Spiritual Spring Water with me now.

"White Level Storage Boxes can be traded directly for 500 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, blueprints can trade for 2000 milliliters. Green Level Storage Boxes can be traded for 2000 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, and blueprints can be traded for 10000 milliliters!"
This was also Han Xing’s purpose in checking the chat channel.
Now he had too many materials piling up in his territory and needed a few Storage Boxes to collect them.
Hearing the high rewards Han Xing offered, many survivors were astonished.
Previously, Han Xing tagged a Bronze Treasure Chest to only exchange for 500 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, Green Equipment Blueprints could only trade for 300 milliliters.
Now, a white level Storage Box blueprint was priced directly at 2000 milliliters, and the green level was 10000 milliliters!
Many people wished they could magically produce a blueprint right now and trade with Han Xing.
"Who has the Storage Box blueprint?"
"Hurry up, the God has a demand, if anyone has a Storage Box or blueprint, take it out quickly."
In the chat segment, people were afraid Han Xing might not get a Storage Box blueprint and wouldn’t sell Spiritual Spring Water, worrying for him.
But the blueprint drop rate seemed quite low.
After all, Storage Boxes are spatial items like Space Backpacks, with larger capacity but can’t be carried, only stored in territories.
Just then, a survivor named Cream Puff slowly said, "I think I have a Storage Box blueprint, it’s Green Level, is... it okay?"
Han Xing smiled and said, "Sure, let’s trade."
He immediately sent a trade request to the other party, and they readily accepted.
Then, a system notification appeared.
[You have acquired a Storage Box Blueprint (Green), and you have lost 10 liters of Spiritual Spring Water.]
The Spiritual Spring Water reserve dropped below 1500 liters, but for Han Xing, it was negligible.

At this time, Cream Puff excitedly announced in the chat channel that they had traded and received a substantial amount of 10000 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water, leaving other survivors envious.
At this point, Han Xing said on the local network, "Everyone, please be patient, I will list another batch of Spiritual Spring Water soon, just trade with me directly."
"Okay God, waiting for you!"
"@Star River, thank you, Star River God, you’re the savior of channel 107..."
In the chat channel, facing everyone’s praise, Han Xing smiled, and just as he was about to log out of the chat channel, he suddenly saw a familiar name mention him.
Levi: "@Star River, what’s going on? Why did you directly reject me when I clicked to trade with you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 21: A Bountiful Harvest
paragraphs: Levi questioned Han Xing in the chat channel.

At this moment, another person called Five Celestial Thunders said, "Even we from the Lei Group were rejected when trying to trade with you. What do you want? Are you not interested in doing business anymore?"
Facing their questioning, Han Xing chuckled softly and said, "I don’t have any intentions, I just don’t want to trade with people from your Lei Group."
Other survivors keenly sensed that there was something unusual in Han Xing’s words.
This powerful figure seems to be at odds with people from this Lei Group?
At this moment, they remembered that yesterday, the Lei Group was clamoring in the chat channel to boycott someone, and that person seemed to be Star River!
It’s over... this group of fools offended the powerful figure, and now they’re directly refusing to trade with you.
Many people silently mourned for the Lei Group members for a few seconds.
At this point, Levi also knew that Han Xing was holding a grudge from yesterday. He suppressed his anger and said in a low voice, "Kid, do you really need to be so petty?"
"Although we had conflicts before, it was just me alone. There’s no need to implicate other people in the Lei Group, right?"
However, Han Xing laughed and replied, "Really? I recall yesterday, you Lei Group people jumped out as a group, clamoring to boycott me and not trade materials with me."
"Now congratulations, you’ve succeeded."

Levi was stunned for a moment, then said in a gloomy tone, "Star River, don’t be too ruthless in everything you do. If you don’t sell us water, the lives of dozens of Lei Group members will be on your hands!"
The atmosphere in the chat channel was very strange. This Levi directly dragged in the lives of dozens of people, trying to force Han Xing to sell water.
However, Han Xing sneered, "Levi, I’ve said, don’t try to fool me with your tricks. Do you think moral blackmail is useful against me?"

"You are their leader; you should be responsible for your subordinates. Since the decision was yours, all the consequences arising from it are also yours to bear. If you can’t bear it, it only proves your incompetence."
Having said that, Han Xing didn’t want to waste more words with Levi and directly exited the chat channel.
Levi was left with a livid face, trembling with anger as he looked at the chat channel.
Meanwhile, other Lei Group members turned pale as paper.
At this time, in Han Xing’s Sky Island Territory.
He squeezed out from a pile of materials.
Levi’s rhetoric didn’t affect him at all, even though he deliberately exaggerated the situation.
But Han Xing knew that although water resources were scarce in channel 107, some people definitely still had reserves.
Lei Group members could completely seek out these people for exchange; it’s just that the cost would be higher, depending on whether Levi is willing to pay the price.
Shaking his head, Han Xing didn’t further consider those people’s issues.
Instead, he looked at his territory, which had nearly doubled in size again, and smiled, revealing a bright white grin.
Previously, his territory was 32 cubic meters; after merging with the Dark Elf’s Sky Island, it expanded directly to 64 cubic meters.
An 8-meter by 8-meter large platform floated in the air.
Though the space is large, the massive amount of materials still made the platform extremely crowded and chaotic.
Han Xing managed to make his way out of the material pile, finding two vacant spots on the edge.
Then, he glanced at the blueprint section and the requirements for crafting a storage box.
[Storage Box Blueprint (Green)]
[Materials Needed: Spirit Core*50, Refined Iron*100, Mithril*10, Rare Earth*100.]
[Success Rate 10% (Due to Divine-level Craftsman Talent, success rate already at 100%)]
"Hmm? It actually requires mithril as a material."

Han Xing pondered, "The source of mithril is quite scarce; aside from the small chance of finding some in a Bronze Treasure Chest, you can only rely on luck to find a few pieces of Secret Silver Ore."
"I’m not sure if there’s any in channel 107 now."
Han Xing was unsure, but when he returned to the chat channel and expressed his intention to acquire mithril, he still got responses from many people.
Finally, he successfully used 2000 milliliters of Spiritual Spring Water to exchange for 21 pieces of mithril.
Indeed, there is strength in numbers. Even if the odds are low, there are always a few lucky Emperors of Luck who can obtain these materials.
With the materials for the storage box gathered, Han Xing directly clicked on craft.
A dazzling green light flashed, and a portion of the material mountain on the ground disappeared.
A 180-second progress bar appeared before his eyes.
Since it was a crafting tool, it required some longer time.
After waiting for 6 minutes, a system prompt came.
[Successfully crafted Storage Box (Green) *2]
[Storage Box (Green), Quality - Fine, Storage Space 350, Special Effect - Expansion (Storage space additionally increased by 50)]
[Storage Box (Green), Quality - Rare, Storage Space 400, Special Effect - Intermediate Expansion (Storage space additionally increased by 100)]
Two storage boxes, one of Fine Quality and one of Rare Quality, with the bonus effects counted, added up to an additional 750 storage slots!
The Divine-level Craftsman Talent once again demonstrated its powerful effect!
"Great, now the space is more than enough!"
As soon as those words dropped.
Bang!
A hollow thud, and two refined iron storage boxes appeared in front of Han Xing, each approximately two meters long and one meter wide.
Since the boxes were entirely made of refined iron, they appeared with a black effect, with white patterns formed by mithril running through them.
Han Xing stuffed the small mountain-like piles of materials into the storage boxes.
Moments later, the territory became spacious once again.
Han Xing dusted off his hands and opened the sale channel once more to start selling Spiritual Spring Water.
Channel 107 was rocked once again.
Many people eagerly scrambled to trade materials with Han Xing. Within just a few seconds, over a hundred trade requests appeared.
In fact, compared to the first time, the fervor of trading was even greater!
Han Xing clicked on the trade points so much that his hand nearly went limp; he was busy beyond measure.
[Trade successful, you obtained a Furniture Blueprint Collection; you lost 500ml of Spiritual Spring Water.]
[Trade successful, you obtained a Beast Hide Short Boots Blueprint (Green); you lost 300ml of Spiritual Spring Water.]
[Trade successful, you obtained a Warrior Pendant Blueprint (Green); you lost 500ml of Spiritual Spring Water.]
As Han Xing adjusted the trade conditions, this time he removed all sorts of equipment and instead collected various blueprints, immediately skipping redundant ones.
This grand trading scene continued for nearly two hours, and Han Xing felt as though his fingers were about to cramp from all the tapping.
Once the final trade was complete, Han Xing, as if having fought a great battle, directly collapsed to the ground.
However, despite the fatigue, a look of excitement appeared on Han Xing’s face.
After all, who wouldn’t be thrilled to see a dozen skill books, and dozens of equipment and weapon blueprints sitting quietly in their backpack?
Not only that, but besides these items, at the edge of the territory, four storage boxes occupied eight square units.
Just now, with the materials filling up, Han Xing had temporarily made two more.
Now, with four storage boxes and nearly three thousand storage slots, it was filled to the brim with various materials!

Han Xing dusted off his hands and opened the sale channel once more to start selling Spiritual Spring Water.
Channel 107 was rocked once again.
Many people eagerly scrambled to trade materials with Han Xing.
Within just a few seconds, over a hundred trade requests appeared.
In fact, compared to the first time, the fervor of trading was even greater!
Han Xing clicked on the trade points so much that his hand nearly went limp; he was busy beyond measure.
[Trade successful, you obtained a Furniture Blueprint Collection; you lost 500ml of Spiritual Spring Water.]
[Trade successful, you obtained a Beast Hide Short Boots Blueprint (Green); you lost 300ml of Spiritual Spring Water.]
[Trade successful, you obtained a Warrior Pendant Blueprint (Green); you lost 500ml of Spiritual Spring Water.]
As Han Xing adjusted the trade conditions, this time he removed all sorts of equipment and instead collected various blueprints, immediately skipping redundant ones.
This grand trading scene continued for nearly two hours, and Han Xing felt as though his fingers were about to cramp from all the tapping.
Once the final trade was complete, Han Xing, as if having fought a great battle, directly collapsed to the ground.
However, despite the fatigue, a look of excitement appeared on Han Xing’s face.
After all, who wouldn’t be thrilled to see a dozen skill books, and dozens of equipment and weapon blueprints sitting quietly in their backpack?
Not only that, but besides these items, at the edge of the territory, four storage boxes occupied eight square units.
Just now, with the materials filling up, Han Xing had temporarily made two more.
Now, with four storage boxes and nearly three thousand storage slots, it was filled to the brim with various materials!

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Territory Points Ranking, Activated!
paragraphs: Earlier, in the first wave of ten-minute trading, Han Xing exchanged 37 liters of Spiritual Spring Water for tens of thousands of materials.
Now, in the two-hour trade, Han Xing had consumed more than 400 liters of Spiritual Spring Water.
From this, one can imagine how many materials, how many Spirit Cores he had accumulated!
"This wave, really made a killing!" Han Xing excitedly stood up.
These materials, not to mention Rare Earth and Ether, as special materials, their uses are very extensive, future large engineering tools and Magic Devices will use them.
More importantly, the Spirit Cores.
Han Xing has already discovered that the more powerful the equipment being crafted, the more Spirit Cores are needed, and the uses of Spirit Cores are very extensive.
After looking at these materials.
Han Xing then looked at those seventeen Skill Books.
Among them, there are five Skill Books for Stalkers, including basic skills like Stealth, Backstab, and Throat Slashing.
There are 4 for Warriors, including skills like Charge, Midair Slash, and Horizontal Slash.
For Holy Profession, there are skills like Divine Strike, Holy Light Ball, and Purification.
Additionally, for the Mage, skills like Ice Arrow Skill, Fireball Technique, Wind Blade, and Thunder Strike, all essential damage skills for the Mage profession.
What Han Xing looked forward to the most were the three Skill Books for the Hunter profession.
[Wind Chasing Arrow: Shoot a rapid arrow to cause 130% damage to the enemy.]
[Multi-Shot: Continuously shoot five arrows, each causing 80% damage.]
[Roll: Can perform a quick roll during combat.]
"Very good!"
Han Xing clenched his fist and said, "Now, before advancing the Hunter, all the basic skills except for ’Weakness Strike’ are complete."
Then there is that pile of blueprints.
Han Xing was too lazy to look at them one by one and clicked to learn all of them.
Since Han Xing did not trade for duplicate blueprints, all the blueprints here are ones he has not learned yet.
[Beast Hide Short Boots][Beast Hide Shorts][Traveler’s Ring][Warrior Pendant]...

Since Leather Armor increases the agility attribute the most, it’s the preferred equipment for Hunters and Stalkers, excluding ones he can use, some Green Robes, Light Armor, and Fine Iron Armor, they were directly ignored by him.
Now, except for not having a Helmet and Gauntlets, he almost has half a set of one-star Green equipment!
In a situation where materials are not lacking, Han Xing crafted seven or eight sets in one go.
After excluding some Fine Quality green equipment, the rest are all Rare Quality green equipment.
A total of four pieces of Rare Quality green equipment.
[Beast Hide Shorts (Green), Quality - Rare, Defense 2~4, Agility +3, Attached Effect - Basic Magic Resistance]
[Beast Hide Short Boots (Green), Quality - Rare, Defense 1~2, Agility +6, Attached Effect - Rapid Run (Active Effect, increases running speed by 50% for 10 seconds when activated.)]

[Warrior Pendant (Green), Quality - Rare, Power +6, Constitution +2, Attached Effect - Warrior’s Roar (When attacked, has a 50% chance to trigger the Warrior’s Roar state, increasing your Attack Power by 10%, effect lasts 10 seconds.)]
[Traveler’s Ring (Green), Quality - Rare, Power +2, Agility +2, Spirit +2, Constitution +2, Attached Effect]
Han Xing equipped them one by one, greatly enhancing his attributes.
His panel changed.
[Name: Han Xing]
[Race: Human Race]
[Profession: Hunter]
[Level: LV2]

[Power: 6+9 (Warrior Pendant +6, Traveler’s Ring +2, Beast Hide Cloak +1), Agility: 6+15 (Space Backpack +4, Beast Hide Short Boots +6, Beast Hide Shorts +3, Traveler’s Ring +2), Spirit: 5+2 (Traveler’s Ring +2), Constitution: 8+8 (Space Backpack +4, Warrior Pendant +2, Traveler’s Ring +2)]
[Skills: Basic Bow Mastery, Double Arrow, Wind Chasing Arrow, Multi-Shot, Roll.]
[Talent: Divine-level Artisan (SSS)]
Looking at his attributes, Han Xing suddenly said with emotion.
"I’m so strong!"
As of now, Han Xing’s equipment among Survivors can indeed be considered very powerful.
His attributes are enough to easily overpower other level 5 Survivors.
Apart from attributes, he has also learned three Hunter skills.
Plus the Warrior Pendant he made, which provides a short Attack Power boost effect, and the short boots with a Rapid Run effect, his combat ability has greatly increased.
"Next time I encounter the Dark Elf Squad, it won’t be as risky."
Han Xing thought happily.
While organizing these materials, several hours passed in the blink of an eye, and the sky gradually darkened.
The second day since the human Survivors descended into this world is about to end.
During this time, Han Xing also opened those dozens of Bronze Treasure Chests.
Of course, Bronze Treasure Chests mostly only produce green equipment and blueprints, with a small chance for Skill Books.
He doesn’t lack any of these things now.
He dumped everything the chests opened into the Storage Box.
Han Xing looked at the sky and, after thinking for a while, said, "It’s getting late, let’s not continue exploring other Sky Islands for today, balancing work and rest is also important.
Han Xing wasn’t in a hurry, he opened a newly acquired book, titled "Furniture Crafting Guide".
"Time to start making some furniture!"
Han Xing opened the Furniture Crafting Guide and first made a bed, a pillow, and a blanket for himself.
He also added several chairs, tables, torch stands, a barbecue stand, bonfire stove, and other furniture.
The 66-square-meter platform is no longer small, enough for him to place these facilities.
The originally empty territory now felt a little more like home.
Four one-meter-high torch stands were inserted into the four corners of the territory, each with a Dark Fire Stone on top, flickering lights spread warmth.
Han Xing checked the Exotic Beast Egg hatching progress, the system prompted.
[Hatching in progress, time remaining until full hatching 94 hours 47 minutes 32 seconds...]
Another 94 hours.
After a glance, he no longer paid attention, instead, he lay comfortably on the bed, gazed at the starry sky, and then fell asleep.
The next morning.
A system announcement woke all Survivors from their dreams.
"Announcement: The number of level 2 Survivors in a regional channel has first surpassed 1000 people, the territory points board is now open!"
"Territory Points Board: Survivors gain 1 point for each cubic area of territory expanded, the top 100 Survivors in each region who first reach 1000 points will receive ranking rewards."
Simultaneously, the Blue Star Survivors assigned to different regions started voicing their confusion.
"Territory Points Board? 1000 level 2 Survivors already surpassed?"
"Which region got there so fast?"
At this moment, the people in region 107 channel also shared the same confusion.
But in the next moment, they knew which region got there so fast.
"Announcement: Since 1000 Survivors in your region 107 have first reached LV2 level, you have obtained the ’Heroic Struggle’ state effect."
[Heroic Struggle: During the duration of the points board, all attributes of Survivors increase by 10%.]
"Wow! It’s us in region 107!"
"Brothers are truly fierce! Number one in the whole server!"
"So awesome!"

chapters.title: Chapter 23: Hidden Profession Scroll
paragraphs: The sudden system announcement also startled Han Xing awake.
He saw a new Heroic Struggle effect on his status bar, and a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"Impressive! It seems like everyone in District 107 are all night owls, staying up all night, that’s fierce!" Han Xing sincerely admired.
What he didn’t realize was that District 107’s achievement of the server’s top ranking was partly due to his own contribution.
While all human survivors were in a severe state of water shortage, Han Xing had defeated a Dark Elf Squad and cleverly outwitted a powerful demon, eventually discovering a large water source.
Although it was just a few hundred liters of water traded, when divided among thousands of people, it didn’t seem like much.
Yet, even this small amount revived their vitality and restored their fighting spirit.
With this experience, they became more aware of the necessity to actively explore Sky Island while in good condition to obtain more resources.
This was one of the reasons why District 107’s channel was leading other districts.
Han Xing immediately opened the regional territory points leaderboard.
Currently, the first-ranked person in the entire District 107 channel was impressively himself.
Rank 1: Star River, Territory Points 66.
Rank 2: Black Eagle, Territory Points 42.
Rank 3: Whisperer, Territory Points 35.
Rank 4: Papaya Star Spirit, Territory Points 32.
In the top 100, Han Xing’s personal territory points were far ahead, though the other survivors weren’t lacking either.
Those who made the list had at least double-digit territory points.
This meant they had experienced at least one or several battles and were gradually adjusting to the world’s rhythm.
"The leaderboard? What’s the reward?"
Han Xing looked at the leaderboard interface, and the next moment, the system prompt appeared again.
[Territory Points Leaderboard Rewards Updated.]
Rank 51-100, rewards: Food*10 units, Fresh Water*5 units, Spirit Core*100, Random Advanced Profession Scroll*1.
Rank 21-50, rewards: Food*20 units, Fresh Water*10 units, Spirit Core*200, Choose Green Weapon*1, Random Advanced Profession Scroll*1.
Rank 11-20, rewards: Food*30 units, Fresh Water*15 units, Spirit Core*300, Choose Green Weapon*1, Choose Green Equipment*1, Choose Advanced Profession Scroll*1.
Rank 4-10, rewards: Food*50 units, Fresh Water*20 units, Spirit Core*500, Choose Blue Weapon*1, Choose Advanced Profession Scroll*1.
Rank 3 rewards: Food*100 units, Fresh Water*50 units, Spirit Core*1000, Choose Blue Weapon*1, Silver Treasure Chest*1, Choose Advanced Profession Scroll*1.
Rank 2 rewards: Food*200 units, Fresh Water*50 units, Spirit Core*1000, Choose Blue Weapon Design Map*1, Silver Treasure Chest*1, Choose Advanced Profession Scroll*1.
Han Xing was astonished by the rewards displayed above.
"Silver Treasure Chest and Blue Equipment have appeared, along with Advanced Profession Scrolls; these rewards likely will have many people clamoring for them!"
However, when he saw the first-place reward, his eyes widened instantly.
Rank 1 rewards: Food*500 units, Fresh Water*200 units, Spirit Core*1000, Choose Purple Weapon Design Map*1, Silver Treasure Chest*1, Hidden Profession Scroll*1.
He ignored the rewards before this, focusing solely on the last item.
Hidden Profession Scroll!
When Han Xing was choosing a profession, he’d already decided that his future goal was to switch to the hidden profession, Hunter.
Wild Ranger.
But currently, he hadn’t found any clues regarding the trigger conditions of this hidden profession.
According to Han Xing’s estimation, at least until he reached level eight or nine would he be able to tackle the Wild Ranger’s profession-switch mission.
But now, an opportunity appeared before him.

If he could achieve first place on the leaderboard, he wouldn’t need to bother finding the Wild Ranger’s trigger mission, and upon reaching level 10, he could directly switch to the powerful hidden profession!
In "Sky Island Paradise", no one knew how many hidden professions truly existed.
But since they were concealed, compared to other professions, they might not be necessarily stronger, but they certainly had their unique qualities.
In that instant, Han Xing’s desire to achieve first firmly took hold!
As the points rewards were updated, not only Han Xing saw the reward information, but other survivors also noticed the shocking first-place reward and were envious.
The chat channel was bustling at this moment.
"So many rewards! Even food and water are rewarded by units. Whoever enters the top hundred won’t have to worry about food and drink anymore!"
"Exactly, more importantly, there’s even an Advanced Profession Scroll!

"I saw in the game interface description before that after reaching level 10, if one wants to break through, you’ll need these Advanced Profession Scrolls to become an Advanced Professional, and at that time, your strength will undergo a qualitative change; not only will attributes significantly increase, but you’ll also be able to learn more advanced skills!"
"By then, dealing with creatures under level 10 will be like a parent spanking a child!"
Upon hearing the introduction of advanced professions, many survivors showed a hopeful glimmer in their eyes.
"Gosh, the top ten all have blue weapon rewards, the top three even have a Silver Treasure Chest, that’s too tempting!"
"Indeed, if I could receive one of the top three rewards, I would be satisfied..."
Survivors of District 107 were all discussing the rewards for the top ten, but few were discussing the first-place reward, which was a strange phenomenon.
Finally, someone asked: "Why isn’t anyone talking about the first-place reward? That’s a Hidden Profession! And a Purple Weapon unprecedented so far!"
"Don’t even think about it, look who’s currently number one: our savior from District 107, Star River God!"
Vortex Potato: "That’s my dad! No one fight my dad for first place!"
Meanwhile, in District 107, several organizations at the initial stages of development began urgent discussion meetings.
’Divine Whisper’ discussion group.
"I’m sure everyone has seen it, the rewards for the top 100 are very tempting; if our Divine Whisper has several people in the top 100, basically, our survival issues will be resolved."
The speaker was the third-ranked figure on the leaderboard, Whisperer, who was of the Mage profession.
Whisperer continued: "Therefore, those who still have the strength must explore the clouds around them as much as possible, expand their territory."
"As for me, I’ll strive to catch up and maintain my third position; of course, first place is also my target, so I hope to receive your support..."
Other members responded: "Boss, just say what you need, your brothers will support you.’
"Exactly, support Whisperer Boss!"
Plane Boy Group discussion group.
"Stay energetic, our Plane Boy Group already has three people in the top 100, let’s try to get a few more!"
"We must ensure Papaya Star Spirit Boss secures a top ten position."
"Secure ten, aim for three, pursue one! Papaya Star Spirit Boss, we support you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Getting Ready to Climb the Rankings!
paragraphs: Compared to the lively atmosphere of other discussion groups, group 107 seemed a bit strange.
That was the Dusk Mercenaries discussion group.
In the group, a Survivor named Vulture asked, "Captain, this time, do you think you have a chance at first place?"
Meanwhile, on a certain Sky Island Territory, a man dressed in full Stalker Equipment with a gloomy expression stopped in his tracks.
He was the one in second place on the Points leaderboard, Black Eagle.
Seeing the message in the discussion group, he didn’t immediately reply but responded tersely, "Difficult, will try my best."
Others said incredulously, "Captain, even you have no confidence in taking the top spot from that Star River? You are, after all..."
Black Shadow was silent for a moment before replying again, "He’s strong, I can’t see through him."
"But I will try my best."
Han Xing climbed out of bed, re-energized.
Seeing the chat on the local network, the enthusiasm among the Survivors in Channel 107 was high.
"Great, it seems everyone is in high Spirit!"
Han Xing stretched out his body and clenched his fist, "I should also start pushing for the leaderboard!"
"But before hitting the leaderboard, there are some things I need to do first."
He opened the blueprint tab and made over five hundred Fine Iron Arrows in one go.
It consumed over a thousand pieces of Refined Iron, but with his current material reserves, it wasn’t a big deal.
Then, Han Xing started mass-producing containers, the relevant blueprints were in the furniture encyclopedia.
He made glass bottles in large, medium, and small sizes, with the small bottles holding 100ml, medium ones 500ml, and large ones 1000ml.
As they were made from special materials, the glass bottles were quite resistant to dropping and impact.
He collected all the Spiritual Spring Water from the pool on the ground and put it into the Storage Box, clapping his hands as he stood up.
"Great, now I don’t have to worry about monsters rushing into my Territory and destroying the Spiritual Spring Water reserves during battle."
After finishing all this, Han Xing pondered for a moment and joined the discussion group of the three of them.
Han Xing: "Guys, did you see the announcement? Want to give it a shot and aim for the top ten?"

Cheng Jianyong: "Brother Xing... you have too much faith in us, don’t you? My Territory Points just reached 12, not even in the top 100... Brother Yun might have a chance, he’s got 20 Points now, ranked 91st."
Han Xing was a bit surprised to hear that, "Already in the top 100? Not bad, Xiaoyun!"

Shen Yun also replied, "It’s alright, mostly thanks to that Skill Book you gave me, Brother Xing. It has been very helpful, allowing me to venture into places I dared not explore before. With ’Holy Light Healing’, I’ve been able to challenge more and recover from multiple injuries."
"In the early stages, a Skill Book really makes a big difference!"
Cheng Jianyong listened enviously, and somewhat resentfully said, "I’m so envious... Brother Xing treats you so well. If I had a Skill Book too, I might have made the top 50 by now."
Shen Yun retorted disdainfully, "Keep dreaming, there are nearly ten thousand people in Area 107, many hidden masters for sure, don’t underestimate them."
But Cheng Jianyong wasn’t convinced, "Give me a Skill Book, and I’ll definitely make the top 50!
Then he said rather dramatically, "Emperor Jianyong, I am not inferior to others!"
Han Xing: "..."
Shen Yun: "..."
Han Xing said exasperatedly, "Cheng Jianyong, stop with the cringe."
Cheng Jianyong laughed sheepishly.
At this point, Han Xing continued, "Seriously, if I gave you a Skill Book, could you really make the top 50?"
Cheng Jianyong realized something instantly and said excitedly, "Brother Xing, is it...?"
Han Xing smiled.
Cheng Jianyong eagerly asked, "Brother Xing, do you really have it? Let me see what a Warrior Skill Book looks like!"
His tone was full of longing, but Han Xing said, "Wait a minute, I haven’t finished speaking."
"You just said, one Skill Book could get you into the top 50, what if I gave you two?"
Cheng Jianyong paused for a second and then cautiously said, "Two... two books! Then... top 20?"
"Three books!"
"Gasp..."
This time, not only Cheng Jianyong was unsettled, even Shen Yun’s breathing quickened.
Both of their eyes were filled with desire, and Cheng Jianyong eagerly exclaimed, "Brother Xing, from now on, you’re my real brother!"
"I’ll do whatever you ask, go wherever you want me to, I’m your biggest fan!"
Based on their understanding of Han Xing, they knew he wouldn’t joke about non-existent things. Since he said it, it meant he really had them.
At this moment, Shen Yun also spoke in a sharp voice, "Brother Xing, I want it too..."
The sound made their skin crawl.
Cheng Jianyong cursed, "Damn, Shen Yun, you’re disgusting, losing face for a Skill Book."
But Shen Yun quickly retorted, "Cheng Jianyong, you’re one to talk, you’re just as bad!"
"You’re disgusting!"
"You’re shameless!"
Hearing them bicker, Han Xing laughed, "Alright, stop messing around."
"Both of you will get one, not just Skill Books but also Green Equipment, Weapons, I have them all, I’ll trade them to you now."
Han Xing initiated a trade request with them.
As they watched the trading window fill with Skill Books covering all early-stage Professions, followed by Armor and Weapons...
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong both felt a sense of unreality.
"Brother... Brother Xing, are these really for us?"
Both of them were unsure, knowing the value of these items all too well.
But before they could recover from the shock, they saw an additional 20 liters of Spiritual Spring Water in the trade window.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong’s incredulous eyes turned vacant.
They weren’t fools. After seeing so much precious Spiritual Spring Water and recalling what had been happening on the chat channels lately, they guessed Han Xing’s identity.
Cheng Jianyong tentatively asked, "Brother... Brother Xing, the one currently ranked first, Star River, that’s you, isn’t it?"
"That’s right."
Han Xing openly admitted it, telling them his virtual name wasn’t a big deal.
"Gasp..."
Hearing Han Xing’s admission, both simultaneously gasped.
Shen Yun also said, "I had guessed before, but I never dared to be sure, but it turns out, it’s really you, Brother Xing!"
Cheng Jianyong said with a hint of resentment, "So Brother Xing is Star River God. I was wondering who had the ability to gather so many water resources so quickly!"
Han Xing laughed, "You guys never asked!"
"Alright, hurry and accept it all, we need to push for the leaderboard."
"Feel free to drink the Spiritual Spring Water; if it’s not enough, I have more, just don’t die."
Han Xing closed the discussion group.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were still chatting.
Cheng Jianyong said, "It’s incredible that Brother Xing gave us so much, there’s no way we can avoid making a push now."
Shen Yun agreed, "With this Equipment and Skills, climbing to the top ten should be no problem. You better work hard; don’t shame Brother Xing."
"Haha, I definitely won’t, Shen Yun, I’ll tell you, within two days, I’ll surpass you!"
"Heh... anyone can brag, you’ll never surpass me."
"Let’s see then!"
Spurred on by confidence, Shen Yun said before exiting chat.
"By the way, don’t tell anyone about Brother Xing’s identity."
"Don’t worry, I’m not stupid."
At this time, Han Xing maneuvered the Sky Island Territory forward.
The nearby clouds within tens of kilometers were all of similar size.
The smallest ones were about ten cubic meters, the largest were comparable to the Dark Elf Camp, around thirty cubic meters.
For Han Xing, the monsters inside these clouds posed no threat.
He approached a cloud mass and started to engage, with a system prompt coming through.
"There seems to be a cold presence within, do you wish to enter?"
Han Xing clicked enter directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Elite Creatures, High Level Zone Unlocked
paragraphs: The clouds dispersed, revealing a snow-white monster.
[Frost Slime (One-Star Creature)]
[Level: LV3]
[Power 10, Agility 7, Spirit 8, Constitution 8]
[Skills: Frost Armor, Snowball Throwing.]
As this round creature exuding a trace of coldness appeared, Han Xing shot an arrow without hesitation.
"Wind Chasing Arrow, go!"
The Fine Iron Arrow, carrying the breath of the wind, moved unimaginably fast.
The powerful penetration instantly pierced through the Slime’s ice crystal shell.
Crack!
With a crisp sound, the ice crystal shattered.
This arrow, together with the end of the arrow, went entirely into the Slime’s body...
The Frost Slime’s body trembled violently.
Han Xing’s eyes brightened; he had hit the Slime’s vital spot.
"Tsk tsk, with a few new pieces of equipment, the attack power is just not the same. I never thought one arrow could severely injure a level 3 monster."
"Lucky for you, you’re a Slime. If you were a humanoid creature with a head, this arrow would have directly exploded your head, ha ha ha."
Hearing Han Xing’s sinister laughter, the Frost Slime in front widened its eyes in terror.
"Poor Slime, let me shoot... no, let me free you!"
Han Xing pulled back the bowstring and shot a second arrow, then a system notification appeared.
[You have killed Frost Slime lv3, gaining 30 experience points.]
[Your territory range has expanded.]
After merging this Slime’s territory, Han Xing’s territory area reached 72 cubic units, and he remained first on the leaderboard.
Without stopping, Han Xing continued to engage other clouds.
[You have killed Red Fire Fox lv3, gaining 30 experience points, and your territory range has expanded.]
[You have killed Black-maned Wild Boar lv3, gaining 30 experience points, and your territory range has expanded.]
[You have killed...]
One system notification after another appeared. From morning until the sun was about to set, Han Xing almost never paused.
In the continuous exploration of clouds, he also encountered many monsters successively.
Jade Frog, Lightning Slime, Hunched Wild Boar Group...
Monsters fell one after another under his arrows.
Han Xing harvested a large amount of experience, and the experience bar below his character panel reached 90% of level 2.
Meanwhile, his territory area also nearly doubled, with Han Xing firmly holding the first place on the territory leaderboard with 129 points.
Moreover, he was the only one whose territory area had broken through three digits.
The current second place, Papaya Star Spirit, had later overtaken Whisperer and Black Eagle with 95 points.
However, the gap between them was not large, and the others were closely following.
Han Xing pondered, "It seems the competition on the leaderboard is very fierce."
Not only was it fierce, but he didn’t know that the chat channel in area 107 was almost breaking out in arguments over this ranking.
The leaderboard’s second, third, and fourth places were all dominated by powerful entities, and several other factions in the top ten.
Motivated by interested parties, they seemed intent on disrupting the competitors on the leaderboard, and heated arguments had erupted in the chat channel.
Except for the Dusk Mercenary Corps, where Black Shadow was more low-key, other groups had all joined the spray war.
Of course, none of this concerned Han Xing.
As the sun set behind the western mountains, a crescent moon climbed the treetops.
In the moonlight, a human dressed in leather armor and holding an iron bow was battling a Gray Rock Giant Wolf.
With agile movements, he continuously leaped back and forth on the suspended platform, avoiding the Gray Rock Giant Wolf’s assaults, and then taking advantage of the gap to draw his bow and shoot.
This person was Han Xing.
"Brother Wolf, hurry up, run faster! Didn’t you eat? My dog runs faster than you!"
"Are you really a wolf, or are you just a little earth dog in wolf’s clothing?"
As he tangled with the giant wolf, Han Xing spewed trash talk.
Even though he didn’t know whether the giant wolf could understand, his disruption tactics indeed worked.
The giant wolf’s eyes turned increasingly red, blood vessels visible.
It became angrier, let out a roar, and lunged at Han Xing.
Just then, the opposing human Hunter’s eyes suddenly sharpened, and an arrow with a hint of green shot over at terrifying speed, seeming to tear through the air.
The Gray Rock Giant Wolf had no chance to dodge, allowing this arrow to stab into its abdomen.
"Got it!" Han Xing exclaimed excitedly.
Seeing the Gray Rock Giant Wolf’s increasingly sluggish movement, he knew that the neurotoxin applied to the arrowhead had taken effect.
Han Xing breathed a sigh of relief, thinking, "This Elite Monster is really hard to deal with; after taking so many arrows from me, it’s still lively."
Indeed, this Gray Rock Giant Wolf was a powerful Elite Wild Monster.
When Han Xing was clearing the last cloud in the area, he encountered it and a battle ensued.
The monster’s attributes appeared before him.
[Gray Rock Giant Wolf (One-Star Elite Creature)]
[Level: lv3]
[Power 15, Agility 20, Spirit 11, Constitution 18]
[Skills: Rapid Assault, Tearing Bite, Bloodthirsty.]
A true Elite Creature with three full skills, coupled with its formidable attributes, and at the current stage, for human Survivors, it’s deadly upon contact.
Han Xing knew this might be related to his exploration speed.
This region’s clouds had mostly been conquered by him; this giant wolf was likely the strongest monster in the area apart from the Dark Elf Squad, equivalent to a mini-boss of the region.
At this moment, seven or eight iron arrows were stuck in the Gray Rock Giant Wolf, although none had hit vital spots, the neurotoxin continuously taking effect was making it increasingly weak.
The Gray Rock Giant Wolf’s movements gradually slowed down, at this moment, it seemed to know that its fate was sealed.
The ferocity in the giant wolf’s gaze was replaced by a trace of calm, it looked at Han Xing and then glanced around.
The Gray Rock Giant Wolf seemed to make a decision, howled to the sky, and then suddenly leaped into Han Xing’s territory.
Seeing this, Han Xing narrowed his eyes, readying for the giant wolf’s attack at any moment.
However, the Gray Rock Giant Wolf’s target was not him, instead, it charged straight for the five storage boxes at the territory’s edge.
"Cunning creature, you want to cause damage to my territory before dying?"
Han Xing remained unflustered and raised his bow and arrow.
The next moment, the Multi-Shot skill activated.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
In quick succession, five piercing sounds rang out, five iron arrows shot at the Gray Rock Giant Wolf’s massive body with terrifying speed.
Pfft! Pfft! Pfft!
Four out of five arrows hit their target.
The Gray Rock Giant Wolf, whose consciousness was already blurred, staggered briefly after taking more hits, and eventually, it fell.
[You have killed Gray Rock Giant Wolf (Elite Level) lv3, gaining 150 experience points]
[Your level has increased.]
"Leveled up!"
Reaching level 3, Han Xing checked his panel and nodded, "Not bad, agility increased by 3 points, while power, spirit, and constitution each increased by 1 point."
Over the past two days, he had almost figured out the leveling bonus pattern for human Survivors.
Before reaching level 10, and becoming an Advanced Professional, each level up generally grants 4-6 points in attributes.
Then, corresponding attributes will increase based on one’s professional specialty.
For example, Hunter’s agility, Warrior’s power, Mage’s spirit, and the Holy Profession’s spirit and body dual attributes.
At this moment, a different notification appeared.
[You have killed the Elite Monster in this region, you can now explore higher-level areas]
[Please note, monsters in higher-level areas will become more powerful, so Survivors should choose wisely during exploration.]
