chapters.title: Chapter 26: Fierce Competition, Narrowing Gap
paragraphs: [Please note, monsters in the advanced area will become more powerful, so survivors should choose cautiously during exploration.]
"Advanced area?"
Han Xing looked around and noticed that indeed, there were many more clouds in the distant sky, varying in size.
The number is significantly higher than that in the current area.
"So I was always in the novice area before, and only after defeating the strongest monster in this area can I move to the advanced map."

Han Xing seemed to understand some of the mechanics of this game, shook his head, "Never mind, that area is still far away from me, at the current pace, it would take at least four to five hours, let’s talk about it tomorrow."
With this thought, Han Xing decided to deal with the loot in front of him first.
He walked over to the body of the Gray Rock Giant Wolf and directly disassembled it.

[Successfully disassembled Gray Rock Giant Wolf’s body, recovered Fine Iron Arrow*13, obtained One-star High-quality Beast Hide*1, obtained Thick Wolf Meat 104kg, obtained Beast Heart*1, obtained Strong Blood*5...]
"High-quality Beast Hide?"
Han Xing looked at the thick fur on the ground, "I remember it can be used to make Blue Leather Armor, good stuff!"
As for the Beast Heart and Strong Blood, he hadn’t figured out their usage yet, so he put them all away for now.
There wasn’t much good stuff in the territory of this Gray Rock Giant Wolf, but after Han Xing merged the Sky Island, he found some unexpected surprises.
Under the moonlight, at the edge of the giant wolf’s territory, a few rock geological territories were glittering with silver light.
"Treasure!" Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
He walked over, squatted down, and observed for a moment.
Han Xing said somewhat uncertainly, "There should be some kind of ore in here."
"Should I dig?"
Thinking of this, Han Xing took out an iron pick from his backpack and began to strike vigorously.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
The sound of metal striking stone constantly rang out.
When Han Xing chipped off the stone blocks covering these ores, finally revealing the silver-glimmering ore inside, the system prompt appeared at this time.
[Secret Silver Ore, requires smelting, can extract Secret Silver from inside.]
"Smelting?"
Han Xing was puzzled, "I don’t have the equipment, do I have to build a smelting workshop?"
Although Secret Silver is a good material, it’s also the main material for making other Blue Equipment.
But it seems that at the current stage of survivors, they still can’t refine this metal.
Unless a future version update opens territory construction functions.
At that time, survivors can construct various facilities in their territories, such as smelting workshops, weapon research institutes, fortifications, even including taverns, etc.
Currently, Secret Silver is only obtainable with a small chance from treasure chests.
Han Xing previously received over twenty Secret Silver Ingots, also thanks to the efforts of those players known as the Emperor of Luck, of course, this chance is very small.
Since it’s temporarily impossible to refine Secret Silver, Han Xing stuffed all these Secret Silver Ores into the Storage Box.
Then, he looked at the Points Ranking.
First place: Star River, Territory Points 184.
Second place: Whisperer, Territory Points 162.
Third place: Black Eagle, Territory Points 123.
Fourth place: Papaya Star Spirit, Territory Points 115.
Fifth place...
"Hmm? That Whisperer is catching up? Black Eagle also surpassed Papaya Star Spirit, taking third place?"
Seeing the points ranking, Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
The gap between him and Whisperer has been gradually narrowing, the opponent is also working hard to catch up.
But thinking about it, it makes sense, although he is equipped with nearly a full set of Green Armor, in reality, the attribute gap between him and other survivors is not significant.
As survivors continue to explore outward, they will also find various equipment, skill books, etc., in other territories.
Even if not for their own use, it can be exchanged on the trading channel.
The strength of survivors is steadily increasing, especially among those few top players, who are improving rapidly.
Of course, there are corresponding costs behind this as well.
Han Xing noticed that the 10,000 survivors in Area 107 have already decreased to 9,632 people.
This means that over three days, just in this area, more than 300 people have lost their lives!
According to this ratio, the current death toll of human survivors could have reached a terrifying number.
Although most of these people died due to accidents, as survival difficulty increases later, encountering more powerful monsters, this number will continue to soar.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong in the discussion group said, "Brother Xing, that Whisperer has something, he’s about to catch up with you!"
Ever since knowing Han Xing is indeed Star River, Cheng Jianyong has been closely following the leaderboard.
Han Xing replied, "Yes, very strong indeed, if I’m not mistaken, he should be a Mage profession."
"Mage?"
"Yes."

Han Xing affirmed, "The Mage’s first five skills, four of them are offensive skills, Whisperer as a team’s captain, probably gathered all of them with the help of his team members, plus the equipment’s enhancement, Mage’s exploration speed is indeed faster than other professions."
"I see." Cheng Jianyong realized and asked further, "Brother Xing, how do you know all this?"
"Read more of the game introductions, you can know this too."
Han Xing paused, continued, "By the way, what’s your ranking now?"
"Huh?" Cheng Jianyong seemed a bit puzzled, "Brother Xing, didn’t you look at the leaderboard? Both I and Brother Yun are on the list now!"
"You didn’t tell me your virtual names, how would I know what you are called?"
"You didn’t ask either."
Han Xing: "..."
"Stop joking, quickly tell me what you’re called."
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Alright, I am called ’Lone Brave’, Brother Yun is called ’Yun Tianming’.
Han Xing: "Such cheesy names..."
"Right? I think Yun Tianming sounds very cheesy too."
"I’m talking about you."
Cheng Jianyong: "???"

At this moment, Shen Yun was still working hard on territory points overnight, not seeing the conversation between the two in the discussion group, otherwise, he would certainly quarrel with Cheng Jianyong for at least half an hour.
Han Xing opened the leaderboard and saw the name ’Lone Brave’ ranked at 65th with 33 points.
And ’Yun Tianming’, who is Shen Yun, surprisingly had rushed into the top forty, occupying the 37th with 57 points.
Han Xing was somewhat surprised but upon thinking, it was within expectation.

After all, he had given them almost a complete set of high-quality green armor, and so many skill books, along with a large amount of Spiritual Spring Water, they could explore boldly without much worry.
Having such a fast leaderboard climb speed is only natural.
After closing the chat, Han Xing continued to approach other clouds.
After leveling up to level 3, the speed of the Sky Island increased to 8 meters/second, which is equivalent to a speed of 28.8 km/h, already quite fast.
During the process of the Sky Island moving, Han Xing also glanced at the chat channel.
After a whole day of fighting and exploration, survivors shared their experiences inside.

"Damn, my luck was really bad today, encountered an elite-level jungle tiger while exploring a territory, almost got bitten to death, if it weren’t for using an ancestral Divine Skill slide tackle, I would have been done there."

"What you faced is nothing, today I ran into a huge bear, it slapped and broke over a dozen ribs, fortunately, I’m a sports student, ran about ten kilometers carrying it until the bear got exhausted and let me go."
"You guys are awesome, compared to you, getting bitten by a Five-Step Snake seems trivial."
"Bro, can you still talk after being bitten by a Five-Step Snake?"
"Oh, because I pulled out its venomous fangs, a bite doesn’t hurt, actually feels comfortable, planning to keep it as a pet."
"Bro, you’re really twisted..."
The chat channel filled with speechless symbols.
At this moment, someone said, "Stop joking, check it out, Papaya Star Spirit has released another strategy."
"The expert released another strategy? I followed his posts before and avoided several monster-hidden clouds based on the tips."
"Me too, thanks to Papaya Star Spirit’s strategy, I easily opened a Bronze Treasure Chest."
"Quick, see what it is this time?"
Everyone clicked to see it, prominently recognizing Papaya Star Spirit’s strategy post, and already had hundreds of replies in a short time.
But the post title was different from before, revealing a serious tone.
"Alert! Dark Elf Squad!"

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Whisperer
paragraphs: The post title is: "Beware! Dark Elf Squad!"
Upon clicking it, a few pictures of monsters and their attributes appeared prominently.
Their slender bodies and pointed ears revealed their identity: Dark Elves.
The configuration of the Dark Elf squad that Papaya Star Spirit encountered was similar to what Han Xing faced.
In the post, Papaya Star Spirit emphasized the strength and intense aggression of these Dark Elves.
He narrowly escaped with his life, almost meeting his end there.
Then, he warned other Survivors to pay attention to system prompts. If there’s a prompt mentioning ’Fallen Creatures’, they must not enter, or danger will be imminent.
After reading the post, many Survivors couldn’t help but feel fortunate.
"Dark Elves, such powerful monsters, I hope we don’t encounter them."
"Yeah, luckily Papaya Star Spirit is willing to share intelligence, and thank goodness he’s strong enough. Otherwise, if it were us, we might have been killed instantly by the Dark Elves."
After reading the chat channel information, Han Xing pondered.
Papaya Star Spirit also encountered a Dark Elf squad, but the things this group of Dark Elves were guarding seemed to be a Silver Treasure Chest, not Spiritual Spring Water.
"This means that not every Dark Elf is accompanied by a water source; there might be other treasures."
Thinking of this, Han Xing felt slightly relieved.
Because this means his Spiritual Spring Water can still be monopolized for a while.
However, it also reminded him that the strength of Survivors is gradually increasing, and soon they will be able to solve the water source problem on their own.

Han Xing immediately thought: "I need to quickly distribute another batch of Spiritual Spring Water, or else when people are no longer bothered about water sources, Spiritual Spring Water will lose its value."
With this thought, Han Xing opened the trading channel.
Compared to yesterday, there were thousands more trade messages above.
Han Xing’s lips curled into a smile.
"Everyone’s really working hard, they must have found a lot of materials today, right?"
"With such effort, they must be quite thirsty too, right?"
"Wouldn’t they love a sip of sweet Spiritual Spring Water right now?"
Han Xing continuously let out sinister laughter. Realizing his overreaction, he quickly wiped the drool from the corner of his mouth.
Then, he put the Spiritual Spring Water back on the shelf.
Compared to yesterday, this time there were more conditions for exchanging Spiritual Spring Water.

The Green Equipment Blueprint was removed, adding other blueprints such as various territory buildings and defensive structures. Additionally, Strong Blood, various herbs, Mithril, and other materials were added for exchange.
The appearance of Spiritual Spring Water once again caused a sensation.
Although not as heated as yesterday, Han Xing still traded for quite a few materials.
After two or three hours of trading.
Han Xing distributed 432 liters of Spiritual Spring Water, exchanging for three Storage Boxes full and materials for 2550 Storage Spaces.
Among them, he obtained 21,643 Spirit Cores, 45,387 blocks of Refined Iron, 103 One-star Beast Hides, and 86,646 units of Rare Earth...
There were also Ether, Dark Fire Stones, Moonlight Grass, and many other materials, which could be called a massive haul.
However, he didn’t trade for any Blue Equipment or blueprints.
Other Survivors weren’t foolish; they naturally knew the value of such items.
It wasn’t like yesterday where even a drop of water was hard to find in the trading channel; some teams, more or less, found some drinking water.
Nonetheless, for now, the healing property of Spiritual Spring Water remains unparalleled, with no competition.
At this moment, Han Xing pondered: "There are still over 800 liters of Spiritual Spring Water; I should be able to sell them one more time, which would be tomorrow."
"After this sale, the market for Spiritual Spring Water will start to shrink, and I won’t be able to continue collecting materials from players’ hands."

"But it’s okay; early preparations are almost done. Once I obtain a batch of blue blueprints, I can use these materials to mass-produce equipment, then sell them to other Survivors, starting a new cycle of collection."
"By then, I’ll store most of the materials. Once the territory reaches a certain scale, I’ll start mass constructing large-scale defensive fortifications to make my territory impenetrable."
"Then, I’ll obtain new equipment blueprints and continue this model to grow stronger and bigger!"
At this thought, Han Xing’s smile was almost uncontainable.
Han Xing had made a preliminary plan for his future development and was prepared for potential changes mid-way, such as version updates, to which he would adapt accordingly.
However, no matter how things would change, he had an advantage that no other Survivor had.
That was a 100% success rate in crafting!
As long as he had the corresponding blueprint, even a Divine Artifact, he could mass-produce it for you!
He didn’t believe that other Survivors could resist equipment of higher quality and stronger attributes.
And as long as there was demand, Han Xing could profit greatly from it.
With this in mind, Han Xing looked up at the sky.
It was already late at night. After a whole day of exploration and consecutive battles, he was a bit tired.
"That’s it for today; fighting in a fatigued state is not a wise decision."
He checked the Exotic Beast Egg incubation on the system interface.
[Remaining incubation time: 76 hours, 17 minutes, 48 seconds...]
"Still over seventy hours to go until it hatches, hopefully, the creature inside this Exotic Beast Egg won’t disappoint me..."
Han Xing lay back on his bed, ready to sleep again.
Meanwhile.
Not long after Han Xing fell asleep, in the Sky Island Territory of other Survivors.
A middle-aged man dressed in a Mage’s Robe, holding a Bronze Staff, was battling a group of forest wild boars.
He waved his Staff, and a fireball the size of a basin gradually took shape.
Then, he hurled the fireball into the group of wild boars without hesitation.
With a loud bang, the wild boars erupted into a cacophony of screams.
Next, several thumb-thick Ice Arrows shot forth, piercing through the wild boars’ bodies in an instant, leaving gushing blood holes.
At that moment, a large-bodied Elite Monster in the group quickly charged forward, its eyes blazing red, rushing towards the Human Mage like a small mountain.
The Human Mage remained calm and composed, waving his hand, he executed a Qi Burst, widening the gap between himself and the wild boar.
Suddenly, a bolt of lightning struck down from the sky, hitting the Elite Wild Boar squarely on its head.
Zap!
The Elite Wild Boar stiffened instantly, black smoke rising from its body, and the Human Mage standing nearby could even smell the aroma of roasting meat.
The Elite Wild Boar collapsed, leaving only some ordinary wild boars in the Sky Island Territory. The outcome of the ensuing battle was no longer in doubt.
After the entire wild boar group was annihilated, the Human Mage lifted the hood of his robe, revealing the face of a middle-aged man.
He was the leader of ’Divine Whisper’, Whisperer, currently ranked second on the Points Ranking.
Whisperer crouched down, a smile appeared on his lips as he said, "Very good, this Sky Island is 12 square units in area, which will considerably increase my points!"
He quickly merged the wild boar territory with his Sky Island.
On the leaderboard, Whisperer’s territory points jumped from 164 to 176 in an instant, just 8 points shy of surpassing Han Xing to claim the first spot!
Whisperer pondered, "Star River’s points haven’t changed for a while, could it be... this guy went to sleep?"
Thinking he had figured it out, Whisperer chuckled, "So carefree, but this gives me a chance."
"Star River, while you’re sleeping, I’m going to surpass you and claim the first position, that Hidden Profession Scroll will be mine!"
After saying this, Whisperer controlled his Sky Island, continuing to venture towards the next location.
However, he failed to notice that his pupils were already filled with bloodshot veins.
Meanwhile, Black Eagle, ranked third, and Papaya Star Spirit, ranked fourth, were also racing against time to explore.
As night deepened, the top three positions on the leaderboard quietly changed.

"Star River, while you’re sleeping, I’m going to surpass you and claim the first position, that Hidden Profession Scroll will be mine!"
After saying this, Whisperer controlled his Sky Island, continuing to venture towards the next location.
However, he failed to notice that his pupils were already filled with bloodshot veins.
Meanwhile, Black Eagle, ranked third, and Papaya Star Spirit, ranked fourth, were also racing against time to explore.
As night deepened, the top three positions on the leaderboard quietly changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Ranking Changes
paragraphs: The next day.
As soon as Han Xing opened his eyes, he saw many private messages, all sent by other survivors.
In the discussion group, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were also mentioning him.
"Hmm? So many people looking for me?"
Curiously, Han Xing clicked into the discussion group.
Soon, he figured out the context and story.

It turns out that last night while he was sleeping, the existence called Whisperer was grinding intensely through the night, and finally in the early morning hours, surpassed him in territory points, taking the first place.
Moreover, he was promoting his team ’Divine Whisper’ in the chat channel, recruiting other survivors to join.
The effect was significant; many survivors had already joined them, and now, Divine Whisper was about to become the largest team in District 107.
Han Xing chuckled, "This Whisperer, truly a dedicated grinder."
"Speaking of which, staying up all night like that, is he really not feeling fatigued? How long can he maintain this state?"
He stroked his chin, seemingly contemplating something.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong was furiously mentioning Han Xing in the discussion group.
"@Star River, Brother Xing! Wake up, you’re no longer first!"
"Brother Xing, my bro..."
Han Xing helplessly opened the discussion group, replying: "Why panic, the points board has only been open for two days. It’s still early to reach 1000 points."

Seeing Han Xing’s reply, Cheng Jianyong quickly said: "But didn’t you say that this Whisperer is likely a Mage profession, and can explore much faster than you? Now that the gap has widened, it’ll be hard to catch up."
"And, on the current leaderboard, that Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit are about to overtake you too!"
Cheng Jianyong seemed more anxious than Han Xing.
However, Han Xing leisurely replied: "Don’t worry, rushing won’t help; if they want to compete, let them.
We just need to maintain our own pace and not risk challenging those dangerous clouds to chase rankings."
"They won’t be able to maintain this state for long. Even the most strong-willed person can’t fight high-intensity battles without sleep."
Beside him, Shen Yun echoed: "Brother Xing is right; their current state is too risky."
"I experienced it the night before last, staying up all night grinding, and the next day my combat state dropped significantly, nearly being bitten to death by monsters several times!"
Upon speaking, Shen Yun felt a bit frightened and said: "So, don’t be fooled by their current frenzy; in reality, they are walking on a tightrope, and any mistake will result in a heavy price."
Cheng Jianyong also realized his impatience, awkwardly chuckling twice.
Just then, Shen Yun seemed to recall something, saying: "Cheng Jianyong, you should also take it easy. Don’t risk your life for the rankings. Remember what the system alert said?"
Cheng Jianyong suddenly remembered something, and his face changed drastically: "Damn! I almost forgot!"
"The system alert said that after a month, the weak will be sent to their relatives, meaning that in a month, my wife and child will come to this world."
"If something happens to me now..."
Cheng Jianyong instantly broke into a cold sweat.
"Sweating profusely, huh, buddy?" Shen Yun teased.
Cheng Jianyong didn’t respond; his family was extremely important to him.
But since he had been in this world for just a few days, nothing was quite adapted yet, so much so that he hadn’t had time to consider these things.
Now, he suddenly remembered that in a month, he would reunite with his family in this world.
In his heart, Cheng Jianyong made a silent decision.
He must not let his family experience the same dangers as he did, and he definitely couldn’t allow himself to die in this world before they even arrive!
Then, Cheng Jianyong said in the discussion group: "You’re right, I can’t let anything happen here. I need to protect Qianqian."
"Brother Yun, Brother Xing, you must be careful too!"
Shen Yun said indifferently: "I’m fine; back home, it’s just my old man and my mom, and they’re still quite healthy. Only Brother Xing..."
Han Xing’s situation was something they were aware of. Han Xing was parentless, living alone and growing up by himself.
Han Xing smiled, saying: "Just take care of yourselves; I wouldn’t want strangers popping up next month claiming to be my long-lost parents."
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong didn’t continue the topic.

After a pause, Han Xing continued to instruct: "Nowadays, the monsters you’re encountering are getting stronger. If you come across creatures you can’t beat, remember to escape if possible, and never take risks in confrontation."
"If injured, drink Spiritual Spring Water. Don’t worry about consumption; there’s plenty, whatever you need, I have."
"Remember, don’t get killed."
Han Xing solemnly advised, and the two nodded solemnly in agreement.
Meanwhile, other survivors were also discussing Han Xing’s ranking.
Divine Whisper discussion group.

A survivor named Moonlight Cat said: "That ’Star River’s’ rank hasn’t changed. This guy is probably still sleeping in; our Whisperer leader is industrious, with this momentum, he’s bound to take first place!"
Other discussion group members echoed: "That’s right, Whisperer leader is the strongest."
"Heaven rewards diligence; the leader will surely be first!"
Whisperer had just surpassed 200 points. Seeing the group chat, a thin smile surfaced on his pallid face.
He coughed lightly, saying: "If we truly get first place, it’s not solely due to my efforts, thanks to all the brothers’ help."
If it weren’t for you gathering a few Mage skill books and Mage equipment for me, I couldn’t have surpassed Star River so quickly.
After listening, the team members flattered: "The leader is humble. Your strength is outstanding."
"That’s right. Star River and Black Eagle have no chance against the leader’s true strength!"
Whisperer’s smile grew wider; he seemed to relish the praise from everyone.

Especially as he looked at the leaderboard, with the previously trending ’Star River’ trampled underfoot, waves of satisfaction surged within him, vanquishing even the fatigue from last night’s endless battle.

But to not show it, he remarked on the local network: "Everyone, don’t be too complacent. Continue exploring the clouds actively; I hope our Divine Whisper group can push several more people into the top hundred rankings."
"Okay, we’ll listen to the leader!"
Whisperer’s words received many responses, achieving a widely recognized status in District 107.
At this moment, someone in the discussion group said: "Look quickly, Star River’s points have changed!"
Just now, they saw Han Xing’s territory points jump from 184 to 196, suddenly increasing by 12 points.
Whisperer’s heart sank, realizing that Han Xing was starting to pick up the pace.
Thinking of this, he closed the discussion chat, took a deep breath as if dispelling internal fatigue, once again eyeing the distant clouds.
Not only on the side of Divine Whisper, other group survivors also began their sprint.
Everyone unconsciously sped up their exploration progress.
In just a morning.
The leaderboard was constantly shifting.
New names occasionally broke into the rankings, and sometimes someone’s rank surged by over ten places, showing fierce competition.
In Han Xing’s case, after a morning of exploration, not only didn’t his ranking increase but dropped to third place.
During which Black Eagle surpassed him.
As everyone’s attributes catch up, with skills and equipment becoming quite similar, what’s left is a battle of individual combat awareness.
In this aspect, Han Xing was evidently not skilled, at least not compared to those top-tier contenders.
These individuals, before descending to ’Sky Island Paradise,’ perhaps had different identities and specialties.
Such as soldiers, boxers, mercenaries, etc.
These identities helped them better survive in this world.
Local channel, everyone started a heated discussion on the ranking changes.
"It’s over... Star God has dropped another rank; even Papaya Star Spirit is about to catch up. He might not even maintain the top three!"
"I see that possibility. Star River initially traded much water for lots of equipment, gaining previous advantages. Now that everyone’s equipment and skills are catching up, his advantage is waning."
"I see... I thought Star God would definitely take first this time."
"How is that possible? Our District 107 has many experts; it’s very challenging for Star River to claim first place!"
Regarding Han Xing, there was a wave of skepticism in the local network.

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Torrential Downpour
paragraphs: In the chat channel, there was a chorus of pessimism.
But as the subject of the heated discussion, Han Xing was casually drawing his bow and shooting arrows.
In front of him, a few giant pangolin-like monsters lay at his feet.
After half a day’s time, Han Xing had also arrived at the so-called high-level area.
Here, the survivors seemed like they had left the newbie safe zone.
The clouds in this vicinity were larger, casually encountering clouds of several dozen square meters, with the strength of the monsters inside rising continuously.
Han Xing didn’t take risks or explore the large clouds to compete on the leaderboard.
Previously, the encounter in the Dark Elf territory was still fresh in his mind.
He opted for steady progress, specifically maneuvering Sky Island to approach clouds of only a dozen square meters.
Compared to the top three on the leaderboard with an increase of dozens of square meters, Han Xing’s pace was merely a snail’s pace.
But he wasn’t in a hurry.
Today was the second day of the points leaderboard, and the Whisperer ranked first with only about 260 points.
At this rate, the daily growth in the area was at most a hundred to two hundred square meters. To reach 1000 points, it would take at least three to four more days.
While everyone was engrossed in exploration.
In the afternoon at sunset, suddenly dark clouds covered the sky, and thunder rumbled.
At this moment, all survivors instinctively stopped what they were doing and lifted their heads.
A thought simultaneously emerged in everyone’s mind.
It’s going to rain.
When they realized this thought, all survivors were confused for a moment, then couldn’t help but show ecstatic expressions.
Because if this rain really fell, it meant that the water crisis that had troubled them for many days would be completely resolved!
And this also sent a signal.
Han Xing’s Spiritual Spring Water would no longer sell...
Although the healing function remained unique, it could no longer be priced arbitrarily like before.
Rumbling~
Thunder rolled across the sky, lightning flashed!
The next moment, clear raindrops fell on everyone’s heads.
Then, the rainfall became increasingly dense.
Crash~
As a torrential downpour fell, countless survivors started to celebrate wildly mid-air.
Some survivors even directly raised their heads to welcome the rainwater with their mouths.
The air quality and environment in this world were excellent, even the rainwater tasted sweet.
Survivors couldn’t help but burst into joyful laughter.
After several days of water crisis, this indeed felt like relief in a time of drought.
Smart people took out all available tools to store rainwater for their drinking supply.
Those without tools even dug pits on the spot to serve as containers.
The chat channel was a hotbed of excitement, with many survivors eagerly discussing.
"Woohoo... Finally, it’s raining. The past few days have been a nightmare!"
"Thank heavens, we finally made it through!
"Finally can take a bath, the smell on me is repulsive even to myself!"
"Let me smell it..."
Survivors were all shouting excitedly.
The celebration in the chat channel lasted for nearly half an hour, then someone suddenly said.
"Great, finally no need to buy Spiritual Spring Water from Star River at a high price, his asking price is downright extortionate..."
The local network suddenly fell silent for a moment.
Because it was the first time someone openly criticized Han Xing’s pricing as exorbitant in the chat channel.
Before this, everyone’s opinions about Han Xing were positive, even elevating him to the savior status of Area 107.
Even when Han Xing’s ranking fell, it didn’t shake his place in the survivors’ hearts.
After all, his hands held the lifeline of thousands.
But now, with the water crisis resolved, people suddenly realized Han Xing’s role seemed not that crucial anymore.

Then, a survivor named Dark Fireworks agreed, "Actually, I’ve wanted to say for a long time that Star River’s prices were so high that each transaction nearly emptied out all our gains from the past two days..."
"He isn’t considering without equipment, how we would survive the upcoming battles, only thinking about selling high-priced water without regard for our lives..."
At this moment, a survivor retorted angrily in the chat channel.

Vortex Potato: "@Dark Fireworks, you are shitting me. If it weren’t for Star God selling water these last few days, you wouldn’t have survived until now. Your pathetic life was saved by others, and now you’re bold enough to bite them?"
Dark Fireworks: "@Vortex Potato, What are you saying? Star River’s water price is undeniably high, this is a recognized fact, why can’t people say it?"
Vortex Potato: "@Dark Fireworks, Fact my ass, it’s just you complaining, don’t drag us into it."
Dark Fireworks: "I#@$*..."
The two started spouting trash talk at each other.
This time, another survivor chimed in, "What that person said is true, Star River’s water is indeed overpriced. I traded a Warrior skill book for less than 500 ml of water, isn’t that extortionate?"
Vortex Potato snapped, "You are all full of it! Why didn’t anyone say it was expensive then, but now you’re all jumping out and barking here?"
Dark Fireworks countered, "Vortex Potato, is Star River your dad? Why are you defending him so fiercely?"
"You’re right, he is my dad! I’m telling you guys, my dad bears grudges, be careful that he might remember your names and never trade with you again!"
Vortex Potato’s threat seemed to have an effect. Remembering the previous incident with Lei Group, those survivors who criticized Han Xing suddenly shut their mouths.
At this point, some spectators also stepped forward to voice fair opinions.
"Not exactly extortionate; under those circumstances, it’s already good that someone offers water."
"Right, if it seems expensive, just don’t buy it in the future."
"Anyway, no one will lack water starting today, no need to blame others."
In the local network, there were still many rational and sensible people who spoke up for Han Xing.
Those who thought the price was high also closed their mouths.
A dispute gradually faded into oblivion.
However, with the passing of today, Han Xing’s monopolistic position would be overturned, and his popularity would similarly plummet.
Even falling out of the top three no longer sparked discussion among others.
Now, everyone’s attention was on the Whisperer, Black Eagle, and others.
Of course, Han Xing also noticed the conversations in the local network about him.
His heart showed no ripples; instead, he laughed, "That Vortex Potato, when did I gain such a grown-up son like you?"
"Saying it as if it’s true, yet I’ve never even dated a girlfriend!"
At this time, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were busy exploring Sky Island, unaware of the chat channel dispute.
Otherwise, given their personalities, they would definitely fight with these guys until dawn.
But at this moment, the Clever Little Sheep suddenly sent him a message.
Han Xing opened it to see the content: "Keep going, I support you."
She even included a cute encouragement emoji at the end.
A slight smile of critical strike appeared at Han Xing’s lips, speculating that this little girl might have seen some negative comments on the local network about him, so she’s cheering him up.
Shaking his head, Han Xing didn’t put the discussions from these people to mind.
He smiled slightly.
"These guys won’t really think that besides Spiritual Spring Water, they won’t be buying anything from me in the future, right?"
Suddenly, his smile ceased, replaced by a surprised expression as he said, "Shoot, I forgot to collect the laundry during the rain. The bed and furniture are all wet!"
Currently, Han Xing lacked building blueprints, most furniture remained outdoors, placed directly in his territory.
With the heavy rain, they were completely drenched.
After the rain, the wind swept the clouds away.
The next day, Han Xing still maintained his pace, gradually clearing the small clouds in this area.
His ranking dropped from fourth all the way to sixth.
Currently, Whisperer was still in first place.
With two consecutive sleepless nights, Whisperer’s territory points reached 348, exceeding Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit in second and third by more than fifty points.
However, Han Xing’s change in rank no longer sparked discussion.
As they say, the greater the expectation, the greater the disappointment; they now felt that Han Xing maintaining a position in the top ten would be good enough.
By evening.
Han Xing’s ranking happily fell outside the top ten.
On the morning of the third day.
Han Xing’s territory points were at 260, ranking 13th.
Meanwhile, Whisperer’s territory points, after a night of intense effort, broke through 400.
Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit followed, with the gap between the three now under 50 points.
Everyone was immersed in exploration.
By the end of the third day, Whisperer’s points directly surpassed 600!
Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit’s points also surpassed 500.
Now, in the chat channel, the reputation of these three was rising rapidly, including their teams, which had started recruiting people.

"You’re right, he is my dad!
I’m telling you guys, my dad bears grudges, be careful that he might remember your names and never trade with you again!"
Vortex Potato’s threat seemed to have an effect.
Remembering the previous incident with Lei Group, those survivors who criticized Han Xing suddenly shut their mouths.
At this point, some spectators also stepped forward to voice fair opinions.
"Not exactly extortionate; under those circumstances, it’s already good that someone offers water."
"Right, if it seems expensive, just don’t buy it in the future."
"Anyway, no one will lack water starting today, no need to blame others."
In the local network, there were still many rational and sensible people who spoke up for Han Xing.
Those who thought the price was high also closed their mouths.
A dispute gradually faded into oblivion.
However, with the passing of today, Han Xing’s monopolistic position would be overturned, and his popularity would similarly plummet.
Even falling out of the top three no longer sparked discussion among others.
Now, everyone’s attention was on the Whisperer, Black Eagle, and others.
Of course, Han Xing also noticed the conversations in the local network about him.
His heart showed no ripples; instead, he laughed, "That Vortex Potato, when did I gain such a grown-up son like you?"
"Saying it as if it’s true, yet I’ve never even dated a girlfriend!"
At this time, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were busy exploring Sky Island, unaware of the chat channel dispute.
Otherwise, given their personalities, they would definitely fight with these guys until dawn.
But at this moment, the Clever Little Sheep suddenly sent him a message.
Han Xing opened it to see the content: "Keep going, I support you."
She even included a cute encouragement emoji at the end.
A slight smile of critical strike appeared at Han Xing’s lips, speculating that this little girl might have seen some negative comments on the local network about him, so she’s cheering him up.
Shaking his head, Han Xing didn’t put the discussions from these people to mind.
He smiled slightly.
"These guys won’t really think that besides Spiritual Spring Water, they won’t be buying anything from me in the future, right?"
Suddenly, his smile ceased, replaced by a surprised expression as he said, "Shoot, I forgot to collect the laundry during the rain.
The bed and furniture are all wet!"
Currently, Han Xing lacked building blueprints, most furniture remained outdoors, placed directly in his territory.
With the heavy rain, they were completely drenched.
After the rain, the wind swept the clouds away.
The next day, Han Xing still maintained his pace, gradually clearing the small clouds in this area.
His ranking dropped from fourth all the way to sixth.
Currently, Whisperer was still in first place.
With two consecutive sleepless nights, Whisperer’s territory points reached 348, exceeding Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit in second and third by more than fifty points.
However, Han Xing’s change in rank no longer sparked discussion.
As they say, the greater the expectation, the greater the disappointment; they now felt that Han Xing maintaining a position in the top ten would be good enough.
By evening.
Han Xing’s ranking happily fell outside the top ten.
On the morning of the third day.
Han Xing’s territory points were at 260, ranking 13th.
Meanwhile, Whisperer’s territory points, after a night of intense effort, broke through 400.
Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit followed, with the gap between the three now under 50 points.
Everyone was immersed in exploration.
By the end of the third day, Whisperer’s points directly surpassed 600!
Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit’s points also surpassed 500.
Now, in the chat channel, the reputation of these three was rising rapidly, including their teams, which had started recruiting people.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Life Secret Elixir Formula
paragraphs: Divine Whisper, Dusk Mercenaries, Plane Boy Group.
The three major teams in Zone 107 have entered a rapid development phase, with the number of discussion group members increasing daily, creating a trend of tripartite confrontation.
As for Han Xing, ever since he dropped out of the top ten, he hasn’t made any significant progress.
So far, Han Xing’s territory points have just broken through 400, barely maintaining a position in the top twenty.
In the chat channel, there is almost no discussion about Han Xing anymore, as if he is about to be forgotten by everyone.
On the morning of the fourth day, Han Xing’s territory points reached 456, having already fallen out of the top twenty.
However, this is also because Han Xing deliberately slowed down his pace.
If he were to sprint seriously, he could still maintain a position in the top ten, but that does not meet his expectations.
There isn’t much difference between the rewards for the top ten and the top twenty; his target is only the first place.
So, Han Xing is waiting for an opportunity, which is the hatching of his pet.
In the current stage where everyone is fighting alone, having an extra pet, no matter how weak, can still provide significant assistance to a survivor.
And Han Xing’s pet egg was snatched from the hands of the Great Demon Monarch, so it can’t be too weak.
By then, it will be the real time for him to sprint!
On the leaderboard, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun have also been squeezed out of the top fifty.

In the discussion group, Cheng Jianyong was there complaining early in the morning: "Damn, these guys are just reckless, I’ve controlled my daily sleep to under six hours and spent all other time exploring the Sky Island, yet I still can’t outdo them, these crazy contenders!"

But Han Xing just laughed and said, "It’s quite normal, during the event period, all survivors in our Zone 107 have a ’Heroic Struggle’ state, making battles easier. During this state, they’re bound to go all out exploring the Sky Island."
However, Shen Yun pondered and said, "Four days...today marks the 90th hour since the event started."
"The group in the top twenty now probably hasn’t slept much; even the most determined individuals are likely reaching their limits."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong said dejectedly, "What’s the use? We’re way too far behind now, even if some people can’t hold on and rest for a few hours, we still can’t catch up."
"Forget about the first place, that Whisperer already broke 800 points and might hit 1000 today, claiming the first place reward."
But Shen Yun shook his head and said, "No, you don’t get it."
"The people on the leaderboard now, especially those in the top ten, are too afraid to rest even if they’re exhausted."
"They’re terrified that if they rest for a few hours, their hard-earned rankings from the past few days will just disappear!"
"So the next day is the day that will decide the final ranking; it depends on whether they can hold out."
"And don’t forget, there are powerful creatures like regional bosses..."
Shen Yun was right, simultaneously.
In the territories of other survivors.
The Whisperer in full Mage Equipment, the Stalker Black Eagle, the Warrior Papaya Star Spirit, and several other top-ranking survivors.
At this moment, they all faced monsters on the Sky Island, with nearly bloodshot eyes, clenching their teeth, mustering their last bits of spirit.
Yet no matter how they struggled, their body’s fatigue and sluggish actions betrayed them.
At that moment, a young man wielding a Two-Handed Greatsword found his vision suddenly blurring while battling a giant lizard.
He blinked hard, but his consciousness seemed to slip, breaking off intermittently.
By the time he gathered his spirit again, the giant lizard had unknowingly leapt beside him.
The giant lizard opened its bloody mouth, swiftly enlarging in front of the male Warrior.
In his exhausted eyes, a deep-seated fear emerged.
After a scream.
Outside the giant lizard’s territory, a Sky Island with an area of over five hundred square meters collapsed...
At the same time, on the territory points leaderboard, one name was quietly erased.
Han Xing was sitting silently on a bench in his territory, watching the progress bar before him.
[Remaining hatching time for Exotic Beast Egg, 0 hours 30 minutes and 59 seconds...]
"Almost there, just half an hour left!"
After waiting a hundred hours, it will soon be revealed what creature is inside this black egg.
Han Xing also felt a bit excited inside, and he softly said, "An Exotic Beast Egg taken from the Great Demon Monarch, surely it can give me a Legendary-level pet?"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s voice, the giant egg on the ground quivered slightly, with complex patterns continuously emerging on its black and gold shell.
The creature inside also seemed eager to come out.
But after all, it wasn’t time to hatch yet, with about half an hour of incubation left, Han Xing could only continue to wait.
At this moment, a private message caught his attention.
Han Xing looked at the name, it was that Clever Little Sheep again.
He opened the private chat to see the message from the other side.
Clever Little Sheep: "Star...Star God, hello, do you...have time now?"
Han Xing: "...Who taught you to call me that?"
Clever Little Sheep: "Ah? I saw they were all calling you that earlier...so, I, I..."
Han Xing: "Never mind, what do you need from me?"

The other side seemed to breathe a sigh of relief and replied after a moment: "It’s like this, today while exploring the Sky Island, I encountered a really formidable monster, a strange tree with many arms!
"After a huge effort, I barely managed to defeat it, and under its roots, I discovered a formula."
"I checked the information on it and thought you could make use of it."
"A strange tree, could it be a Plant Series monster?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment, "And a formula? Send it for me to see."
"Okay."
[Clever Little Sheep has initiated a trade request with you.]
Han Xing: "..."
"Didn’t I teach you that you can directly send item information in the private chat window without needing a trade?"
Clever Little Sheep was shocked, then reacted and said: "Ah? Oh, I forgot..."
Han Xing sighed, "Alright, just put it up."
Following Han Xing’s instruction, Clever Little Sheep quickly put up a formula.

[Life Secret Medicine Formula (Green): It records the manufacturing method and material ratios for the Life Secret Medicine, capable of healing the heavy injury state of One-Star Creatures and the light injury state of Two-Star Creatures.]
Upon seeing the formula information, Han Xing’s eyes widened.
This is actually a rare recovery potion formula!
You know, while Spiritual Spring Water also has recovery effects, compared to the Life Secret Medicine, its effect is much inferior.
What does healing heavy injuries mean?
As long as a survivor isn’t instantly killed or missing limbs, the Life Secret Medicine can pull you back from the brink of death.
This thing is almost equivalent to an extra life in the early stages!
Han Xing suppressed his excited heart and calmly said, "I want this formula, name your price."

Hearing Han Xing say this, the other side Clever Little Sheep seemed a bit dazed, and after a moment, she quickly replied: "You...you misunderstood, I intended to give you this formula, I don’t want anything from you..."
Now, it was Han Xing who was surprised.
He knew that although this girl was somewhat naive, she wasn’t foolish.
She must know the value of this formula.
Now, as long as she throws this thing into the trading channel, those large teams would probably pay any cost to get it!
After all, currently, there are no recovery items that can rival ’Life Secret Medicine.’
’Life Secret Medicine,’ at this stage, is almost as irreplaceable among survivors as the Spiritual Spring Water was a couple of days ago.
Holding the only formula is almost like controlling the market, with limitless potential value!
Yet, she now actually says she wants to give it to him for free, which made Han Xing a bit doubtful of his own ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Hatching!
paragraphs: It seems Clever Little Sheep knew Han Xing couldn’t believe it, so she quickly said: "I... I really don’t want your stuff, you can just take it."
After saying that, she directly confirmed the trade. As long as Han Xing confirmed it on his end, this incredibly valuable early-stage formula would fall into his hands.
"Can you tell me why?"
Han Xing asked again. Having grown up mostly alone, apart from Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, he barely had any friends.
Han Xing also had no intention of broadening his social circle. In his mind, relationships between people were too complicated, and he always put interest first.
The Clever Little Sheep seemed a little embarrassed but still said: "When you sold Spiritual Spring Water on the chat channel before, you saved a lot of people..."
"No matter what they say about you, I know you’re a good person."
"So... I thought I’d give you this blueprint."
Hearing this response, Han Xing was stunned and shook his head with a bitter smile.
What’s this girl thinking? I’m not a good person.
He only sold Spiritual Spring Water for the sake of profit.
However, Han Xing also knew that at this stage, this formula in his hands could bring out the maximum value.
To make the Life Secret Elixir requires materials, and in all of Area 107, there is probably no one with more materials stockpiled than him.
After a moment, Han Xing exhaled and said: "Then I’ll take it. When I make the Life Secret Elixir, I’ll prioritize providing you with it."
Clever Little Sheep breathed a sigh of relief and happily said: "Yes, yes, thank you."
Han Xing confirmed it, and the system prompt came.
[You have obtained the Life Secret Medicine Formula (Green), do you want to learn it?]
"Yes."
The next moment, on Han Xing’s character interface, next to the blueprint tab, there was a new formula tab.
[Life Secret Elixir (Green): After consumption, can quickly restore body injuries, with a usage interval of 30 seconds.]
[Required materials for production: Small glass bottle*1, Spiritual Spring Water*100ml, Spirit Core*10, Moonlight Grass*5, Wind Breath Grass*3, Strong Blood*1, Magic Crystal*5]
The materials needed to make the Life Secret Elixir are many, and it looks quite complicated.
At this point, Han Xing was a bit puzzled, not knowing if a recipe like this could be enhanced by the Divine-level Artisan talent, achieving a 100% success rate.
When he saw the information below the formula, a smile of delight appeared on his face!
[Life Secret Elixir success rate 45%, enhanced by the Divine-level Artisan talent, success rate already reached 100%.]
"It really can!"
Han Xing excitedly clenched his fist.
Although he didn’t know why the Divine-level Artisan talent could influence the elixir formula, he indeed had a 100% success rate!
Doesn’t this mean that apart from the formula, other things Han Xing makes could also achieve a 100% success rate?
This idea needs verification, but Han Xing feels there’s a big possibility!
Calming his excited heart, Han Xing looked at the private chat window and replied, "I’ll go gather some materials and find you once I’ve made the Life Secret Elixir."
"Yes, yes, alright." Clever Little Sheep replied with an expression.
After Han Xing finished speaking, he was about to close the private chat.

At this time, it seemed like he thought of something and advised Clever Little Sheep: "If there’s something you don’t understand in the future, you can ask me. Don’t trade with others casually again."
"By the way, you’re also from Xinyang City, right? You can also try contacting your friends."
Seemingly afraid the other party didn’t understand, Han Xing added: "In Area 107, most people are from our Xinyang City. You can add others as friends by searching for their real names."
After Han Xing finished speaking, the Clever Little Sheep on the other side exclaimed: "So that’s how it is!"
The next moment, she became a bit despondent: "But forget it, I probably don’t have any friends in Xinyang City..."
Han Xing heard something off in her tone, indicating she might have a story, but he didn’t ask further.
He’s not someone who likes to delve into others’ pasts.
After closing the private chat.
Han Xing opened the formula tab, excitedly looking at the Life Secret Elixir formula.
The required materials above, after his crazy harvest in the past two days, or rather, through trades with other survivors, had already been gathered.
Not only that, he had ample stock; he could make up to a thousand bottles of the elixir in one go!
Han Xing indeed planned to do so, but not now.
"The main ingredient in the Life Secret Elixir formula is the Spiritual Spring Water. No wonder that little girl thought of me right away."
"Next, Spiritual Spring Water must not be sold anymore. If sold, it should be the Life Secret Elixir!"
"However, I have to find an appropriate time to sell it."
Han Xing thought to himself.
The time shouldn’t be too long.
As survivors continue to explore, the monsters they encounter will become stronger, and the casualty rate will rise sharply.
By then, it will be the time to offer his Life Secret Elixir!
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly opened the formula, prepared for production, and the system prompt appeared.

[Do you wish to consume the materials: Small glass bottle*80, Spiritual Spring Water*8000ml, Spirit Core*800, Moonlight Grass*400, Wind Breath Grass*240, Strong Blood*240, Magic Crystal*400, to make Life Secret Elixir*80?]
"Yes." Han Xing confirmed.
A few slots of materials in the warehouse were emptied, but it was nothing compared to his material reserves.
In front of him, there appeared a long 10-second progress bar.
It was already nighttime by then, but Han Xing was not in a hurry.
A few minutes later, a system prompt appeared in front of him.
[You’ve successfully made Life Secret Elixir*80.]
Eighty bottles of Life Secret Elixir were all made.
Han Xing first traded 20 bottles of Life Secret Elixir to Clever Little Sheep.
Then, he opened the system interface and checked the incubation progress of the Exotic Beast Egg.
[Remaining incubation time: 0h 0m 48s...]
As time passed, black light surprisingly emanated from the patterns on the eggshell.
The system countdown reached the last 10 seconds.
The large black egg began to tremble violently, as if a creature was awakening, desperately wanting to break out from the shell!
Han Xing became even more excited.
"Make it a dragon for me!"
When the countdown reached the last second, he heard a crisp cracking sound.
Crack!
Han Xing saw cracks appear on the patterns of the big egg, and strands of intense black light burst from within.
"Geez, what a commotion!"
At that moment, Han Xing suddenly felt deprived of his sight.
The view in front became a blank sheet.
In fact, even the area within dozens of kilometers around him turned pitch-black.
It felt as if the surrounding light was completely devoured at this instant.
Even though Han Xing couldn’t see, he was shouting excitedly in his mind.
"Come on, dragon! Come on, dragon!"
The next second, the black light began to shrink rapidly, converging quickly toward a single point.
At the same time, Han Xing caught sight of the system prompt.
[Exotic Beast Egg hatched successfully, pet information has been bound...]
"Done!"
Han Xing stood up excitedly!

"Next, Spiritual Spring Water must not be sold anymore.
If sold, it should be the Life Secret Elixir!"
"However, I have to find an appropriate time to sell it."
Han Xing thought to himself.
The time shouldn’t be too long.
As survivors continue to explore, the monsters they encounter will become stronger, and the casualty rate will rise sharply.
By then, it will be the time to offer his Life Secret Elixir!
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly opened the formula, prepared for production, and the system prompt appeared.

[Do you wish to consume the materials: Small glass bottle*80, Spiritual Spring Water*8000ml, Spirit Core*800, Moonlight Grass*400, Wind Breath Grass*240, Strong Blood*240, Magic Crystal*400, to make Life Secret Elixir*80?]
"Yes." Han Xing confirmed.
A few slots of materials in the warehouse were emptied, but it was nothing compared to his material reserves.
In front of him, there appeared a long 10-second progress bar.
It was already nighttime by then, but Han Xing was not in a hurry.
A few minutes later, a system prompt appeared in front of him.
[You’ve successfully made Life Secret Elixir*80.]
Eighty bottles of Life Secret Elixir were all made.
Han Xing first traded 20 bottles of Life Secret Elixir to Clever Little Sheep.
Then, he opened the system interface and checked the incubation progress of the Exotic Beast Egg.
[Remaining incubation time: 0h 0m 48s...]
As time passed, black light surprisingly emanated from the patterns on the eggshell.
The system countdown reached the last 10 seconds.
The large black egg began to tremble violently, as if a creature was awakening, desperately wanting to break out from the shell!
Han Xing became even more excited.
"Make it a dragon for me!"
When the countdown reached the last second, he heard a crisp cracking sound.
Crack!
Han Xing saw cracks appear on the patterns of the big egg, and strands of intense black light burst from within.
"Geez, what a commotion!"
At that moment, Han Xing suddenly felt deprived of his sight.
The view in front became a blank sheet.
In fact, even the area within dozens of kilometers around him turned pitch-black.
It felt as if the surrounding light was completely devoured at this instant.
Even though Han Xing couldn’t see, he was shouting excitedly in his mind.
"Come on, dragon!
Come on, dragon!"
The next second, the black light began to shrink rapidly, converging quickly toward a single point.
At the same time, Han Xing caught sight of the system prompt.
[Exotic Beast Egg hatched successfully, pet information has been bound...]
"Done!"
Han Xing stood up excitedly!

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Void Ghost Wolf
paragraphs: After a hundred hours of waiting, the Exotic Beast Egg finally hatched!
However, when Han Xing regained his sight, he didn’t see the anticipated figure of a dragon or other legendary creature.
What was in front of him was a creature that looked like a puppy.
With an entirely black body, droopy ears, and a round-headed short figure, the creature was staring at Han Xing with big, watery eyes, looking at him blankly.
Han Xing was also looking at it.
Man and dog locked eyes.
"What the hell, a mongrel???"
Han Xing widened his eyes and was the first to speak, his voice filled with shock and a tinge of disappointment...
He had thought that the Exotic Beast Egg acquired from the Great Demon Monarch would be something extraordinary.
Even if it didn’t hatch into a legendary creature like a dragon, it should at least hatch into a Behemoth or Bathing Fire Phoenix, right?
But now, aside from its black fur, this entirely black creature looked exactly like a mongrel puppy.
Han Xing was speechless.
However, in the next second, the puppy-looking black creature suddenly emitted a faint black light.
Han Xing didn’t even realize what was happening, just saw a black shadow flash by, and then the black puppy had disappeared.
Han Xing’s face was full of question marks, and he exclaimed, "What just flew by?"
The next moment, he suddenly noticed that the black puppy had already appeared by his feet.
At this moment, it was panting with its mouth open, tongue out, and excitedly pawing at Han Xing’s boots with its short little legs.
It was then that he noticed the attributes of this husky puppy.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Juvenile)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV1]
[Power: 6, Agility: 11, Spirit: 7, Constitution: 7]
[Skill 1: Body of Nothingness (50% chance to dodge physical or magical attacks)]
[Skill 2: Counterattack Spike (Each attack taken generates a Void Spike internally. After accumulating 10 attacks, all spikes burst, each causing 220% damage)]

[Skill 3: Power of the Void (Void Ghost Wolf’s attacks carry Power of the Void effect, causing Void Corrosion on enemies, reducing healing received by 10% and armor by 5%, stacking up to 6 times, and cannot be cleansed by Holy Profession’s Purification Skill)]
[Skill 4: Void Flashes (Increases movement speed by 200%, attack speed by 100, and critical strike rate by 50% when entering battle)]
[Skill 5: Void Absorption (Unlocks at Level 6)]
[Skill 6: Void Ravage (Unlocks at Level 10)]
[Affinity: 100]
[Satiety: 60 (Hungry)]
[Growth: S+ (Can improve pet’s growth by Potential Value. 10,000 Potential Value improves growth once. Current remaining Potential Value: 0)]
Han Xing: "???"
Han Xing was so bewildered that his eyes almost popped out, incredulously asking, "You’re not a dog, you’re a wolf!?"
He pointed to the entirely black puppy on the ground.
The canine pup seemed to understand Han Xing’s words, nodding excitedly and circling around his feet.
Han Xing took a deep breath. Once he confirmed the breed of the black puppy, his disappointment disappeared completely!
Instead, he was filled with uncontrollable delight!
He exclaimed excitedly, "Although I don’t know what a Void Ghost Wolf is, just the name sounds impressive, this is a jackpot!"
"And these attributes... are too outrageous!"
"A juvenile with 6 skills and S+ growth, truly a legendary pet template!"
While Han Xing was overwhelmed with excitement.
At this moment, the little wolf cub saw Han Xing ignoring it and started rolling around on the ground.
Han Xing’s mouth twitched slightly, thinking if it weren’t for the pet panel clearly indicating this was a wolf.
And it was a Void Race creature with S+ level growth, it would’ve been hard not to suspect it was just a puppy.
Han Xing crouched down and picked up the palm-sized black puppy.
In his arms, it seemed extremely excited, flailing its short limbs wildly, sticking its tongue out, and letting its warm breath puff on Han Xing’s face.
Though the little creature’s appearance didn’t meet Han Xing’s expectations, its attributes were undeniably powerful.
Han Xing was very satisfied, nodding his head, "How about we name you Coal Ball? Considering you’re so black."
The black puppy hesitated for a moment, then once again started flailing excitedly in Han Xing’s hands as if it was satisfied with the name.
"Coal Ball?"
Han Xing tried calling it, and the little wolf cub got even more excited at the call.
"Haha!" Han Xing chuckled and patted its little head.
Just then, ’Coal Ball’ jumped down from Han Xing’s hands.
It excitedly pawed at Han Xing’s belt...
—Which held the Space Backpack.
With a ripping sound, Han Xing’s face instantly changed, "Damn! Take it easy, don’t you know how sharp your wolf claws are?"
Han Xing was at a loss and quickly pulled up his pants.
’Coal Ball’ looked at him blankly from the ground.
Recalling Coal Ball’s recent actions, Han Xing realized that something in his backpack might have attracted it.
So, Han Xing started taking things out of his backpack one by one, from equipment to Spiritual Spring Water, and various materials.
’Coal Ball’ showed no interest in any of them.
Until it saw Han Xing take out a small bead emitting a green aura, ’Coal Ball’ jumped up excitedly.
"Do you want this?" Han Xing asked curiously, as he held a Spirit Core in his hand.
’Coal Ball’ seemed to understand him and started bouncing around in place.
It appeared Spirit Cores had a certain attraction to pets, though he didn’t know their effect.
Han Xing stroked his chin, pondered for a moment, and then threw the Spirit Core into the air.
’Coal Ball’ emitted a flash of black light, and with a terrifying speed, snagged the Spirit Core mid-air.
Then, with a gulp, it swallowed it down.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[Successfully fed the pet, ’Coal Ball’ Affinity +1, Satiety +1, Potential Value +1.]
"Potential Value?" Han Xing suddenly noticed the last part of the system prompt.
He recalled the pet panel note about growth regarding Potential Value.
10,000 Potential Value can improve a pet’s growth once.
For example, if a pet has C-level growth, consuming 10,000 Potential Value would upgrade it to B-level growth, and so on.
Furthermore, the higher a pet’s growth, the more attributes it gains per level.
Therefore, it’s best to improve a pet’s growth as early as possible.
Han Xing mused while rubbing his chin, "So feeding a Spirit Core grants 1 Potential Value."
"Does this mean I could feed ’Coal Ball’ with 10,000 Spirit Cores at once to immediately increase its growth by one level?"
Coal Ball’s growth was already S+, so further improvement might elevate it to the legendary SS-level!

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Go, Little Coal Ball!
paragraphs: The ’Coal Ball’ with just an S+ Growth Level already has such powerful Basic Attributes. What would happen if it were enhanced to SS-level?
All that’s needed is to feed it Spirit Cores to increase its Potential Value.
Through previous transactions, Han Xing’s Spirit Core reserves have already exceeded twenty thousand!
Even if he feeds ten thousand Spirit Cores to the ’Coal Ball’ all at once, he still has plenty left.
If it were another Survivor, they wouldn’t be able to come up with that many in a short time.
Han Xing widened his eyes, excitedly grabbed a handful of Spirit Cores from his backpack, and tossed them all to the ’Coal Ball’.
Coal Ball was also excited, devouring them fervently.
"Eat! Eat all you want; I’ve got plenty for you, haha!" Han Xing shouted excitedly.
However, after consuming over thirty Spirit Cores, ’Coal Ball’ lost interest in the ones on the ground.
Han Xing noticed a change in the pet’s information under the Satiety column.
[Satiety: 100]
"Can’t eat anymore?"
Han Xing said somewhat regretfully, "It seems the idea of rapidly boosting a pet’s Potential Value by feeding it a lot of Spirit Cores at once isn’t feasible."
Pets have their own Satiety, and the amount they can be fed daily is limited, which must be a system limitation.
Shaking his head, Han Xing decided not to dwell on it.
After all, an S+ Growth Level is already incredibly astounding.
Once full, the Coal Ball happily rolled on the grass.
With a smile, Han Xing said, "Now that you’re full, it’s time to get to work."
Hearing this, Coal Ball jumped up excitedly.
With that, Han Xing was already controlling the Sky Island Territory, steering towards other clouds.
Ten minutes later, Han Xing’s Sky Island Territory approached a cloud with an area of twenty square meters.
At this point, a system prompt appeared: "A group of aggressive horned creatures lives here. Enter?"
"Aggressive horned creatures? It seems they aren’t a friendly bunch..."
Han Xing pondered, stroking his chin.
But he was too eager to test the abilities of Coal Ball.
So, Han Xing immediately clicked "Yes."
The clouds dissipated, revealing four gray long-haired creatures with curved horns.
[Horned Sheep (One-Star Creature)]
[Level: LV3]
[Power 8, Agility 10, Spirit 7, Constitution 8]
[Skills: Sheep Horn Charge, Yang Dingtian]
Four Level 3 One-Star Monsters, even for Han Xing, would require utilizing his immense Attack Power to instantly take down two, then defeat each one by one.
Otherwise, if he were surrounded, with his fragile body, he’d soon be trampled to death by these Horned Sheep.
However, at this moment, he intended to let ’Coal Ball’ fight alone.

As a pet, the Void Ghost Wolf ’Coal Ball’ adhered strictly to its owner’s commands, even if Han Xing ordered it to battle a foe as formidable as the Great Demon Monarch. It would comply without hesitation.
The Level 1 ’Coal Ball’ was to face four Level 3 Horned Sheep alone.
Even when facing enemies outnumbering it, it showed no trace of fear.
"Go, Little Coal Ball!"
Receiving Han Xing’s command, the black puppy on the ground instantly shed its naive and adorable expression.
Instead, it slowly revealed a fierce demeanor, baring its fangs.
At this moment, it finally exuded the imposing aura of a powerful creature like a Void Ghost Wolf.
Simultaneously, the four Horned Sheep, upon seeing Han Xing, had their eyes turn red instantly.
They all lowered their heads, aiming their sharp horns, and, with a leap, rushed towards Han Xing.
However, in the next moment, a figure faster than them appeared.
Coal Ball emitted a faint black light, speeding like a black shadow, as it instantly reached a Horned Sheep.
It extended its sharp claws, slashing across the Horned Sheep’s neck.
In Han Xing’s view, the attack by ’Coal Ball’ seemed to leave afterimages.
Swish, swish!
The Horned Sheep only felt a sharp pain, now having two claw marks on its neck.
In the next instant, blood began to gush.
The Horned Sheep let out a painful wail, the remaining three Horned Sheep, hearing the sound, turned their pitch-black eyes towards ’Coal Ball’.
Hostility shifted.
The next instant, they furiously moved, charging at ’Coal Ball’.
Seeing this scene, even Han Xing broke out in a cold sweat for Coal Ball.
He tightened his hold on the Longbow, ready to intervene at a moment’s notice.
However, the ’Coal Ball’ on the ground was not only unflustered, but instead bared its teeth and let out a threatening growl.
Its eyes carried a regal conceit, like a king of the jungle, seemingly ignoring the Horned Sheep.
The three Horned Sheep arrived.
Coal Ball neither dodged nor evaded, once again emitting faint black light.
Han Xing saw clearly that at the moment the Horned Sheep attacked, the sharp horns seemed to pass through Coal Ball’s body, as if assaulting a piece of nothingness, causing it no harm.
"Body of Nothingness!
Han Xing exclaimed in his heart.
As Coal Ball’s first skill, Body of Nothingness provided it with a 50% chance to dodge.
At this moment, the three Horned Sheep’s attacks all missed.
Indeed, it’s nothing less than a Divine Skill!
In the next instant, with a flicker of black light, Coal Ball bit one of the Horned Sheep’s heads.
Then, extending its two sharp foreclaws, in a speed that created afterimages, it swung its claws.
Swish, swish! Swish, swish!
In a flash, Coal Ball attacked four times, and with its Tearing Bite damage, this Horned Sheep endured five attacks from Coal Ball.
The Horned Sheep instantly had several deep gashes on its body, faintly exuding a black aura.
This was the effect caused by Coal Ball’s second skill, Void Corrosion.
With a cry of despair, the Horned Sheep fell.
At this moment, traces of blood still lingered at Coal Ball’s mouth, its ferocious appearance even intimidating other Horned Sheep, causing them to hesitate to attack again.
Han Xing also noticed that when Coal Ball moved or attacked, the black light emerging from it seemed to have increased its speed substantially.
Such that its actual displayed speed even far exceeded the attributes on the panel.
"Is it the effect of the fourth skill, ’Void Flashes’?" Han Xing was filled with astonishment.
This Void Ghost Wolf truly caught him by surprise, consistently delivering one delight after another!
Void Flashes directly doubled Coal Ball’s speed, and along with Body of Nothingness’ evasion, Counterattack Spike’s burst, and Power of the Void’s weakening effect.
These skill combinations directly formed a formidable close combat system, lacking neither survival nor burst.
Moreover, ’Coal Ball’ is only Level 1 now; when it reaches Level 6, Level 10, it will unlock the subsequent two skills.
Upon reaching Two-Star, it can learn new Advanced Skills, not to mention the later Three-star, Four-star.
By then, how powerful will an S+ Growth Level Coal Ball be?
Han Xing couldn’t help but be thrilled just thinking about it!
And at this moment, the remaining three Horned Sheep also reacted, launching another attack on Coal Ball.
Coal Ball showed no weakness, turning into a black lightning, weaving between the three Horned Sheep.
Each time it appeared, it would inevitably leave a few wounds on them.
For a moment, blood splattered, and the scene turned somewhat gory...

chapters.title: Chapter 34: S+ Growth Level!
paragraphs: The counterattack of these horned sheep was very fierce.
Coal Ball had several close calls with the horned sheep’s attacks, but even if an attack landed on it, it would be evaded due to a 50% dodge chance from the Void Body.
So far, it hadn’t suffered any serious injuries.
Conversely, the three horned sheep were tormented to the point of near collapse by it.
At this moment, seeing Coal Ball transform into black light again, one horned sheep let out an angry bleat and then charged fiercely.
The horned sheep’s second skill, Yang Dingtian, activated!
This time, Coal Ball wasn’t so lucky; the 50% dodge probability of the Body of Nothingness didn’t activate, and it was instantly lifted into the air by the horn.
The sharp goat horn pierced through Coal Ball’s skin, spilling a stream of black crystal-like fluid into the air.
Han Xing’s heart tightened instantly.
This crystal-like black liquid should be Coal Ball’s blood; the body structure of a Void Race creature differs from ordinary creatures.
After being lifted, Coal Ball rolled a few times on the ground before quickly standing up.
A wound appeared on its abdomen, looking rather creepy.
"Grr..." Coal Ball let out a low growl; although injured, its ferocity remained undiminished!
Upon seeing this, Han Xing quickly said, "Coal Ball, come back."
Coal Ball turned its head and looked at Han Xing blankly.
Seeing that Coal Ball’s injury wasn’t as serious as imagined, Han Xing breathed a sigh of relief and waved, saying, "Well done, leave the rest to me!"
Hearing this, Coal Ball obediently ran back to Han Xing’s side.
At this point, the two horned sheep had already lost their minds in anger.
"Baa!"
The horned sheep, eyes bloodshot, gasped for air and charged at Han Xing with all their might!
However, the next moment, two arrows glowing chillingly enlarged rapidly in their view.
Puff! Puff!
Both arrows hit their mark simultaneously.
"Baa~ baa~"
The heads of the two horned sheep were pierced by arrows; after a tragic cry, they died.
In the field, only the last horned sheep remained, but it couldn’t escape its fate either.
They were already tormented to the brink of death by Coal Ball. If Coal Ball’s Level weren’t just 1, with higher attack power...
It could easily take down these four horned sheep by itself.
At this time, a system prompt appeared.
[You have killed horned sheep LV3*4 and gained 120 experience points, pet ’Coal Ball’ gained 80 experience points.]
Han Xing squatted down, checking Coal Ball’s injuries.
Coal Ball lay on its side obediently, licking its own wound.
"Trouble, how do you treat a pet’s injuries?" Han Xing thought with a headache, holding his head.
He looked at his backpack; there were only two items with healing effects.
Spiritual Spring Water and Life Secret Elixir.
"Would these work on pets?"
Han Xing was uncertain, but there was no better option at hand. He sighed, "I can only try."
Han Xing took out a bottle of Life Secret Elixir and had ’Coal Ball’ lie still.
Then, he unscrewed the glass bottle containing the elixir, and a rich fragrance wafted up to his nostrils.
Just smelling the elixir made one feel refreshed.
"Hiss~"
Han Xing greedily inhaled twice, then poured out the entire bottle of Life Secret Elixir.
The emerald-green liquid glowed with a dim fluorescence, and upon contact with Coal Ball’s wound, it was rapidly absorbed.
"It works!" Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
He then saw Coal Ball’s wound healing at a speed visible to the naked eye.
At this rate, it would be completely healed in a few minutes.
"What a powerful effect!"
Han Xing was thrilled in his heart; it was his first time witnessing the effect of the Life Secret Elixir and he was momentarily awed by its powerful restorative capability.
At the same time, Han Xing also breathed a sigh of relief in his heart.
"Luckily... the Life Secret Elixir works on pets too, or else I could only rely on ’Coal Ball’s’ self-healing ability."
All pets have a self-healing ability, as do humans, the difference being in speed.
But when a pet is in an injured state, its combat power will be greatly reduced, possibly even leading to death.
In that scenario, Han Xing would probably be heartbroken.
With this in mind, he picked up Coal Ball with one hand and said, "You did well today, but your level is still a bit low. I’ll take you to level up first."
Coal Ball, revitalized, stretched out its little short legs, paddling constantly.
A dozen minutes later, Han Xing approached another small cloud about a dozen square feet in size.
Upon entering, there were two Level 4 Mud Slimes.
The battle began, and just having healed its injuries with the Life Secret Elixir, Coal Ball had regained its strong combat power.
It pushed its speed to the limit and was the first to charge up to the monsters, initiating melee combat.
This time, Han Xing didn’t let it fight solo though.
Swish! Swish!
Arrows were shot, and both Mud Slimes suffered armor-piercing damage.
At that moment, black light flashed.
Coal Ball’s sharp claws left several black smoke-emitting wounds on them.
This was Coal Ball’s third skill, the Power of the Void effect, which not only suppresses healing but also reduces defense.
Therefore, Han Xing directly activated the skill Multi-Shot!
Puff, puff, puff!
All five arrows hit.
They easily penetrated the Slimes’ flesh, without even needing any armor-piercing effect to cause terrifying damage.
The two Mud Slimes were directly obliterated by this wave of attacks!
Shocked in his heart, Han Xing thought: "Is this the power of Coal Ball’s defense reduction effect? It’s truly formidable!"
"Such organisms that inherently don’t possess high defense, once reduced, can receive maximum damage with each arrow!"
Partnering with Coal Ball was incredibly enjoyable, and Han Xing excitedly clenched his fist.
[You have killed Mud Slimes lv4*2 and gained 80 experience points, pet ’Coal Ball’ gained 60 experience points.]
[Pet ’Coal Ball’ has leveled up.]
"Leveled up?"
Han Xing couldn’t wait to check Coal Ball’s attributes.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Juvenile)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV2]
[Power: 9, Agility: 16, Spirit: 8, Constitution: 9]
"Whoa!"
Han Xing was instantly amazed.
Although it was just a single level up, Coal Ball’s attributes jumped significantly; Power, Spirit and Constitution each increased by two or three points, which was expected.
However, the agility attribute directly increased by 5 points!
What does this mean?
For these human Survivors, the total attribute increase per level is merely 4-6 points.
Whereas Coal Ball, with a single level up, gained a total of 14 attribute points, three to four times the difference!
Just a few more levels, and Coal Ball’s basic attributes might even crush fully armed humans!
Han Xing could clearly feel that Coal Ball’s speed had taken a huge leap forward; under the state of black light augmentation, he couldn’t even catch a glimpse of Coal Ball, let alone hit it.
"Is this the power of an S+ Growth Level pet? Terrifyingly strong!"
"If it continues to level up, it could definitely become a big boss template!"
Filled with excitement, Han Xing was overflowing with prospects for Coal Ball’s future growth.
