chapters.title: Chapter 35: Level Soaring!
paragraphs: Han Xing was very satisfied with Coal Ball’s amazing growth.
At this moment, Coal Ball also seemed to sense its owner’s inner joy. It flickered and appeared beside the corpse of the Mud Slime, then flickered again, reappearing at Han Xing’s feet.
Han Xing could see that it held a few Spirit Cores in its mouth, seemingly seeking its owner’s permission.
He squatted down, patted Coal Ball’s head, and said, "Eat them, it’s your reward."
Coal Ball happily started jumping in place.
After merging the Mud Slime’s territory, Han Xing continued to explore other Sky Islands.
At this time, Han Xing found that Coal Ball, having reached Level 2, was like an energetic little boss.
With the monster attributes unable to suppress it, Coal Ball moved like it owned the place!
In every fight, Coal Ball charged forward as if on adrenaline, fearlessly leading the charge against powerful monsters.
Then, Han Xing only saw a flash of black light, and before he could catch sight of Coal Ball, it had already ended the fight.
Sometimes, Han Xing would seize the opportunity with his own powerful Attack Power to instantly kill the enemy while Coal Ball was engaged with them.
But soon, Han Xing found that dealing with ordinary monsters seemed to no longer be his concern.
He only needed to follow Coal Ball to gain experience.
Because of its Body of Nothingness with a 50% evasion trait, combined with Coal Ball’s terrifying speed, very few monsters could touch it.
One after another, the monsters fell at their feet.
Han Xing stood with his arms crossed, delightedly watching Coal Ball charge and break through the front lines.
[You have killed Granite Rabbit lv4*3, gained 120 Experience Value, and your pet ’Coal Ball’ gained 84 Experience Value]
[You have killed Yellow-skinned Deer lv5, gained 50 Experience Value, and your pet ’Coal Ball’ gained 40 Experience Value]
[You have killed...]
An hour later.
Han Xing suddenly noticed a white light rising from both himself and ’Coal Ball,’ and a system prompt appeared.
[Your Level has increased, current Level lv4]
[Your pet ’Coal Ball’ Level has increased, current Level lv3]
"Leveled up again?"
Han Xing couldn’t recall how many times he’d exclaimed that today.
Coal Ball had just reached Level 2 less than an hour ago, and now it had already reached Level 3.
Even for himself, going from Level 2 to Level 3 took an entire day.
This little one’s leveling speed was really like rocketing upward.
Han Xing patted Coal Ball’s head.
At Level 3, Coal Ball had completely surpassed him in the Panel Attributes.
With 21 points in agility, plus the 200% speed boost from the skill ’Void Flashes,’ even Elite Monsters at Level 5 probably couldn’t keep up with it.
At this moment, Han Xing realized that handling those ordinary monsters was no longer his affair.
On top of that, the speed at which Coal Ball resolved battles was increasing.
A string of system prompts appeared.
His experience bar was rapidly skyrocketing at an unprecedented rate.
In just an hour, he reached 50% of Level 4, and in another hour, he could directly break through to Level 5!
More importantly, Han Xing’s territory size was expanding at an overwhelming pace.
At this moment, Han Xing’s territory points reached 584!
In just over two hours, it increased by more than a hundred points, equivalent to an area of more than a hundred squares!
On the territory points leaderboard, Han Xing had also climbed back into the top twenty.
However, his rate of growth didn’t attract much attention.
Because at this time on the territory points leaderboard.
The first place Whisperer’s points had already broken past the 900 mark, reaching 912 points, just 88 points away from securing the top spot!
The second place Black Eagle and third place Papaya Star Spirit were similarly in close contention, one with 874 and the other with 852.
In the chat channel, people were hotly debating the rankings.
"I think this time the first place will undoubtedly belong to our ’Divine Whisper’ leader, Whisperer, right?"
"Not necessarily; our Plane Boy Group leader Papaya Star Spirit isn’t to be underestimated. The gap isn’t large, and he could catch up soon!"
"Keep dreaming, Papaya Star Spirit is a Warrior profession and can’t even catch Stalker profession’s Black Eagle, let alone the Mage Whisperer."
"You’re talking nonsense! Papaya Star Spirit will definitely not lose, the Plane Boy Group will definitely take first place!"
"Haha..."
While they argued endlessly.
The three on the leaderboard were nonetheless tense.
At this stage, none of them dared to relax even a bit.
Even though their mental state had reached its limits, and their eyelids felt as heavy as lead, they bit down hard, determined to keep exploring.
On the Sky Island Territory.
At this moment, Whisperer’s eyes were nearly bloodshot, his complexion sallow and thin, looking as if he’d lost over ten pounds.
Yet he still clenched his jaw, continually encouraging himself.
"Persist! Must persist!
"Victory is just one step away, I must take first place!"

Clinging to his last breath, Whisperer kept fighting the monster in front of him, and even though his movements with the Bronze Staff were numbed, he continued to cast Fireball Technique to destroy the monster before him.
Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit were in the same mode.
Among them, the Stalker Black Eagle.
Before arriving in this world, he seemed to be a member of some special organization, possessing incredible combat awareness.
Upon acquiring Extraordinary Power in this world, he adapted seamlessly.
At this moment, Black Eagle silently appeared behind a Dark Elf Warrior, a flash of cold light slicing the Bronze Dagger across the Dark Elf’s throat.
The strike was so smooth, so unpretentious, yet visually satisfying.
It seemed as if he had practiced it thousands of times.
Blood splattered.
The next second, the Dark Elf Warrior’s body limply fell to the ground.
Lying about were five or six Dark Elf corpses, in disarray on the ground.
It was evident these Dark Elves had caused Black Eagle quite a bit of trouble.
He bore several new wounds, the most serious being a deep cut on his back slashed by the Dark Elf Warrior, continuously oozing blood.
At this point, a trace of bloodthirsty intent appeared on Black Eagle’s always serious face.
It was the aura only those emerged from a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood could possess.
In the Dusk Mercenaries discussion group, someone asked: "Captain, are you alright?"
Black Eagle’s expression returned to coldness, he quietly said: "Not bad."
"Though it’s exhausting and painful, this nerve-wracking feeling, where one misstep spells doom, reminds me of the battlefield..."
A moment later, Black Eagle suddenly noticed a gathering of black energy forming in front of the treasure chest guarded by the Dark Elves.
The energy grew denser, eventually shaping into a humanoid silhouette.
"Soul of Vengeance, a Level 5 Elite Monster..."
Black Eagle closed the discussion group, his eyes narrowed, as his heart kept ringing warning bells.
The next moment, the black shadow vanished, attacking Black Eagle at terrifying speed.
Black Eagle barely had time to react before the black shadow materialized before him.
"So fast..."
This was his last thought before Black Eagle’s figure flew backward.

chapters.title: Chapter 36: Time to Sprint
paragraphs: Meanwhile, when Black Eagle was entangled by the level 5 Elite Monster, Soul of Vengeance.
Papaya Star Spirit and Whisperer also encountered different monsters.
Although these monsters had different attributes and skills, they all shared a common trait: they were extremely troublesome.
This was no coincidence.
In fact, every Survivor, upon descending into this world, has terrain that is quite similar.
The number of clouds in each area is roughly the same, and each has its own Elite Monster of the area, except for some hidden existences, these Elite Monsters are the strongest in this area.
Just like how Han Xing encountered the Gray Rock Giant Wolf in the first area; defeating it was the only way to advance to a new area.
However, that Gray Rock Giant Wolf was merely equivalent to the Newbie Village boss and appeared less troublesome compared to the monsters encountered by Black Eagle and Whisperer.
And now, due to the advanced progress of Whisperer and the others, they were finally facing the most powerful existence of this area, each falling into a bitter struggle.
Just as everyone eagerly awaited the final victor to emerge.
The result was that after waiting for more than an hour, the top three on the leaderboard suddenly stopped moving as if they had agreed on it.
In the chat channel, many people were puzzled.
"What’s going on? Why is the leaderboard not moving? Did the top three agree to sleep together?"
"Don’t rush, wait a bit longer, maybe they’re all doing temporary adjustments, preparing for the final sprint."
"That’s certainly possible; given this situation, do you think there might be a change in who will be the final number one?"
"Stop dreaming, Whisperer has a huge advantage now; he’ll surely be number one!"
Yet, someone was dissatisfied, saying: "Previously, Star River also had a great advantage; many said he was sure to be number one. But look at him now, he can’t even hold on to the top twenty."
"Star River? He’s just a guy with good luck, nothing noteworthy."
No one disputed this statement in the chat channel. Since Han Xing dropped out of the top twenty, support for him has dwindled.
However, someone surprisingly said: "Hey, Star River is back in the top twenty!"
"What?" Many Survivors were quite astonished.
"643 Points! What was his score before?"
Having lost focus on Han Xing, no one knew his previous score, but the increase must be substantial!

Yet, some people who had opinions against Star River still dismissively said: "So what if he’s in the top twenty? He’s too far behind Whisperer and the others; the gap of nearly 300 points would take at least a day to close!"
"Yes, Star River has no chance; stop discussing him."
However, what they didn’t know was that Han Xing had increased nearly 200 points in just three hours!
This terrifying speed even as a Mage, Whisperer could only look on enviously.
Though these people hadn’t noticed.
Cheng Jianyong had maintained close attention to Han Xing’s ranking.
Upon seeing Han Xing’s rankings soar.
In the discussion group, Cheng Jianyong eagerly asked: "Brother Xing, you started exerting effort?"
At this time, Han Xing was enjoying eating Experience behind ’Coal Ball.’
Upon seeing the group messages, he smiled and replied: "Yes."
Cheng Jianyong suddenly became excited, "Haha, I said Brother Xing was waiting to burst forth at the end, right? Shen Yun, look, a 200-point increase in three hours, it’s terrifying!"
Shen Yun learned and also exclaimed: "Wow, so fast? Brother Xing, did you take medicine?"
Han Xing laughed: "Yes, I took medicine. I have more here; do you want a couple of them?"
Shen Yun instinctively refused: "No, no, I’m still young, I don’t need it."
Cheng Jianyong echoed: "Haha, Brother Xing, keep such things for yourself, Xiao Yunzi and I have great physical constitution; we don’t need this to fight three hundred rounds every night!"
However, Han Xing said in a peculiar tone: "You really don’t want it? The effect of my medicine is extraordinarily good, one gulp, and you’ll be invigorated!"
Shen Yun hurriedly declined.
But Cheng Jianyong tentatively asked: "Brother Xing, is this medicine really that strong? Maybe, I should try some?"
"Hahaha!" Han Xing laughed: "See, I knew Cheng Jianyong, this married man is not going to last, right? Now it’s been exposed!"
Shen Yun also laughed along.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong had a face full of embarrassment.
Han Xing then said: "Okay, not teasing you anymore."
Then, Han Xing sent them a trade request.
The two accepted with strange expressions.
However, when they saw that Han Xing threw 20 bottles of Basic Life Secret Elixir at them in one go, the group was filled with sounds of sucking in cold breath.
"Hiss..."
Cheng Jianyong felt incredulous, saying, "Life Secret Elixir!"
He chuckled bitterly and said: "Brother Xing, so the medicine you mentioned, one gulp and it invigorates is this?"
"Yes."
Han Xing chuckled: "I didn’t deceive you, right? I’ve tested this medicine; the effect is incredibly good!"
"Unless you’re missing an arm or a leg or suffered a deadly blow, one bottle of medicine can save you."
"If your constitution is high enough, you won’t even need to worry about injuries; you can go head-to-head with those monsters!"
At this moment, Shen Yun tentatively asked: "Brother Xing, do you mean...
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, from now on, we need to change our strategy. With Life Secret Elixir in hand, we can be more daring in challenging those clouds."
"I’ve seen your rankings: Shen Yun at 27th, Cheng Jianyong at 36th, as long as you go all out, not to mention top three, everyone should be able to reach the top ten!"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s thoughts, the two were suddenly quite surprised.
However, Cheng Jianyong clenched his teeth and said: "Damn, with Life Secret Elixir and Brother Xing’s strong support behind us, forget top ten, I’ll crush into the top three surely!"
"I’m going for it!"
Shen Yun also got excited, enthusiastically saying: "Charge!"
At this time, when Whisperer and the others faced strong foes and remained stagnant.
Han Xing and the others’ rankings soared like a rocket.

"Wow, worthy of being Star River God; one move refreshes our common knowledge!"
In the chat channel, discussions about Han Xing resumed.
Nonetheless, many still harbored skepticism against Han Xing, saying with a sneer: "What’s the point of growing fast? He’s still over 200 points behind Whisperer. I’ve told you, he stands no chance."
"Yes, and who’s to say Star River’s rapid growth isn’t just luck?"
"Good luck doesn’t last forever."
At this time, no one stepped forward to refute.

Among the Survivors, someone exclaimed: "Quick, look, ’Lone Brave’ and ’Yun Tianming’ are also wildly climbing the ranks!"
"I’ve seen with my own eyes; they’ve increased by over 40 points in half an hour!"
"What?"
The chat channel was filled with astonishment.
Simultaneously, someone gravely said: "Looks like everyone’s starting to sprint at the last moment!"

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Battling the Area Boss
paragraphs: The survivors of the entire Channel 107 began to accelerate their assault on the leaderboards.
At this moment.
On a Sky Island Territory with a vast area exceeding forty squares.
Han Xing was engaged in combat with a colossal creature.
In front of them, a towering giant brown bear, easily three to four meters tall, roared in anger.
An information window for the brown bear appeared before them.
[Iron-Backed Brown Bear (One-Star Elite Creature)]
[Level: lv5]
[Power 31, Agility 20, Spirit 21, Constitution 35]

[Skill 1: Bear Paw Strike (The brown bear swings its enormous bear paw at the ground, generating a powerful shockwave to knock back surrounding enemies and deal significant damage), Skill 2: Ironback Impact (Iron-Backed Brown Bear charges at the target, sprinting speed increased by 100%, and upon hitting, guarantees a critical strike and knockback effect), Skill 3: Furious Roar (The brown bear lets out a deafening roar, dealing sonic damage to surrounding enemies and increasing its critical strike rate by 50%)]
A formidable panel!
Just its basic attributes alone could crush Han Xing, who was donned in full Green Armor, even though ’Coal Ball’ had leveled up to Level 3, it was still suppressed in attributes.
"Such a strong creature, could this bear be the regional boss?" Han Xing pondered.
However, Coal Ball’s agility attribute had already reached 21 points, and with the skill boost from ’Void Flashes’ granting 200% movement speed.
Even this Level 5 Elite Monster couldn’t keep up with Coal Ball’s pace at all.
Han Xing only saw a black shadow constantly flickering around the Iron-Backed Brown Bear, leaving occasional wounds on its body.
"Roar!"
The brown bear let out an angry roar, continuously flailing its broad bear paws, wildly swiping at the sky, but try as it might, it couldn’t touch even a hair on Coal Ball.
Just then, Han Xing’s Wind Chasing Arrow shot forth.
The Fine Iron Arrow carrying a tearing-through-the-air sound appeared instantly in front of the brown bear.
The target was none other than its eye as big as a bronze bell.
However, this Level 5 Elite Monster reacted swiftly.
Upon seeing the arrow approaching, the Iron-Backed Brown Bear quickly turned, meeting the arrow with its steel-needle-haired back.
Bang!
The arrow hit, but the expected scene of piercing through flesh did not appear.
The Fine Iron Arrow made a dull sound upon contact with the bear’s back.
It was as if the arrow hit a concrete wall rather than the bear’s body.
"What terrifying defense!
Han Xing was amazed; he also noticed the impressive 35 points of Constitution the Elite Brown Bear had, which granted it formidable flesh defense.
The arrow failed to deal any damage and instead completely enraged the gigantic creature.
It suddenly stood upright, pounding its chest repeatedly with its bear paws.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
After a series of dull thuds, the brown bear opened its mouth and howled skyward.
"Roar!!!"
A terrifying shockwave began to spread.
"No, it’s the Elite Monster’s skill, Furious Roar!"
Han Xing’s face changed instantly, "Coal Ball, retreat quickly!"
Furious Roar is an area skill; although Coal Ball is strong, its Constitution is weak compared to the brown bear.
Enduring this sonic attack up close would mean heavy injury if not death!
However, Coal Ball also wasn’t foolish; upon detecting the brown bear’s sonic attack, it had already retreated backward.
A flash of the black shadow, and Coal Ball appeared at the edge of the territory.
The Greyback Brown Bear’s attack didn’t cause much harm.
Han Xing sighed in relief, but he hadn’t noticed the brown bear had by then shifted its hatred target onto him.
In the next moment, the brown bear got on all fours, drool hanging from its mouth, and glared at Han Xing furiously.
A sinking feeling of dread rose in Han Xing’s heart.
As he realized, the Greyback Brown Bear charged toward him like a cannonball!
This was its second skill, Ironback Impact!
Danger!
At the critical moment, Han Xing used the Hunter’s basic skill, Roll!
Crouching slightly, Han Xing rolled on the ground, narrowly avoiding the Iron-Backed Brown Bear’s charge, feeling fear linger in his chest.
Ironback Impact hitting an enemy guarantees critical and knockback effects.
Given his frail build, even if he survived a hit, he’d be flung high, falling off the Sky Island Territory.
At this point, Coal Ball flashed near the brown bear.
Coal Ball’s eyes showed killing intent, seemingly furious at the brown bear’s attempt to attack Han Xing.
"Awoo!"
Coal Ball let out a growl that was both cute and fierce.
Han Xing watched its form become illusory.
The next moment, countless spikes sprouted from Coal Ball’s shadow.
Void Ghost Wolf’s second skill, Counterattack Spike, activated!
The next moment, ten spikes fired simultaneously.
Each Counterattack Spike bore the Power of the Void, carrying unmatched lethal power.
Even with the Iron-Backed Brown Bear’s terrifying defense, it was easily pierced; its massive body was practically a target at this moment.
Thud, thud, thud!
With a few fleshy sounds, the Iron-Backed Brown Bear took on Coal Ball’s burst skill at close range, at least seven spikes hitting its body.
The Iron-Backed Brown Bear didn’t expect this little creature to inflict such grave damage, its frustration palpable.
Yet, the Counterattack Spike carried the Power of the Void, continuously corroding its wounds, drastically reducing its state.
Void Ghost Wolf’s third skill, [Power of the Void] The damaged enemy not only experiences inhibited healing but also reduced defense!
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, seizing the opportunity!
Without a thought, he used his strongest burst skill.
Multi-Shot!
In the next moment, five Fine Quality Fine Iron Arrows, shot out with swift speed, hitting the brown bear.
Moreover.
Among the five arrows, two triggered the Armor Piercing effect, boosting damage tremendously!
This time, Han Xing’s arrows faced no obstacle, puncturing the brown bear’s thick skin, embedding in its flesh easily.
Han Xing squinted, watching this gigantic creature expectantly.
Yet, he found it still full of energy, showing no hint of weakening.
"Is it immune? Indeed, the snake venom on a Level 1 creature has no effect on this Level 5 monster."
Han Xing felt some regret.
He shook his head, refocusing on the battle at hand.
At this point, Coal Ball again diverted the Iron-Backed Brown Bear’s attention.
Han Xing reassumed his role as a long-range attacker.
Having a formidable pet upfront made a Hunter’s combat easeful.
Once the Iron-Backed Brown Bear’s defense was reduced, and Han Xing’s arrows could damage it, the battle had little suspense remaining.
Three minutes later.
The Iron-Backed Brown Bear bristled with three to four dozen arrows like a porcupine.
It was utterly exhausted.

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir
paragraphs: The battle had raged on, and the Iron-Backed Brown Bear was now utterly exhausted from Han Xing and Coal Ball’s relentless assault.
But it had to be said, its life force was truly formidable. Even now, it clung to its last breath tenaciously.
At this stage, no Survivor could hope to defeat it in a one-on-one fight.
Even if they did, it would likely come at a heavy cost.
Han Xing hadn’t been injured, mainly because Coal Ball had borne the brunt of the battle.
If he had faced it alone, he would likely have been crushed to pulp.
Given the Iron-Backed Brown Bear’s strength, other Level 5 Elite monsters weren’t much different.
"Luckily, it wasn’t Level 6," Han Xing said with a hint of relief.
In , the leap from Level 5 to Level 6 was a significant milestone.
Level 6 monsters were generally far stronger in attributes compared to Level 5 monsters, and ordinary adventurers had no chance to leap levels.
However, when Survivors level up to 6, they receive a considerable boost, not just in attributes but also in equipment.
Once players reach Level 6, the equipment crafted according to blueprints sees a significant attribute increase compared to pre-Level 5 equipment, but there’s also an equipment level requirement.
Before Level 5, players could wear crafted equipment however they pleased.
But after Level 6, equipment has to be worn by another Survivor of Level 6 or higher.
At this moment, the Iron-Backed Brown Bear was at its end and was about to be taken down by Han Xing.
Suddenly, it took a deep breath, raising its paws, with a terrifying power brewing.
Han Xing immediately sensed its intent to unleash the ’Bear Paw Strike,’ a wide-range skill.
But Han Xing wasn’t going to let it succeed.
Wind Chasing Arrow!
Whoosh!
The arrow flew straight into the bear’s eye socket.
Headshot!
Lethal damage!
The massive body of the Iron-Backed Brown Bear fell slowly.
A system notification chimed.
[You have slain Iron-Backed Brown Bear lv5 (Elite Level), gaining 500 Experience Value, and pet ’Coal Ball’ gains 400 Experience Value.]
[Your level has improved, current Level LV5]
[Pet ’Coal Ball’s level has improved, current Level LV4]
"Wow, leveled up again!
In just one morning, Han Xing leveled up twice; the experience gained here was nearly equal to the sum of the past five or six days!
He glanced at his attributes, Power and agility each increased by 4 points, Spirit and Constitution each increased by 2-3 points, which was quite good.
But when he saw Coal Ball’s attributes, he was somewhat unsettled.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Juvenile)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV4]
[Power: 15, agility: 25, Spirit: 14, Constitution: 13]
"Wow! The stats increase at one level is comparable to my 3-level increase. This little creature is truly developing towards a boss’s panel, huh?"
Coal Ball looked at him blankly, the victory in battle left this little wolf also very excited, constantly pawing at Han Xing’s Boots.
Meanwhile, a familiar system notification appeared once more.
[You have slain the elite monster in this area, and you may now explore higher-level regions]
At the same time, the number of clouds in the distance suddenly multiplied several times, and he even saw clouds spanning hundreds or even thousands of square feet appearing.
"Oh? Was this brown bear the strongest monster in this area?"
Han Xing pondered, "It seems I might be the fastest in area 107 to have taken down the area boss, otherwise their points would have skyrocketed long ago."
He then walked over to the gigantic brown bear’s corpse with Coal Ball.
Clicked on decompose, a system prompt appeared.

[Successfully decomposed Iron-Backed Brown Bear carcass, recovered Fine Iron Arrow*45, obtained One-star High-quality Beast Hide*1 (Damaged), obtained Thick Bear Meat*964kg, obtained Bear Paw*2, obtained Beast Heart*1, obtained Strong Blood*20, obtained Power Crystal*7, obtained Barbarian Bear Power Secret Medicine Formula*1]
Hmm?
Han Xing felt a stirring, the items in the front weren’t special, but he noticed the last notification.
"Barbarian Bear Power Secret Medicine Formula?"
Thinking about it, Han Xing eagerly looked towards the pile of loot on the ground.
Indeed, beneath the large bear hide, he saw a yellowing paper formula.
After picking it up, a system prompt appeared.
[Would you like to learn the Barbarian Bear Power Secret Medicine Formula?]
"Yes."
The next moment, Han Xing saw a second secret medicine formula appear in the formula section.
[Barbarian Bear Power Secret Medicine: When consumed, grants a powerful Barbarian Bear Power boost, increasing your Power by 30% for 100 seconds]
[Materials required for secret medicine: Strong Blood*10, Spirit Core*5, Tiger Bone Grass*1, Power Crystal*1]
"Increase Power by 30%?" Han Xing was surprised.

According to the Hunter’s formula of 1 point of Power equaling 2 points of Attack Power, his current Power was 18 points, resulting in a 5.4 Power increase, which translates to nearly 11 points of Attack Power.
This was almost equivalent to the enhancement from a weapon, truly an impressive effect!
"With this potion, during battle, it adds at least 20% to my Attack Power, which is quite a lucrative gain!"

Excitedly, Han Xing exclaimed, "And this increase especially benefits the Hunter profession. If it were a Warrior profession with 1 point of Power equating to 3 points of Attack Power, the boost would be even greater!"
"Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, they should also find it very useful."
At this thought, Han Xing immediately crafted 100 bottles of Barbarian Bear Power Secret Elixir.
After all, he had plenty of materials now, no shortage at all!
Then, he found Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, and traded 20 bottles to each.
He also encouraged them to keep pushing up the leaderboard.
With this elixir, their Attack Power would significantly enhance, speeding up their exploration of Sky Island considerably.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced at the leaderboard.
After incorporating the brown bear’s territory, his territory points increased by over 60 squares, breaking through 800 points, and immediately surged into the top ten!
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were also not falling behind, their rankings rising swiftly.
Especially Cheng Jianyong, being a Warrior, after obtaining the Barbarian Bear Power Secret Elixir, his Attack Power skyrocketed!
He was like a fighter on adrenaline, with his rank soaring.
He jumped from the 37th place to the 25th in one hour.
However, after starting to use the Barbarian Bear Power Secret Elixir, in just half an hour, his score increased by over 50 points, propelling him into the top twenty!
This speed of progress was almost catching up to Han Xing.
In the chat channel, the Survivors were astounded beyond measure.
Someone swallowed hard and whispered, "How on earth are these guys managing this?"
"When did our area 107 have such monster performers?"
His tone was filled with disbelief, and many Survivors shared his sentiments.
"Star River God is a different story, adding over 200 points in just three hours, and now not long after, he added nearly 60 again."
"But what’s up with that Lone Brave and Yun Tianming? How are they achieving a percentage increase per hour too?"
No one could offer an answer.
Just then, someone asked, "How come Whisperer and Papaya Star Spirit’s scores haven’t changed? What on earth are they doing?"
"Could they really allow Star River to bounce back and reclaim a top-three position?"
Hearing this, Survivors from Divine Whisper and Plane Boy Group felt a collective chill. They thought Whisperer and Papaya Star Spirit were secure in their victory.
But now, they couldn’t help but feel nervous for Whisperer and Black Eagle!

Given the Iron-Backed Brown Bear’s strength, other Level 5 Elite monsters weren’t much different.
"Luckily, it wasn’t Level 6," Han Xing said with a hint of relief.

Level 6 monsters were generally far stronger in attributes compared to Level 5 monsters, and ordinary adventurers had no chance to leap levels.
However, when Survivors level up to 6, they receive a considerable boost, not just in attributes but also in equipment.
Once players reach Level 6, the equipment crafted according to blueprints sees a significant attribute increase compared to pre-Level 5 equipment, but there’s also an equipment level requirement.
Before Level 5, players could wear crafted equipment however they pleased.

Hmm?

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Su Xiaoyang
paragraphs: At this moment, the chat channel was once again embroiled in a heated debate over the terrifying speed at which the three people’s rankings soared.
However, Han Xing didn’t enter the chat channel, so he was unaware of the situation inside.
Han Xing had just finished a battle and looked at his own ranking: 802 points, currently ranked 9th.
At this moment, he noticed a name on the leaderboard.
Ranked 17th: Clever Little Sheep, Territory points 612.
Surprisingly, Clever Little Sheep had also broken into the leaderboard and was ranked so high, which was very unexpected for Han Xing.
While maneuvering the Sky Island toward another cloud, he sent a private message to Clever Little Sheep.
"Not bad, your ranking is quite high."
Clever Little Sheep quickly responded.
"Ah... is it really high?" Clever Little Sheep replied as if just realizing it.
Han Xing praised, "Yes, in the top twenty already, very impressive."
"Really? I’m not that great, hehe..." The other party gave a silly laugh.

Hearing Han Xing’s compliment, Clever Little Sheep appeared very happy and then a bit embarrassed, saying, "It’s all thanks to you giving me so many Life Secret Elixirs. With them, I’m not afraid of getting hurt, so I could explore fast."
However, Han Xing replied, "No need to be modest. The Life Secret Elixirs are just supportive; in real combat, it’s the Survivor’s own strength that counts."
After saying that, he didn’t want to continue this topic, so he asked, "By the way, did you choose the Hunter profession?"
"Mm-hmm, I chose the Hunter." Clever Little Sheep replied.
Han Xing said directly, "I just got a Secret Elixir formula that increases Power, which should significantly boost attack power for us Hunters as well."
"I’ll trade it to you." Han Xing sent a trade request to Clever Little Sheep.
Then, as usual, he put up 20 bottles of Barbarian Bear Power Secret Elixir.
"Huh? Are all these for me?" Clever Little Sheep’s tone was a bit uncertain.
Han Xing replied, "Yes, consider it as a return for the Life Secret Elixir formula you gave me."
Clever Little Sheep hesitated for a moment and then accepted.
She solemnly said, "Thank you!"
"You’re welcome." Han Xing replied casually.
After trading the elixirs, Han Xing was about to close the private chat and continue sprinting.
At this point, Clever Little Sheep tentatively asked, "Uh, umm..."
"Is there something else?" Han Xing asked.
Clever Little Sheep didn’t reply immediately, seeming to hesitate.
A moment later, as if gathering courage, she said, "Um, can I add you as a friend?"
You could clearly hear the nervousness in her voice, as if she feared Han Xing would refuse.
Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
Adding a friend would require knowing the other person’s real name.
Han Xing thought for a moment, deciding it wasn’t a big deal, so he agreed, "Sure, I’m called Han Xing, you can add me."
"Whew..."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s agreement, she involuntarily breathed a sigh of relief, saying, "Th-thank you..."
The next moment, a system prompt appeared.
"Survivor ’Su Xiaoyang’ is requesting to add you as a friend."
So this girl is called Su Xiaoyang, what a name...
Han Xing’s expression was a bit odd.
He clicked accept.
Su Xiaoyang successfully added Han Xing as a friend, appearing very excited.
Han Xing then said, "I need to continue sprinting on the leaderboard; let’s talk another time."
"Mm-hmm, I won’t disturb you, good luck!" Su Xiaoyang replied happily.
Upon closing the chat interface,
Han Xing began sprinting on the leaderboard again.
At the same time.
On a large platform exceeding 600 square feet, a beautiful girl was staring blankly ahead.
She was dressed in a set of Hunter’s green equipment, the tight-fitting leather armor accentuating her proud curves.
Tall figure, fair skin, paired with an angelic face, she was truly a slender and lovely sight.

At this moment, beneath the hem of the girl’s beast hide skirt, a pair of dazzling white, slender legs were modestly brought together, rubbing back and forth, while her ample chest heaved with her heavy breaths, appearing very excited.
This girl was Su Xiaoyang, and after adding Han Xing as a friend, she had remained in an excited state.
"So... your name is Han Xing... what a nice name...
At this moment, an excited smile appeared on Su Xiaoyang’s delicate face.
"Didn’t think... even someone like me would have someone willing to be my friend, so happy!"
"I really want to tell my parents about this quickly; they’ll surely be happy for me too, right?"
So excited, Su Xiaoyang seemed to have accidentally squeezed something in her hand, causing bright red blood to spray.

Su Xiaoyang instinctively exclaimed, looking at the mass of a part taken from some beast’s body in her hand, regretting, "Accidentally squeezed the freshly dug-up Beast Heart... It was meant for Xiaoqian, what a pity..."
She frowned slightly, her eyes flowing, catching a glimpse of that pale tree in the territory.
This tree was only about two meters high, resembling a willow on Blue Star, but it looked particularly eerie; its bark was pale as paper, including the branches which were equally pale.
What was more bizarre, the branches of this small tree were covered with thorns resembling animal teeth.
Then, Su Xiaoyang moved her artfully beautiful legs gracefully to the side of this strange plant and softly said, "Though I squeezed it, it shouldn’t go to waste; Xiaoqian, go ahead and eat it."
With those words, the strange plant’s branches started to tremble slightly, and one of them slowly extended in front of Su Xiaoyang.
The next moment, the branch quickly retracted, and the Beast Heart in Su Xiaoyang’s hand disappeared without a trace.
"Xiaoqian is so obedient."
Su Xiaoyang praised, and the information of this odd Demon Tree appeared before her eyes.
[Heart-eating Tree (One-Star Elite Creature)]
[Level: lv5]
[Power 25, Agility 28, Spirit 31, Constitution 32]
[Skill 1: Poisonous Kiss (Heart-eating Tree whips branches at enemies, making them severely poisoned after being attacked)]
[Skill 2: Life Forbidden Zone (Heart-eating Tree releases internal gases to form a wide Life Forbidden Zone, imposing multiple negative states on any life entering the gas’s range)]
[Skill 3: Wild Flower Dance (Heart-eating Tree enters a berserk state, swinging countless branches indiscriminately to attack enemies)]

[Talent: Heart-eating Demon (Heart-eating Tree enhances its Attributes by consuming other creatures’ hearts; the more hearts consumed, the stronger it becomes, and the higher Attributes will be. When a certain number of hearts are consumed, the Heart-eating Tree will undergo a transformation.)]
This was unexpectedly an Elite Level plant-type monster, the Heart-eating Tree!
Not only did it possess three powerful skills, but it also had a growth-capable Talent Skill, enhancing its strength by devouring beasts’ hearts.
When it consumed a certain number of beasts’ hearts, it could even undergo a transformation!
And, of course, this included humans; it would attack any creature that invaded its territory.
Yet, Su Xiaoyang somehow managed to plant this fierce monster in her own territory!

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Sweeping the Top Three, Secured!
paragraphs: In Su Xiaoyang’s territory, there was a Demon Tree, and it looked very obedient to her.
She stretched out her fair hand, gently touching the branches of the Heart-eating Tree, then whispered softly, "You know, Xiaoqian, I made a friend today. His name is Han Xing."
"Don’t get me wrong, it’s not like before where I thought of someone as my friend one-sidedly. We’ve actually added each other as friends!"
"So far, I haven’t revealed my true nature. In his mind, I should just be a very obedient and good child."
"If we ever get the chance to meet, I’ll definitely try my best to restrain myself, control my odd habits, and not scare them away like I used to!"
Su Xiaoyang clenched her little fists, secretly cheering herself up, as a trickle of lingering blood dripped from between her fingers.
A glimmer of hope appeared in her eyes, "I really want to meet you soon... Han Xing..."
Then, Su Xiaoyang seemed to realize her loss of composure, lowering her head shyly.
At this moment, Han Xing had already made contact with a Sky Island spanning over thirty square meters.
As the clouds dispersed, they revealed a group of eight Slimes, levels four to five!
As the battle began, Han Xing immediately drank a bottle of Barbarian Bear Power Secret Elixir.
A surge of hot Power rose up in his stomach.
At that moment, he wanted to shout, "Whose Qilin Arm is burning hot!"
Whizz!
The Arrow shot out.
The crisp sound of the Bowstring tightening.
This Arrow was far more lethal than usual.
As the battle commenced, the Slime group bounded towards him.
And this Arrow, directly triggered the penetration Effect.
After piercing through the first Slime, its momentum did not diminish, and it fiercely stabbed into the body of the second Slime.
Just then, a flash of black light flickered.
Coal Ball charged directly into the Slime mob.
The Slimes’ formation was disrupted, causing severe chaos.
"Well done!"
Han Xing, in the rear, was not stingy with his praise; he and Coal Ball were becoming increasingly coordinated.
As a series of Fine Iron Arrows shot out.
In just five minutes, they had taken out the Slime group!
Meanwhile, his territory Points reached 834, advancing one rank to 7th place.
A few minutes later.
His territory Points reached 851, advancing three more ranks to 4th place!
The entire 107 Channel, other Survivors were shocked beyond measure.
In less than five hours, Han Xing had shown them what it meant to break the limits of speed skyrocketing.
A hard-fought 200 Points in a day?
Impossible.
He could rush 100 Points in an hour!
Those who previously thought Han Xing couldn’t break into the top ten, or even the top twenty, fell silent at this moment.
The chat channel saw a return of calls for the Star River God.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing was still racing forward.
From 850 Points, he soared to 900 Points, officially surpassing Papaya Star Spirit and Black Eagle, claiming second place.
Now, the first-place Whisperer hadn’t made any moves yet.
The chat channel exploded.
"Terrifying, the Star River God has already soared to second place. At this rate, taking first is a sure thing!"
"Indeed, the Star God is truly the light of our 107 Zone; the first few days were just settling, today he burst forth and directly overtook with power!"
The voices in the chat channel had shifted to whether Star River could securely claim first place.

However, some Survivors from the Divine Whisper Team were not resigned, saying, "Don’t get too excited, maybe the Whisperer boss is conquering a large area of Sky Island, taking more time; if successful, he will surely break 1000 Points directly, and claim first place!"

"True! Previously, Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit both got stuck around the 900 Points mark, likely encountering some strong enemy. Star River is now at this score, and will probably face the same situation soon."
After this person’s comment, part of Han Xing’s supporters began to grow nervous again.
Because what this person said was indeed not unreasonable.
However, the so-called 900 Points checkpoint, for Han Xing, also did not exist.
Because he had already dealt with the strongest monster in this area, the Grey-backed Brown Bear.
His Points did not stall, on the contrary, they surged rapidly, reaching 954 Points in just over twenty minutes, reclaiming first place.
Within the local network, the people from Divine Whisper were completely silenced.
Just when everyone thought Han Xing would continue this trend and take 1000 Points to grab first place directly.
They found that his territory Points stopped at a subtle number.
1st place: Star River, 999 Points.
Just 1 Point away from the first-place reward, it was hard not to suspect that he did it on purpose.
The Survivors in the chat channel suddenly froze.
They seemed unsure of what Han Xing intended to do.
Even though he could’ve claimed first place directly, he paused at this moment.
Including the Survivors striving for the leaderboard.
Seeing the exaggerated number of 999 Points, they internally gave up hope for first.
The batch of Survivors in the top ten lost motivation, feeling a bit dejected for a time.
The upward trend on the leaderboard suddenly slowed down.
And this was also the Effect Han Xing wanted.
Just then.
Two more names appeared in everyone’s sight.
8th place: Lone Brave, 804 Points
9th place: Yun Tianming, 793 Points.
The two of them successively smashed into the top ten, maintaining a terrifying growth rate, swiftly climbing the ranks.
Before everyone could react, they had officially broken 900 Points, claiming the second and third places successively.
Then, Han Xing’s territory Points finally changed, breaking through 999 to officially exceed 1000, taking the first place reward.
More than an hour later, Cheng Jianyong successfully broke through 1000 Points, securing the second place reward.
And then, Shen Yun achieved the third place.
The three of them successively wrapped up the top three rewards!
The other Survivors in 107 Channel were extremely shocked.
[You have successfully reached 1000 territory Points, currently ranked 1.]
[You have received rank rewards: 500 units of Food, 200 units of Fresh Water, 1000 Spirit Core, 1 self-select Purple Weapon Design Map, 1 Silver Treasure Chest, 1 Hidden Profession Scroll.]
Han Xing looked at the system notification, a slight smile on his lips.
In the discussion group, Cheng Jianyong shouted excitedly, "Whoa, this is so satisfying, hahaha!"
"Brother Xing is so thoughtful, intentionally sticking at 999 Points to bewilder those competitors, giving us time to increase our Points."
Shen Yun also chimed in, "Xiaoyongzi, now you know, right? Listening to Brother Xing never goes wrong. A temporary advantage doesn’t mean anything; the one who laughs last is the true winner!"
Cheng Jianyong was in the midst of exhilarating rewards, agreeing wholeheartedly with Shen Yun’s words, "That’s right, Brother Xing has great foresight!"
Han Xing chuckled, "Stop with the awkward flattery, just check your rewards."
"Got it!" the two replied excitedly.
Shen Yun, who took 3rd place, had rich rewards, including a self-selected Blue Weapon, a Silver Treasure Chest, and an Advanced Profession Scroll.
Cheng Jianyong’s 2nd place rewards were similar; besides the Blue Weapon, he could also choose an additional piece of Blue Armor.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were incredibly excited, impatiently checking the attributes of the reward items!

sentences.text: In Su Xiaoyang’s territory, there was a Demon Tree, and it looked very obedient to her.
She stretched out her fair hand, gently touching the branches of the Heart-eating Tree, then whispered softly, "You know, Xiaoqian, I made a friend today.
His name is Han Xing."
"Don’t get me wrong, it’s not like before where I thought of someone as my friend one-sidedly.
We’ve actually added each other as friends!"
"So far, I haven’t revealed my true nature.
In his mind, I should just be a very obedient and good child."
"If we ever get the chance to meet, I’ll definitely try my best to restrain myself, control my odd habits, and not scare them away like I used to!"
Su Xiaoyang clenched her little fists, secretly cheering herself up, as a trickle of lingering blood dripped from between her fingers.
A glimmer of hope appeared in her eyes, "I really want to meet you soon...
Han Xing..."
Then, Su Xiaoyang seemed to realize her loss of composure, lowering her head shyly.
At this moment, Han Xing had already made contact with a Sky Island spanning over thirty square meters.
As the clouds dispersed, they revealed a group of eight Slimes, levels four to five!
As the battle began, Han Xing immediately drank a bottle of Barbarian Bear Power Secret Elixir.
A surge of hot Power rose up in his stomach.
At that moment, he wanted to shout, "Whose Qilin Arm is burning hot!"
Whizz!
The Arrow shot out.
The crisp sound of the Bowstring tightening.
This Arrow was far more lethal than usual.
As the battle commenced, the Slime group bounded towards him.
And this Arrow, directly triggered the penetration Effect.
After piercing through the first Slime, its momentum did not diminish, and it fiercely stabbed into the body of the second Slime.
Just then, a flash of black light flickered.
Coal Ball charged directly into the Slime mob.
The Slimes’ formation was disrupted, causing severe chaos.
"Well done!"
Han Xing, in the rear, was not stingy with his praise; he and Coal Ball were becoming increasingly coordinated.
As a series of Fine Iron Arrows shot out.
In just five minutes, they had taken out the Slime group!
Meanwhile, his territory Points reached 834, advancing one rank to 7th place.
A few minutes later.
His territory Points reached 851, advancing three more ranks to 4th place!
The entire 107 Channel, other Survivors were shocked beyond measure.
In less than five hours, Han Xing had shown them what it meant to break the limits of speed skyrocketing.
A hard-fought 200 Points in a day?
Impossible.
He could rush 100 Points in an hour!
Those who previously thought Han Xing couldn’t break into the top ten, or even the top twenty, fell silent at this moment.
The chat channel saw a return of calls for the Star River God.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing was still racing forward.
From 850 Points, he soared to 900 Points, officially surpassing Papaya Star Spirit and Black Eagle, claiming second place.
Now, the first-place Whisperer hadn’t made any moves yet.
The chat channel exploded.
"Terrifying, the Star River God has already soared to second place.
At this rate, taking first is a sure thing!"
"Indeed, the Star God is truly the light of our 107 Zone; the first few days were just settling, today he burst forth and directly overtook with power!"
The voices in the chat channel had shifted to whether Star River could securely claim first place.

However, some Survivors from the Divine Whisper Team were not resigned, saying, "Don’t get too excited, maybe the Whisperer boss is conquering a large area of Sky Island, taking more time; if successful, he will surely break 1000 Points directly, and claim first place!"
"True!
Previously, Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit both got stuck around the 900 Points mark, likely encountering some strong enemy.
Star River is now at this score, and will probably face the same situation soon."
After this person’s comment, part of Han Xing’s supporters began to grow nervous again.
Because what this person said was indeed not unreasonable.
However, the so-called 900 Points checkpoint, for Han Xing, also did not exist.
Because he had already dealt with the strongest monster in this area, the Grey-backed Brown Bear.
His Points did not stall, on the contrary, they surged rapidly, reaching 954 Points in just over twenty minutes, reclaiming first place.
Within the local network, the people from Divine Whisper were completely silenced.
Just when everyone thought Han Xing would continue this trend and take 1000 Points to grab first place directly.
They found that his territory Points stopped at a subtle number.
1st place: Star River, 999 Points.
Just 1 Point away from the first-place reward, it was hard not to suspect that he did it on purpose.
The Survivors in the chat channel suddenly froze.
They seemed unsure of what Han Xing intended to do.
Even though he could’ve claimed first place directly, he paused at this moment.
Including the Survivors striving for the leaderboard.
Seeing the exaggerated number of 999 Points, they internally gave up hope for first.
The batch of Survivors in the top ten lost motivation, feeling a bit dejected for a time.
The upward trend on the leaderboard suddenly slowed down.
And this was also the Effect Han Xing wanted.
Just then.
Two more names appeared in everyone’s sight.
8th place: Lone Brave, 804 Points
9th place: Yun Tianming, 793 Points.
The two of them successively smashed into the top ten, maintaining a terrifying growth rate, swiftly climbing the ranks.
Before everyone could react, they had officially broken 900 Points, claiming the second and third places successively.
Then, Han Xing’s territory Points finally changed, breaking through 999 to officially exceed 1000, taking the first place reward.
More than an hour later, Cheng Jianyong successfully broke through 1000 Points, securing the second place reward.
And then, Shen Yun achieved the third place.
The three of them successively wrapped up the top three rewards!
The other Survivors in 107 Channel were extremely shocked.
[You have successfully reached 1000 territory Points, currently ranked 1.]
[You have received rank rewards: 500 units of Food, 200 units of Fresh Water, 1000 Spirit Core, 1 self-select Purple Weapon Design Map, 1 Silver Treasure Chest, 1 Hidden Profession Scroll.]
Han Xing looked at the system notification, a slight smile on his lips.
In the discussion group, Cheng Jianyong shouted excitedly, "Whoa, this is so satisfying, hahaha!"
"Brother Xing is so thoughtful, intentionally sticking at 999 Points to bewilder those competitors, giving us time to increase our Points."
Shen Yun also chimed in, "Xiaoyongzi, now you know, right?
Listening to Brother Xing never goes wrong.
A temporary advantage doesn’t mean anything; the one who laughs last is the true winner!"
Cheng Jianyong was in the midst of exhilarating rewards, agreeing wholeheartedly with Shen Yun’s words, "That’s right, Brother Xing has great foresight!"
Han Xing chuckled, "Stop with the awkward flattery, just check your rewards."
"Got it!" the two replied excitedly.

Cheng Jianyong’s 2nd place rewards were similar; besides the Blue Weapon, he could also choose an additional piece of Blue Armor.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were incredibly excited, impatiently checking the attributes of the reward items!

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Warrior Ring, Treasure!
paragraphs: Among the ranking rewards, Cheng Jianyong chose a Stone Shattering Greatsword of fine quality, while Shen Yun picked a Crystal Stone Hammer.
The attributes are good, but they both require Level 6 to equip.
Next is the Silver Chest.
The rewards inside a Silver Chest far surpass those of a Bronze Treasure Chest, making it extremely difficult to obtain at this stage.
Each Silver Chest is generally surrounded by powerful monsters; unless you’re truly an Emperor of Luck, you might not find a Silver Chest on an unexplored Sky Island without monsters guarding it.

Besides a large amount of Mithril, Spirit Cores, and Blood of the Strong, a Silver Chest is guaranteed to contain one piece of Blue Equipment, with a slight chance to get Secret Elixir recipes or blue equipment blueprints, etc.
The two excitedly clicked to open it.
In the next moment, Cheng Jianyong screamed excitedly, "Wow! Warrior Ring blueprint, Blue Armor!"
"Hmm?"
Han Xing exclaimed in surprise, "A blue ring, such a lucky draw?"
Cheng Jianyong laughed excitedly, "Haha, I knew I was the Emperor of Luck!"
Then he said with a bit of disappointment, "But unfortunately, it’s a Level 6 blueprint."
Han Xing replied, "Level 6? That’s not bad. With a level or two more, everyone can equip it, and Level 6 Blue Equipment will have much stronger attributes than those below Level 5!"
Meanwhile, Shen Yun said disappointedly, "Damn, I got a pair of Level 6 Light Armor Leg Guards, also Blue Equipment. My Holy Profession needs Heavy Armor. Now Cheng Jianyong gets to benefit again!"
"Light Armor? Xiaoyunzi, give it to me quickly!" Cheng Jianyong shouted excitedly.

Shen Yun unwillingly initiated a trade and then continued, "Brother Xing, there’s also a Self-Select Advanced Profession Scroll. What should we choose for professional advancement? Do you have any suggestions?"
Before making a choice, they would always subconsciously consult Han Xing’s opinion.
They didn’t know why, but it always seemed like Han Xing knew more about the world’s mechanics.

Han Xing thought for a moment and said, "According to the game introduction, the advanced professions for Holy Profession are Priest and Knight. The former is more about healing and support and lacks combat abilities."
"While the latter leans more towards defense and melee, offering more self-preservation than the Priest. Each of these professions has its pros and cons."
Shen Yun replied without hesitation, "Okay, I’ll choose Priest then."

Han Xing seemed a bit surprised, "Have you thought it through? The Priest’s combat ability is not strong. The system introduction says the Priest relies heavily on teammates early on, only gaining a few output skills after the third transformation into a Bishop."
Shen Yun affirmed, "Yes, I’ve thought it over, I’ll choose Priest."
"Besides, with Cheng Jianyong handling melee and you as a ranged supporter, Brother Xing, I can just assist you both."
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing chose not to dissuade further.
He knew it was Shen Yun’s choice after comprehensive consideration for their future development.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, what should I choose then? Swordsman or Berserker?"
But Han Xing replied speechlessly, "What’s there to choose about those Muscle Lord Professions? They’re all pretty similar anyway.
"Damn, you really look down on the Muscle Lord Professions! Furious and cold, when will the Muscle Lord Professions stand up?!"
Cheng Jianyong exaggeratedly whined, and the next moment, he initiated a trade request to Han Xing.
Han Xing accepted the trade.
Cheng Jianyong traded the newly found blue ring blueprint to Han Xing.
[You have obtained Warrior Ring Blueprint (Blue) Level 6, learn it?]
Han Xing clicked to learn.
The blueprint panel finally showed the first piece of Blue Equipment blueprint.
He checked the crafting requirements.
[Materials needed to craft Warrior Ring: Mithril*10, Spirit Core*50, Rare Earth*100, Power Crystal*10.]
[Crafting success rate 15% (influenced by ’Divine-level Artisan’ talent, success rate reached 100%).]
"It requires so much Mithril?"
Han Xing walked to several storage boxes to check his material reserves; the other three materials were enough, but the reserve for the high-grade material Mithril was only 7.
Still not enough to craft a single ring.
So he asked in the discussion group, "How much Mithril did you guys get from the Silver Chest? Trade it to me first, I’m short to craft the Warrior Ring."
"I have 13 pieces of Mithril here."
"I have 16 pieces here too."
After hearing this, both immediately initiated a trade request to Han Xing.
Han Xing acquired a total of 29 pieces of Mithril, just enough to craft 3 Warrior Rings, along with his own Mithril reserves.
This was all thanks to the 100% success rate brought by the ’Divine-level Artisan’ talent.
If it were other Survivors, the 15% success rate would be enough to make them doubt everything after failing.
Remember, in case of crafting failure, the materials are not returned.
The material loss during this process isn’t something just anyone can afford.
Han Xing didn’t have such concerns and directly clicked to craft. A dazzling blue light appeared.
A 60-second progress bar appeared in front of him.
After the progress bar reached the end, a completely silver-white ring fell to the ground.
Han Xing also checked the ring’s attributes.
[Warrior Ring (Blue), Quality - Rare, Power +12, Attached Effect - Warrior’s Soul]
[Warrior’s Soul: When entering combat state, increases power by 6 points additionally.]
[Wearing Requirement: Level 6]
"All... Power? This ring’s attributes are really pure..." Han Xing couldn’t help but quip.
"However, the power increase is indeed significant!"
One piece of equipment directly increases 12 points of power, plus the attached effect, equating to an 18-point power boost.
Even for a Hunter Profession, it could enhance attack power by 36 points, comparable even to the enhancement brought by a main weapon!
If given to someone like Cheng Jianyong, whose profession focuses on power, the boost from the Warrior Ring would be even more astounding.
"It’s a bit formidable!"
Han Xing marveled and then proceeded to craft two more.
The second one was still of rare quality, with similar attributes.
When he got to the third one, Han Xing suddenly noticed a difference.
This time, the burst of blue light was several times brighter than before.
Han Xing, feeling a bit excited, said, "Could it be..."
In the next moment, he saw the attributes of the ring.
[Warrior Ring (Blue), Quality - Treasure, Power +18, Attached Effect - Warrior’s Soul]
"Wow, a Treasure!"
Han Xing was very surprised; this was his first time crafting equipment with treasure-quality attributes.
In Sky Island Paradise, equipment quality is divided into eight levels: Rough, Ordinary, Fine, Rare, Treasure, Legend, Epic, and Myth.
Generally, green equipment is at most of ordinary quality, occasionally showing fine quality, with rare quality being the upper limit for green equipment.
For blue equipment, they are generally fine and rare, with Treasure as the upper limit for Blue Armor.
Usually, creating rare quality equipment with blueprints is a blessing for other Survivors.
However, Han Xing’s ’Divine-level Artisan’ easily produced a Treasure!
Compared to rare quality, the attributes received a significant boost!
It can be said that just this one Treasure ring directly increased Han Xing’s attack power by nearly 15%!

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Counting the Spoils
paragraphs: Han Xing threw this piece of rare quality ring to Cheng Jianyong, and then tossed another one to Shen Yun.
Without listening to their shouting in the group chat, he directly clicked to close it.
Such a high-attribute level 6 blue equipment should give them enough motivation to level up.
After processing the ranking rewards for Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, Han Xing started looking expectantly at the things he just acquired. These were the main rewards of this leaderboard!
First was a self-selected purple weapon blueprint.
Han Xing naturally chose his profession’s main weapon.
[You have obtained the Moon Crown Longbow Blueprint (Purple) lv6, do you want to learn it?]
"Yes."
The blueprint column also displayed the first piece of purple armor blueprint, which was his weapon blueprint.
Han Xing was even eager to craft it on the spot.
Then, he saw the crafting requirements for the Moon Crown Longbow.
[Materials required for crafting Moon Crown Longbow: Mithril*100, Refined Iron*200, Moon Crystal Stone*5, Spirit Core*500, Rare Earth*2000, Tough Beast Tendon*1.]
"So much Mithril?"
Han Xing was stunned, wondering: "And what is Moon Crystal Stone, I’ve never heard of it."
With insufficient materials, Han Xing could only temporarily shelve it.
After all, this blueprint is also level 6, even if he crafted it, he wouldn’t be able to equip it. He’s still 50% experience bar short of leveling up, so there’s no rush.
After selecting the weapon blueprint, Han Xing opened the system’s silver treasure chest.
When the ancient silver treasure chest was opened, it revealed a dazzling array of materials inside.
Han Xing collected them all into his backpack.
The things from the silver treasure chest were similar to what Cheng Jianyong and the others got, except for 12 pieces of Mithril, there were also some high-end materials.
At the bottom of the chest, Han Xing saw a thick leather top.
[Fierce Beast Hide Armor (Blue), Quality - Refined, Defense 13~17, Agility+5, Constitution+2, Attached Effect - Fierce Beast Soul]
[Fierce Beast Soul: When attacking, there is a 20% chance to activate the residual beast soul on this leather armor, launching a mental attack on the enemy.]
[Equipment requirement: lv6]
"Although it’s only refined quality, the attributes are much better than the leather armor I’m wearing, and the final effect is also nice."
The rewards from the silver treasure chest were good. After opening the chest, Han Xing contentedly looked at the black scroll in his backpack.
His mood was also getting excited.
Because, this black scroll was the biggest reward from this scoreboard.
Hidden Profession Scroll!
Han Xing took out the scroll, and the system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to open the Hidden Profession Scroll? Once opened, a random advancement hidden profession scroll for the Hunter profession will be obtained.]
"Random?"
Han Xing was a bit puzzled, not knowing how many hidden professions actually exist in this world, what if he randomly gets a trash profession?
Then, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Forget it, there’s no point in worrying, even if I get a trash hidden profession, it’s okay, I still have the Wild Ranger as a backup plan."
Then, he directly clicked to open it.
The next moment, the sky suddenly darkened.
Han Xing clearly saw that around his territory, several powerful phantoms appeared.
These phantoms were tall or short, with varying physical characteristics.
Some were as tall as giants over ten meters high, while others were as small as dwarfs.
But they all had one common feature.
That is, they all held a longbow as a weapon on their backs or in their hands.
The next moment, the phantoms started to sway.
Han Xing saw them swiftly passing by before his eyes.
Finally, it fixed on a phantom with pointed ears, about the same build as the human race.
System prompt appeared.
[Successfully randomly obtained the Hunter Hidden Profession Scroll, Elf Shooter.]

[Elf Shooter Profession Scroll: After the Survivor reaches level 10, use this scroll to advance to the hidden profession Elf Shooter. The survivor’s all attributes increase by 150%, level limit rises to level 20, and the agility attribute will receive 1.5 times growth upon leveling up.]
[Automatically learn exclusive skills for Elf Shooter, Wind Perception, Elf Dance, Low Altitude Flight.]
"So strong!"
Han Xing exclaimed, "1.5 times agility growth, every two levels equivalent to an additional level’s worth of agility attribute compared to other Hunter players, and three exclusive skills..."
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly noticed the last skill.
"Low Altitude Flight? Could it be that after learning, survivors can fly into the sky to shoot?"
This idea was very likely to be true too.
Han Xing was incredibly shocked, "If this is the case, then the mobility of this profession might be beyond imagination, and the intensity will also be raised to another level!"
He was overjoyed, this time’s randomly obtained hidden profession had already exceeded his expectations.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly thought, "I wonder how the Elf Shooter profession compares to the Wild Ranger?"
But currently, the skills of the Wild Ranger are still unknown, so there’s no reference.
Shaking his head, Han Xing no longer considered it.
After processing these rewards, it was already deep night.
Since he received the first prize, four or five hours had passed.
During this time, after Clever Little Sheep received the fourth prize, no one has been able to surpass 1000 points anymore.
In the current phase, level 5 elite monsters are like a mountain, blocking the way for all survivors.
High in the deep night, a Sky Island measuring over 900 cubic meters was advancing rapidly.
Lying on this Sky Island was none other than the previous first place, now pushed to fifth, Whisperer.
His state seemed extremely miserable at the moment.
His mage’s robe was torn into strips, and his body was covered with blood marks, as if scratched by some terrible monster.
But the most serious was the blood hole in his chest.
The fist-sized wound looked quite ghastly, still continuously bleeding. Without prompt treatment, he would soon die from severe injuries.
Thinking of this, Whisperer gritted his teeth through the excruciating pain, picked up a small water jug from the ground, and poured it into his mouth.
The jug seemed to contain Spiritual Spring Water traded from Han Xing, which had some healing effects.
However, after drinking a jug of Spiritual Spring Water, Whisperer found that the surface injuries on his body had indeed improved slightly.
But the blood hole in his chest not only didn’t stop the injury but also worsened.
Gritting his teeth, Whisperer cursed in anger.
"Damn damn damn!"
"Damn it, how could there be a level 5 elite tree demon in there? With such fast attack speed, how am I supposed to fight it?"
Whisperer gritted his teeth, "If it weren’t for that tree demon being unable to move, I would have really been done for today!"
Just then, he received a private message.
It was from a Survivor in the ’Divine Whisper’ team.
Moonlight Cat: "Boss, we finally got in touch with you! You haven’t replied for almost a day, the brothers are all going crazy with worry!"

He’s still 50% experience bar short of leveling up, so there’s no rush.
After selecting the weapon blueprint, Han Xing opened the system’s silver treasure chest.
When the ancient silver treasure chest was opened, it revealed a dazzling array of materials inside.
Han Xing collected them all into his backpack.
The things from the silver treasure chest were similar to what Cheng Jianyong and the others got, except for 12 pieces of Mithril, there were also some high-end materials.
At the bottom of the chest, Han Xing saw a thick leather top.
[Fierce Beast Hide Armor (Blue), Quality - Refined, Defense 13~17, Agility+5, Constitution+2, Attached Effect - Fierce Beast Soul]
[Fierce Beast Soul: When attacking, there is a 20% chance to activate the residual beast soul on this leather armor, launching a mental attack on the enemy.]
[Equipment requirement: lv6]
"Although it’s only refined quality, the attributes are much better than the leather armor I’m wearing, and the final effect is also nice."
The rewards from the silver treasure chest were good.
After opening the chest, Han Xing contentedly looked at the black scroll in his backpack.
His mood was also getting excited.
Because, this black scroll was the biggest reward from this scoreboard.
Hidden Profession Scroll!
Han Xing took out the scroll, and the system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to open the Hidden Profession Scroll?
Once opened, a random advancement hidden profession scroll for the Hunter profession will be obtained.]
"Random?"
Han Xing was a bit puzzled, not knowing how many hidden professions actually exist in this world, what if he randomly gets a trash profession?
Then, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Forget it, there’s no point in worrying, even if I get a trash hidden profession, it’s okay, I still have the Wild Ranger as a backup plan."
Then, he directly clicked to open it.
The next moment, the sky suddenly darkened.
Han Xing clearly saw that around his territory, several powerful phantoms appeared.
These phantoms were tall or short, with varying physical characteristics.
Some were as tall as giants over ten meters high, while others were as small as dwarfs.
But they all had one common feature.
That is, they all held a longbow as a weapon on their backs or in their hands.
The next moment, the phantoms started to sway.
Han Xing saw them swiftly passing by before his eyes.
Finally, it fixed on a phantom with pointed ears, about the same build as the human race.
System prompt appeared.
[Successfully randomly obtained the Hunter Hidden Profession Scroll, Elf Shooter.]
[Elf Shooter Profession Scroll: After the Survivor reaches level 10, use this scroll to advance to the hidden profession Elf Shooter.
The survivor’s all attributes increase by 150%, level limit rises to level 20, and the agility attribute will receive 1.5 times growth upon leveling up.]
[Automatically learn exclusive skills for Elf Shooter, Wind Perception, Elf Dance, Low Altitude Flight.]
"So strong!"
Han Xing exclaimed, "1.5 times agility growth, every two levels equivalent to an additional level’s worth of agility attribute compared to other Hunter players, and three exclusive skills..."
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly noticed the last skill.
"Low Altitude Flight?
Could it be that after learning, survivors can fly into the sky to shoot?"
This idea was very likely to be true too.
Han Xing was incredibly shocked, "If this is the case, then the mobility of this profession might be beyond imagination, and the intensity will also be raised to another level!"
He was overjoyed, this time’s randomly obtained hidden profession had already exceeded his expectations.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly thought, "I wonder how the Elf Shooter profession compares to the Wild Ranger?"
But currently, the skills of the Wild Ranger are still unknown, so there’s no reference.
Shaking his head, Han Xing no longer considered it.
After processing these rewards, it was already deep night.
Since he received the first prize, four or five hours had passed.
During this time, after Clever Little Sheep received the fourth prize, no one has been able to surpass 1000 points anymore.
In the current phase, level 5 elite monsters are like a mountain, blocking the way for all survivors.
High in the deep night, a Sky Island measuring over 900 cubic meters was advancing rapidly.
Lying on this Sky Island was none other than the previous first place, now pushed to fifth, Whisperer.
His state seemed extremely miserable at the moment.
His mage’s robe was torn into strips, and his body was covered with blood marks, as if scratched by some terrible monster.
But the most serious was the blood hole in his chest.
The fist-sized wound looked quite ghastly, still continuously bleeding.
Without prompt treatment, he would soon die from severe injuries.
Thinking of this, Whisperer gritted his teeth through the excruciating pain, picked up a small water jug from the ground, and poured it into his mouth.
The jug seemed to contain Spiritual Spring Water traded from Han Xing, which had some healing effects.
However, after drinking a jug of Spiritual Spring Water, Whisperer found that the surface injuries on his body had indeed improved slightly.
But the blood hole in his chest not only didn’t stop the injury but also worsened.
Gritting his teeth, Whisperer cursed in anger.
"Damn damn damn!"
"Damn it, how could there be a level 5 elite tree demon in there?
With such fast attack speed, how am I supposed to fight it?"
Whisperer gritted his teeth, "If it weren’t for that tree demon being unable to move, I would have really been done for today!"
Just then, he received a private message.
It was from a Survivor in the ’Divine Whisper’ team.
Moonlight Cat: "Boss, we finally got in touch with you!
You haven’t replied for almost a day, the brothers are all going crazy with worry!"

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Center of Attention
paragraphs: "One day? I’ve been unconscious for so long?"
Whisperer asked, struggling against the intense pain in his chest, "Cough cough... What happened? Has someone already taken first place? Is it Black Eagle or Papaya Star Spirit?"
Moonlight Cat quickly replied, "It’s not Black Eagle and Papaya Star Spirit, it’s Star River!"
"He took just over three hours, suddenly surged over 300 points, and then, with terrifying speed, directly seized first place!"
"Not only that, the rewards for second and third place have also been claimed, one by Lone Brave, the other by Yun Tianming."
"Someone in the chat channel speculated that they might be working together!"
Whisperer, after hearing this, was also surprised, "What!?"
However, just as he got agitated, he couldn’t help but spit out a mouthful of blood.
Whisperer hurriedly closed his mouth, his face turning pale.
Moonlight Cat across from him obviously noticed his abnormality and asked, "Boss, what’s wrong with you?"
Whisperer wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and said with difficulty, "Don’t worry about the rankings and rewards now, I’m injured, seriously injured!"
"If not treated in time, I will die soon."
"What!?" Moonlight Cat was extremely shocked and hurriedly asked, "Boss, hasn’t the Spiritual Spring Water worked?"
Whisperer gritted his teeth and said, "Useless!"
"Spiritual Spring Water can only heal minor injuries, but I’m too severely injured now, I need stronger recovery items!"
He paused for a moment and continued, "Old Cat, I have to instruct you on something now."

"You need to gather all the team’s resources, do everything you can to help me find items with healing effects, if there aren’t any, go to the trading channel for help, use every means to trade them in."
"Remember, no matter what the cost!"
"Then go tell the brothers, the elite monsters in the new area are unprecedentedly strong, very tough, without recovery items, you simply can’t take them down!"
Moonlight Cat sensed the gravity of the situation, immediately hung up the private chat, and began rapidly reporting the situation to the team members.
However, at the current stage, aside from Spiritual Spring Water, other items with healing effects are scarce.
Some are even less effective than Spiritual Spring Water.
Moonlight Cat was extremely anxious and started posting a message simultaneously in the chat channel and trading channel.
["Divine Whisper" team is offering a high price to purchase healing items and potions, willing to trade a blue Great Sword.]
Meanwhile, another large team, "Plane Boy Group," also released the same purchase request.
However, their offer was even more astounding, directly offering a Blue Armor Wristguard Blueprint.
The entire 107 area channel instantly plunged into turmoil.
At the current stage, the rarity of blue equipment cannot be overstated.
Even Han Xing and his team hadn’t obtained any blue equipment before earning the leaderboard rewards.

In the chat channel, some survivors were discussing, "Both major teams are looking to purchase healing items, even willing to offer blue equipment and blueprints, could it be that their leaders Whisperer and Papaya Star Spirit are in trouble?"
This guess is almost spot on.
Although many among them were tempted by the conditions offered by these two major teams, none of them had adequate healing items.
In the latter part of the night, as more survivors reached the 900-point threshold, they inevitably encountered the area bosses.
At least level 5 elite monsters gave them a taste of despair.
Many found their equipment not even as good as Whisperer’s, getting severely injured or killed upon a single encounter with the elite monster.
Some survivors who were lucky enough to survive began venting their grievances on the local network.
"Damn! The elite monsters in this area are too terrifying, their attributes are so high, and they’re so tough, how are we supposed to fight them?"
"Upstairs, same here, I barely managed to injure the elite monster a little, only to have it go berserk, completely giving me no chance to fight back..."
"Stop complaining, we’re considered the lucky ones to escape with our lives, look at the leaderboard, many names have disappeared, they’re probably already dead..."
Only now did they notice that indeed, many names had vanished from the leaderboard, bringing a chill up their spine.
Being able to escape with their lives after encountering elite monsters is already a stroke of luck amid misfortune.
Other survivors were deeply shocked.
At this moment, they also understood the early map generation mechanism of this world.
Each survivor’s area has a powerful monster, and without defeating it, no new map can be generated, nor can they surpass 1000 points.
The system holds this data firmly.
Someone then asked.
"Isn’t there really no way to deal with this area boss? The system wouldn’t set us an unbeatable enemy at this early stage, would it?
After this person asked, the chat channel fell silent, as everyone wanted to know the answer.
Just then, a weak male voice arose in the chat channel.
"Cough cough... This friend is right, the system wouldn’t set us an unbeatable enemy."
The speaker was Papaya Star Spirit, the leader of the Plane Boy Group, who often posted strategies and had a good reputation in area 107.
Once he spoke, other survivors held their breath, eager to hear his insights.
At this moment, Papaya Star Spirit said, "Cough cough... To be honest, I also encountered an elite monster, and ashamedly, I barely escaped with my life from its clutches."
As someone who had consistently stayed in the top three the past few days, Papaya Star Spirit certainly possessed strength.
His words also prompted survivors to elevate the perceived danger of this area boss by two levels.
Papaya Star Spirit continued, "However, this failure wasn’t entirely without gain."
"Through my observations, I’ve discovered that the monsters encountered by everyone have similar attributes, thus reaching a general conclusion."
"To defeat this level 5 elite monster, you need at least a green main weapon to deal damage to it; it’s a strict requirement, thinking otherwise is futile."
"If you have other green equipment, it can increase some tolerance rate, aside from these, you also need decent combat awareness."
"However, more importantly, you need healing items, or you must have skills from the Healing Series!"
"Otherwise, once the monster goes berserk, regardless of who it is, they inevitably sustain damage, without healing items, continuing the fight is impossible."
After Papaya Star Spirit finished speaking, a collective gasp echoed in the chat channel.
Other people then said.
"I see, the elite monsters in this area are indeed terrifying?"
"You must have recovery items; otherwise, you can’t get through?"
"How did Star God and Lone Brave get through, then? Did they have recovery potions?"
The guess was accurate; Han Xing indeed had plenty of Life Secret Elixirs.
Many people realized this too, and all attention quickly turned to Han Xing.
That night, Han Xing’s private messages exploded!
They were all eager for the recovery potion Han Xing had!
