chapters.title: Chapter 44: The Great Benefactor Han Xing
paragraphs: The next day.
As soon as Han Xing opened his eyes, he saw thousands of private messages waiting to be processed.
He clicked open a few, and roughly understood what had happened.
"So that’s it, it seems everyone has experienced the strength of that Elite Monster."
Papaya Star Spirit’s analysis last night in the chat channel directly made healing potions a mandatory requirement for clearing this area.
So many people privately messaged Han Xing because they wanted to trade for his healing items.
Han Xing was secretly delighted, then whispered: "It seems the time has come to sell a batch of Life Secret Elixir for trade!"
The materials he had accumulated could now produce a large number of Life Secret Elixirs.
Unless other Survivors suddenly had the Life Secret Medicine Formula, he basically controlled the only supply source.
In other words, Han Xing had once again completed a monopoly over the entire District 107, covering nearly ten thousand Survivors.
Thinking of this, Han Xing immediately decided to start making Life Secret Elixirs and then go to the trade channel for transactions.
In fact, he could wait a bit longer, keeping the Survivors in District 107 in suspense.
As more casualties appeared, the Survivors’ desire for Life Secret Elixirs would grow stronger, and they would be willing to pay a higher price to survive.
But it wasn’t necessary.
It’s not that Han Xing was being benevolent, but thinking long-term.
Given the current trend, he and the nearly ten thousand Survivors in District 107 would likely be interacting for a long time.
For Han Xing to continue this model, he needed a large number of Survivors to help him collect various materials and items.
In other words, in his eyes, these Survivors in District 107 were excellent workers.
If too many died or were injured, he would lose a lot of labor, which would not be worth the loss.
Thinking of this, Han Xing suddenly laughed, "I am really too kind!"
Han Xing leapt up from his two-meter-wide bed and took a leisurely stroll on his thousand-square-meter Sky Island.
Soon, Han Xing arrived at his warehouse area and checked his storage boxes for remaining material reserves.
The main materials for making Life Secret Elixirs are 100ml of Spiritual Spring Water and 10 Spirit Cores.
Currently, there are 800 liters of Spiritual Spring Water remaining, and 12,464 Spirit Cores in reserve.
If he used all the materials, he could make over 8000 bottles of Life Secret Elixirs.
Though it sounds like a lot, if divided among over ten thousand people in District 107, not everyone would even get one bottle.
Furthermore, his Spirit Core reserves could only first produce over 1200 bottles of Life Secret Elixir.
Thinking of this, Han Xing clicked on ’create all,’ and a system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to consume 124,600ml of Spiritual Spring Water, 12,460 Spirit Cores, Moonflower... to create 1246 bottles of Life Secret Elixir?]
"Yes!"
As soon as he spoke.
The formula interface appeared with densely packed progress bars.
Meanwhile, his vault of Spirit Core reserves was immediately emptied.
But Han Xing wasn’t worried at all because he was confident that with these over 1200 bottles of Life Secret Elixirs, he could earn even more resources!
At the same time, Survivors from Divine Whisper and the Plane Boy Group were frantic.
Their leader was gravely injured and near death, and under Papaya Star Spirit’s inference, it seemed likely that Han Xing had healing items, so they had been sending him private messages all night.
But Han Xing was fast asleep and didn’t care about them.
Seeing that Han Xing ignored them, they crazily tagged him on the chat channel.
"@Star River, Star River God, come out quickly, our leader is about to die, please save him."
"@Star River, bro, I’m injured too, I’m begging you!"
Chat Channel
At this moment, Han Xing finally appeared.
He smiled and said, "Ladies and gentlemen, I’ve seen your needs."
The chat channel fell silent for a moment.
Then an overwhelming flood of messages started to spam the chat, excitedly tagging Han Xing, with some even sending voice messages, shouting the name Star River.
"Star God, you finally came out, we’ve been waiting almost to the point of collapse!"
"Star God, save the child, Haohao can’t be without a father..."
"Star God..."
Many Survivors eagerly awaited him all night, and now that Han Xing finally appeared, how could they not be excited?
At this moment, someone stepped up to stop their frenzy and shouted, "Quiet! Everyone quiet!"
"Damn it, stop spamming, you’re pushing Star God’s messages down, do you not want to trade for healing items?"
This person’s words were effective, and the chat channel’s frenzy gradually calmed down.

Once the spam stopped, Han Xing continued, "Everyone, rest easy, you’re right about having guessed I indeed have some healing items, they’re called Life Secret Elixirs, and as for their effect, see for yourselves."
Han Xing posted the attributes of the Life Secret Elixirs.
The chat channel resounded with gasps.
"Such a powerful elixir, it can even heal such serious injuries!"
"Damn, with these elixirs, why would I fear the Sky Island Monsters? I’ll transform into a potion-chugging Warrior and charge into the monster horde for 800 rounds!"

Although it’s just the Basic Life Secret Elixir, at the current stage, with Survivors having at most a Constitution of 20 points, it’s enough to pull them back from the brink of death in a short time!
Someone cautiously asked, "Star God, do you... sell this batch of Life Secret Elixirs you have?"
Han Xing replied, "Yes, of course I’ll sell them."
Everyone breathed a collective sigh of relief.
Then, someone else asked, "Star God, when do you plan to list the Life Secret Elixirs, and about the price..."
Han Xing chuckled, "I don’t plan to list them just yet. This time, I will auction off the Life Secret Elixirs I have."
"Auction?"
"Yes."
Han Xing replied, "Some among you should understand what I mean."
Many were puzzled, but quite a few had a hint of realization.

Han Xing didn’t beat around the bush and directly explained, "Currently, on the leaderboard, there are still over ninety rankings that haven’t been claimed. In other words, the sooner you trade with me, the quicker you can defeat the area boss and win the leaderboard rewards."
With that said, the local network fell silent.
They saw through Han Xing’s ambition.
He wasn’t just gathering the top three rewards but now wanted to control the top hundred rewards on the entire leaderboard!
And Han Xing did indeed have this capability.
Perhaps even the system that set the designated reward rules didn’t expect a single human Survivor to manipulate the entire leaderboard.
Currently, the rewards for the top four positions have already been claimed.
But even so, there are still 96 reward slots left to claim on the leaderboard.
More crucially, the top five positions can each choose a Blue Weapon for equipment!
In other words, there’s still one last Blue Weapon reward remaining on the territory points leaderboard.
At this moment, Whisperer, who hadn’t spoken for a long time, suddenly jumped out and said, "Star River, are you serious?"

Then, someone else asked, "Star God, when do you plan to list the Life Secret Elixirs, and about the price..."
Han Xing chuckled, "I don’t plan to list them just yet.
This time, I will auction off the Life Secret Elixirs I have."
"Auction?"
"Yes."
Han Xing replied, "Some among you should understand what I mean."
Many were puzzled, but quite a few had a hint of realization.
Han Xing didn’t beat around the bush and directly explained, "Currently, on the leaderboard, there are still over ninety rankings that haven’t been claimed.
In other words, the sooner you trade with me, the quicker you can defeat the area boss and win the leaderboard rewards."
With that said, the local network fell silent.
They saw through Han Xing’s ambition.
He wasn’t just gathering the top three rewards but now wanted to control the top hundred rewards on the entire leaderboard!
And Han Xing did indeed have this capability.
Perhaps even the system that set the designated reward rules didn’t expect a single human Survivor to manipulate the entire leaderboard.
Currently, the rewards for the top four positions have already been claimed.
But even so, there are still 96 reward slots left to claim on the leaderboard.
More crucially, the top five positions can each choose a Blue Weapon for equipment!
In other words, there’s still one last Blue Weapon reward remaining on the territory points leaderboard.
At this moment, Whisperer, who hadn’t spoken for a long time, suddenly jumped out and said, "Star River, are you serious?"

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Basic Castle Blueprint
paragraphs: Whisperer asked, "Star River, are you really auctioning off your first batch of Life Secret Elixirs?"
Han Xing replied, "Yes, highest bid wins."
"Alright, name your price. We, the Divine Whisper, are determined to win this fifth-place reward!"
After speaking, Whisperer added in the chat channel, "I ask everyone to give me some face, please don’t compete with me for the first batch of Life Secret Elixirs."
Normally, as the leader of one of the three major teams in District 107, Whisperer would be given face by everyone.
But now, since it involved leaderboard rewards and such an important item as the Life Secret Elixir, no one would easily give up.

At this time, the usually low-key leader of the Plane Boy Group, Papaya Star Spirit, also spoke up, "Brother Whisper, everyone wants this fifth-place reward, let’s stick to Star River’s rule: highest bidder wins."
His words were essentially a way to undermine Whisperer.
Whisperer gave a cold snort.
At this moment, Han Xing spoke again, "Then let’s start the auction now."
"First batch, 5 bottles of Life Secret Elixir, starting bid is 1000 Spirit Cores; you can also offer other items to raise the bid, the final winner will be decided based on value."
Starting with 5 bottles, the amount of Life Secret Elixirs is equivalent to several extra lives, enough to wear down an Elite Monster.
After speaking, surviving contenders who felt they had the capability to climb the ranks began bidding furiously.
"1500 Spirit Cores, plus a Green Equipment Necklace!"
"1800 Spirit Cores, plus 64 pieces of Mithril!"
"2200 Spirit Cores..."
Meanwhile, both Whisperer and Papaya Star Spirit were frantically gathering resources within their own discussion groups.
After a round of exaggerated bidding, the final offer reached 4000 Spirit Cores, plus a large amount of Mithril and other materials.
Compared to a piece of Blue Weapon, they felt this price was still bearable, and besides the weapon, there was an Advanced Profession Scroll, so it wouldn’t be a loss.
Just then, Whisperer suddenly spoke up, "5000 Spirit Cores, 107 pieces of Mithril, 13000 Refined Iron, plus a Blue Plate Armor Shirt."
After Whisperer spoke, the chat channel was filled with a collective intake of breath.
This offer scared off many potential competitors.
Whisperer offered up Blue Equipment, partly for the ranking reward, and partly because of his critical injuries, urgently needing Life Secret Elixirs to heal.
However, at this point, Papaya Star Spirit also announced his price, "5500 Spirit Cores, 132 pieces of Mithril, 14000 Refined Iron, plus a Blue Necklace."
"Gasp..."
Another wave of gasps swept through the chat channel.
Whisperer remained silent, seemingly contemplating whether it’s worth further raising the price and if it could be recouped.

Just then, Han Xing suddenly chuckled and said, "Oh, by the way, I forgot to remind you, after defeating this Elite Monster, there’s a good chance of obtaining valuable items, and even the Secret Medicine Formula has a high probability of dropping."
As soon as the word fell, Papaya Star Spirit, who thought he had it in the bag, suddenly felt a wave of anxiety wash over him.
The mention of the Secret Medicine Formula was enough to rekindle interest in those who had given up.
Someone cautiously asked, "Star God, do you mean your Life Secret Elixir Formula was also found on an Elite Monster?"
Han Xing smiled but didn’t directly answer the question.
However, the survivors tacitly accepted this explanation in their minds.
Meanwhile, Whisperer gritted his teeth and spoke once more, "6000 Spirit Cores, 140 pieces of Mithril, 15000 Refined Iron, plus 1 Basic Castle Design Map!"
He had gone all out, even bringing out the design map he stumbled upon on a Mysterious Sky Island!
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, a castle design map sounded like architectural blueprints.
No one had heard of anyone constructing territorial buildings yet.
If no higher offer was made, this first batch of 5 bottles of Life Secret Elixir would go to Whisperer.
Papaya Star Spirit was very conflicted at this moment, but he also considered whether it’s worth the price for a piece of Blue Equipment.
Han Xing waited for a moment and, seeing no further bids, said, "Then, it’s a deal."
Upon these words, many in the chat channel simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
Han Xing also demonstrated his credibility, immediately initiating a trade with Whisperer right after speaking.
Trade window.
At this moment, Whisperer painfully put up a large quantity of Spirit Cores and precious Mithril.
This was practically the entire haul of the ’Divine Whisper’ team over the past few days, all now thrown into this trade.
A system notification appeared.
[Trade successful, you have gained Life Secret Elixir*5, you lost Spirit Core*6000, Mithril*140, Refined Iron*15000, Basic Castle Design Map*1.]
Looking at the five green bottles of elixir on his territory, Whisperer was so overwhelmed he was nearly in tears.
His injuries had been worsening, and his personal status had turned to critical.
If not for sustaining himself with Spiritual Spring Water, Whisperer would not have lasted till this moment.
He could hardly wait to pour a bottle of Life Secret Elixir into his mouth.
The grim wound on his chest finally showed signs of improvement.
At this moment, Whisperer cried tears of joy.
"Phew... I was so close to actually dying..."
Meanwhile, Han Xing continued the auction proceedings.
Although the blue equipment slots on the leaderboard were no longer available, other rewards were still very enticing.
There were still 95 slots left, and just one Advanced Professional Reincarnation Book was enough to encourage other survivors to push themselves.
As a result, the subsequent auctions went very smoothly, with everyone enthusiastic and constantly driving up the bidding limits.
The auction lasted for nearly two hours, with Han Xing finally selling off the remaining 95 slots.
He amassed a vast amount of materials.
Just the Spirit Cores alone accounted for 73,624, with over a thousand pieces of Mithril, and materials like Refined Iron and Rare Earth totaled over 100,000.
Combined with various miscellaneous materials such as Beast Hearts, Strong Blood, Moonflower Grass, etc., his storage box was once again filled to the brim.
What he spent was merely 480 bottles of Life Secret Elixirs.
This return rate was not only tenfold but probably a hundredfold!
Moreover, over the course of two hours, many survivors stuck at the 900-point mark also broke through.
People continuously broke 1000 points, earning ranking rewards.
Half an hour later, when the 100th survivor successfully exceeded 1000 points,
Han Xing stopped the auction mode and instead stocked the Life Secret Elixirs directly.
Unlike Spiritual Spring Water, which can be traded milliliter by milliliter, Life Secret Elixirs can only be traded by whole bottles.
Han Xing set various initial prices, such as 200 Spirit Cores for 1 bottle of Life Secret Elixir, 1 piece of Mithril equals 10 Spirit Cores, a blue blueprint equals 1000 Spirit Cores, etc.
As soon as the Life Secret Elixirs were listed, it caused another frenzy.
From morning wake-up till sunset, Han Xing was madly trading with other survivors.
He remained in a state of exhilaration.
Seeing large amounts of materials flowing in, he felt an incomparable sense of satisfaction!
After all, who could resist the joy of being a hoarder?

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Made a Killing!
paragraphs: At this moment, in Han Xing’s territory of over a thousand squares, various materials were once again piled up.
Just over a hundred thousand spirit cores formed a small two-meter-high mountain, and the spiritual qi it emitted almost turned into mist, making anyone who took a breath feel refreshed.
At this moment, Coal Ball was excitedly jumping up and down on the mountain of spirit cores.
The little creature experienced for the first time the thrill of being overwhelmed by delicious food.
Coal Ball occasionally opened its mouth, swallowing a big bite of spirit cores, at least a dozen at a time.
Han Xing let it eat its fill, since with the amount of spirit cores in this pile, Coal Ball could eat for years and still not finish them!
However, after a few bites, the little creature couldn’t continue eating.
It seemed full to bursting, comfortably finding a patch of grass to lie down on, flipping its belly up, and fell into a deep sleep.
Seeing this, Han Xing’s lips twitched uncontrollably.
"Tsk, and here I thought it had a huge appetite."
Han Xing began to organize his gains.
Up to now, all of the more than 1200 bottles of Life Secret Elixir he produced had been sold, exchanged for a large amount of materials.
However, there was still a significant gap in the market.
This crucial recovery item, many people wished to stock up on a few more bottles, and the Life Secret Elixirs weren’t even enough for all survivors, making the supply even more strained.
Although it was already night, Han Xing worked overtime to continue producing Life Secret Elixirs.
With his current spirit core reserves more than sufficient, he immediately converted all the remaining spiritual spring water into Life Secret Elixirs.
7,000 bottles of Life Secret Elixir, each takes 10 seconds to make, converting to 70,000 seconds, almost 20 hours.
In the coming day, Han Xing did nothing else but make bottles and sell them one by one.
Apart from occasionally resting, he spent all his time trading with other survivors.
In the first hour, he traded away over 600 bottles of secret elixirs.
In the second hour, he traded over 1300 bottles.
Loads of materials continuously flowed in.
The day ended.
Finally, after selling the 7,000th bottle of Life Secret Elixir, Han Xing stopped trading.
Because his spiritual spring water stock was depleted.
Over 800 liters of spiritual spring water, made into over 8,000 bottles of Life Secret Elixirs, of which 7,000 were traded for various materials.
In the chat channel, not seeing Han Xing put up spiritual spring water for a long time, many anticipating survivors suddenly had a bad feeling.
At this time, Han Xing spoke up in the chat channel with a slightly hoarse voice: "Everyone, the Life Secret Elixirs are sold out, I’m out of raw materials, and can’t produce anymore."
Upon hearing this, those who didn’t get to trade felt extremely disappointed.
Among them, there were still many who hadn’t gotten a Life Secret Elixir.
During this, someone cautiously asked: "Star God, is there really none left?"
Han Xing replied: "Yes, the main ingredient needed to make Life Secret Elixirs is used up. I will produce more once I find a new source of the main ingredient."
"Besides, I’ve already traded over 7,000 bottles of Life Secret Elixir, enough for many people to tackle the current area boss."
"You should be able to get some other recovery items from these bosses, which should be enough for everyone else to clear this area."
In fact, Han Xing still had a reserve of over a thousand bottles of Life Secret Elixir on hand.
But he didn’t intend to take them out, as people have personal agendas.
In future battles, there will inevitably be injuries; he didn’t want to be in a dangerous situation due to a lack of Life Secret Elixirs if he got hurt.
Hearing Han Xing say this, many survivors expressed their understanding.
Someone said at this time: "Star God, you’ve worked hard. We will remember your kindness!"
Han Xing smiled and shook his head, "It’s just a transaction, nothing about kindness or not."
However, that person laughed and said: "Star God really is not frank, though you say it’s just a transaction, we all know deep down."
"These past two days, you’ve been trading Life Secret Elixirs with us almost non-stop, indirectly saving countless lives including mine."
The person said with a bitter smile: "If it weren’t for your Life Secret Elixirs, I might’ve been killed by that monster..."
His words received a lot of recognition, and many responded: "Yes, it’s thanks to the Star God’s Life Secret Elixirs that I managed to save my life. It’s so hard to survive in this world..."
"Me too..."
"Not to mention, Star God has already saved us from water and fire twice, most of us in Zone 107 owe him a big favor!"
"Absolutely, Zone 107’s savior, Star God deserves the title. Anyone who dares to question him will have to deal with me!"
"I declare, from today onwards, the Star River Divine Sect is officially established, and I’m the first follower. Anyone else want to join?"

Seeing them getting more and more absurd in their words, Han Xing quickly interjected: "Stop! Cut the mushy stuff, I just want to trade with you for resources. If you keep messing around, I won’t sell anymore!"
"Haha..."
A wave of laughter sounded in the chat channel.
Han Xing shook his head, about to close the chat channel.
And just then, a private message appeared.
The other person’s name was Vortex Potato.
Han Xing had some impression of this name.
Upon opening the private chat, Vortex Potato immediately said excitedly: "Dad! I haven’t exchanged for a Life Secret Elixir yet!"
Han Xing’s face instantly went black.
"Don’t shout nonsense, when did I have such an older son like you?"
Vortex Potato quickly said: "Star God, you don’t understand, you saved my life in my hardest time, you’re basically my rebirth parent, calling you dad is only right!"
Seeing that he wanted to continue speaking, Han Xing quickly initiated a trade request.
After directly putting up 10 bottles of Life Secret Elixirs, without paying attention to his exaggerated scream, Han Xing immediately closed the private chat.
Then, Han Xing felt the noise around him finally quiet down.
After two days of non-stop work, he finally relaxed, a strong sense of drowsiness and fatigue washed over him like a tide.
Han Xing shook his head, mustering some power.
He planned to tally up this round’s harvest before resting, and there was still one thing he hadn’t done.
Looking at the mountains of materials in his territory, Han Xing’s breath became a bit quicker, even the drowsiness was dispelled considerably.
"This really is a major profit this time!"
After the excitement, Han Xing began to tally.
The biggest gain from this transaction was naturally the spirit cores, which had become a universal currency in this world due to their extensive uses.
After accounting for the consumption in producing spiritual spring water, he collected a total of 253,764 spirit cores.
Another heap of relatively precious material was Mithril.
It’s needed to make blue and purple armor, and will likely be heavily used later.
After counting, a total of over 16,000 blocks of Mithril were gathered.
As expected, strength in numbers pays off.
The three of them, each getting a Silver Treasure Chest, only gathered less than 50 blocks of Mithril.
But after trading with the entire Zone 107 survivors, they directly received over ten thousand blocks!
A major profit!

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Cloud Secret Realm Goes Live!
paragraphs: After tallying the number of Spirit Cores and Mithril, Han Xing continued to count other material resources.
Hundreds of thousands of Rare Earths, Ether, along with tens of thousands of Power Crystals, Magic Crystals, as well as Blood of the Strong and various One-Star Beast Hides, and so on.
And most importantly, he exchanged for more than 20 pieces of Moon Crystal Stone, a key material needed to craft the Purple Weapon, the Moon Crown Longbow.
In other words, Han Xing could now craft four Purple Weapons at once!
But he didn’t craft them immediately because his level wasn’t high enough to equip them even if he made them.
It’s not too late to craft them when he reaches Level 6.
Then, Han Xing stuffed all these materials in the Sky Island Territory into the Storage Box.
The crowded Sky Island Territory became spacious once again.
Han Xing casually grabbed a small folding stool, placed it under himself, and took out a blueprint from his backpack to study.
This was something he exchanged from the Whisperer yesterday during the first auction of the Life Secret Elixir, called the Basic Castle Construction Blueprint.
Just then, a cute animal sound rang out.
"Awoo!"
Coal Ball suddenly jumped onto Han Xing’s knee, poking its little head out, seemingly curious about what its master was looking at.
Han Xing lifted Coal Ball with one hand, placed it on his shoulder, patted its little head, and said, "Don’t cause trouble for me, I’ll take you out for some activities tomorrow."
These past two days, Han Xing hadn’t explored the Sky Island, and this energetic little creature had nowhere to vent, almost going mad with energy.
"Awoo~"
Coal Ball responded obediently, raising its head.
After pacifying this little fellow, Han Xing turned his attention back to the blueprint in his hand.
[Basic Castle Construction Blueprint: A Territorial Building, Survivors can construct a Basic Castle within the territory.]

[Basic Castle: Defense Value 1000, can increase the Defense Value of all defensive buildings within the territory by 20%, Attack Power of all offensive buildings by 10%, All Attributes of all friendly units by 10%, and movement speed in Sky Island Territory by 10%.]
[Materials needed for constructing a Basic Castle: Stone Block*100000, Wood*20000, Spirit Core*50000, Refined Iron*50000, Rare Earth*90000, Mithril*8000, Power Crystal*5000, Magic Crystal*5000.]
Note: When constructing the Basic Castle, the territory area needs to be larger than 1000 square meters, and at least 400 square meters of open space must be reserved.
Seeing that the materials were all in tens of thousands, Han Xing suddenly realized that this might not be something feasible at the current stage.
At this stage, which Survivor could produce so many materials at once?
Of course, except for him.
No wonder that Whisperer chose to trade out this blueprint because even with the ’Divine Whisper’ team supporting him, gathering all these materials would take a long time.
Han Xing said with some surprise, "So many materials, even before trading the Life Secret Elixir, my reserves wouldn’t have been enough."
"However, the effects of this castle are truly powerful; just being in the territory gives me a 10% attribute boost."
Moreover, this attribute boost doesn’t just enhance Han Xing; all allies within the territory, including pets, summoned creatures, and subordinates, can also enjoy the bonus!
"But what is the concept of this 1000 Defense Value, can it withstand the onslaught of an Elite Monster?"
Han Xing was uncertain, but thinking about having no house, where all his furniture had to be placed outdoors, he decided instantly to go for it!
No matter what other effects this castle has, it could at least serve as a shelter against the wind and rain!
With this thought in mind, Han Xing moved all the furniture from the center of the territory to the side, leaving a sufficiently spacious area.
In the next moment, he clicked on ’Build.’
The castle blueprint in his hand disappeared, and then a system notification appeared.
"Territorial Building: Basic Castle is under construction, estimated remaining time 32 hours, 59 minutes, and 59 seconds..."
"Basic Castle Construction Blueprint has been automatically recorded in the territory function page."
After the system notification appeared,
Han Xing saw that a large area in the center of his territory was marked off, like the outline of a rectangle.
A bluish-gray mist suddenly rose within the area.
Meanwhile, a large amount of materials disappeared from his Storage Box.
Soon after, the foundation framework of the castle was erected.
Han Xing roughly calculated in his mind that the maximum diameter of the castle was 39 meters, covering an area of about three hundred square meters, not very large.
But if it were merely used as a residence, it would be an undisputed big house, a mansion!
On Blue Star, constructing such a castle would cost several million in funds.
Han Xing imagined expectantly what the finished castle would look like.

According to the sketch on the blueprint, it’s a retro-style European building, divided into upper, middle, and lower sections, each corner of every level has an outward extending tower, with windows in the middle of the tower.
In the center of the building stands a tower tens of meters high, with flags fluttering at its top.
Han Xing excitedly said, "Finally, in this world, I’ll have a place to call home!"
After his anticipation, Han Xing found a sofa he had made nearby and lay directly on it.
His tense nerves began to relax as fatigue hit him like a tide.
The last two days had been incredibly busy, and although the gains were astounding, it was indeed tiring.
Han Xing stared blankly at the bright night sky, feeling the comfortable breeze.
At some point, the little Coal Ball also jumped onto the sofa, lying at his feet, lightly snoring.
And just like that, the two of them fell asleep.
The next day.
It was the tenth day since all Blue Star humans arrived in this world.
As soon as Han Xing woke up, a system notification suddenly appeared in everyone’s mind.
System: "Attention all Survivors."
"It has been ten days since you entered ’Sky Island Paradise’ and you have adapted to this world."
"The new game version is now live, and new challenge instances, Cloud Secret Realm will soon open."
"Cloud Secret Realms are randomly generated, Survivors can find clouds with vortex symbols nearby, inside are randomly generated Cloud Secret Realms."
"Note: Cloud Secret Realms are different from other Sky Island Territories, once entered you will be transported to a special scenario, and the monsters in each scenario vary."
"Cloud Secret Realm difficulties range from 1-star to 5-star, with different player limits for each star level. The higher the star level, the greater the danger; Survivors should choose carefully!"
"Currently, the highest generated difficulty for Secret Realms is 2 stars."

"Success in the Cloud Secret Realms will earn you valuable items and significant rewards, including but not limited to Blue, Purple Equipment, Advanced Profession Scrolls, Rune Blueprints, Rune Crystals, and Strong Fragments!"

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Area Protection Lifted, New Rankings Unveiled
paragraphs: This sudden system announcement left everyone’s head spinning.
In the chat channel, everyone was excitedly discussing what the Cloud Secret Realm was, and what the Rune Blueprint and Strong Fragment were.

At this moment, Han Xing sat back on the sofa, stroking his chin and pondering, "Cloud Secret Realm? When I played ’Sky Island Paradise’ on my phone, it didn’t have such features; it must be a new function introduced in this world."
Speaking of which, Han Xing hadn’t played much on his phone either.
At that time, he won a beta test spot on a mysterious webpage, and then downloaded the installation package.
He played for less than a week in total, and his game character had just reached level 11.
Then, he came to this world.
Therefore, Han Xing’s understanding of this world isn’t much beyond that of other survivors.
"As a new instance, the Cloud Secret Realm should have nice rewards inside..."
"But, accordingly, it will also be very dangerous!"
At this moment, a second system prompt arrived.

System: "All survivors, please note, the Survivor area protection mechanism has been lifted, the area map has been changed to open status, survivors can now use the coordinates on the map to find each other’s location."
"You can cooperate, compete, or choose to draw your sword against others and invade each other’s territories!"
"Please note, when the number of survivors gathered in the same area is too large, there is a greater chance of spawning high-level monsters, and the Cloud Monsters encountered will be stronger."

"In addition, the monster’s desire to attack in the clouds has greatly increased, and they are likely to take the initiative to find the survivor’s territory for invasion. Please make good defense arrangements for your territory."
A long string of prompts, each containing a large amount of information.
The next moment, the chat channel boiled again!
"Brothers! Did you see the update announcement? The area protection feature has been lifted! This means we can not only meet but also team up and even fight together!"
"I saw it too, woohoo, finally no more fighting alone."
"Bro, little sis is coming to find you soon...
At this time, someone kindly reminded, "Everyone be careful, don’t gather too many people together, otherwise high-level monsters might be attracted."
"Didn’t you see the system prompt saying that? The monsters in the clouds can also attack us now, so be careful not to be wiped out!"
Meanwhile, in the discussion group where Han Xing and others were, the three were discussing this update as well.
Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Brothers, the protection mechanism has been lifted, which means we can meet soon! Report your coordinates, I’ll come to find you."
Cheng Jianyong was startled after hearing this and said, "Damn, I’m at 42063, 54223, 48612, quite far from you guys!"

Shen Yun replied: "It is a bit far. With our current speed, it would take at least four to five days to get over, plus we need to avoid those clouds along the way, which will probably take even longer."
Shen Yun tentatively asked, "Why don’t we two head towards Brother Xing’s place first?"
Cheng Jianyong was about to agree.
Then Han Xing said, "Don’t rush, don’t hurry to come over."

"Now that the area protection mechanism is just lifted, other survivors will definitely have the same idea as we do, with large numbers of survivors wandering around, plus the cloud monsters might take the initiative to attack, making the whole area extremely chaotic."
Shen Yun understood something as well and tentatively asked, "Brother Xing, are you worried?"

Han Xing replied, "Yes, I’m worried that some people with sinister motives may target other survivors, in the current situation where everyone’s attributes are similar, if a fight breaks out, it may result in a mutually destructive outcome."
"Moreover, if these people gather together, it will be even more troublesome."
The two heard the worry in Han Xing’s words and knew that what he said was not unreasonable.
In fact, Han Xing’s worry was bound to come true.
Despite the apparent peace of District 107, there must be people with sinister intentions here.
This place is not like Blue Star; it’s a world without legal restraint.
For profit or the spoils of other survivors, these people will do anything.
Cheng Jianyong then asked, "Brother Xing, what good advice do you have?"

Han Xing pondered for a moment and replied, "My advice is, for the first two days, remain inactive; after the initial chaotic period is over, we three can proceed towards the same coordinates, shortening the time to converge.
"Then when encountering clouds that can be fought, try to explore, and upgrade while on the move, but be very careful to avoid those large areas of clouds."
The two agreed that Han Xing’s plan was relatively prudent and thus agreed to follow his plan.
Just as they were about to take action, the system’s third prompt appeared.
Announcement: "As the territorial points leaderboard of most regions has ended, a new leaderboard challenge is now open."
"Divided by different regions, in each region, the top one hundred survivors reaching level 10 first will receive ranking rewards."

"Rank 100-51, rewards [Spiritual Shield Crystal Tower Construction Plan (Basic Level)] *1, [Iron Armor Puppet] *5, [Basic Lord’s House Construction Plan] *1, [Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan] *1, Spirit Core *1000."

"Rank 50-11, rewards [Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan (Basic Level)] *1, [Iron Armor Puppet] *10, [Basic Lord’s House Construction Plan] *1, [Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan] *1, Spirit Core *2000."
"New leaderboard rewards again?"
Han Xing was startled by this system prompt and looked at the attributes of these reward items.

[Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan (Basic Level)]: Territorial building, constructing a pyramid capable of generating a spiritual shield, which can resist physical and magic attacks, with a defense value of: 200.
[Iron Armor Puppet lv10]: Ordinary defensive puppet, can only operate within the territory.
[Attributes]: Power 53, agility 34, Spirit 32, Constitution 56.
[Skills]: Copper Skin Iron Bone, Flame Spray, Sawtooth Cutting.
"The attributes seem pretty good," Han Xing pondered.
That ’Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid (Basic Level)’ can directly generate a shield, which means the territory can be enclosed, preventing others from entering and blocking attacks.

The second item, Iron Armor Puppet, is a defensive-type puppet, and its attributes are roughly similar to those of a level 10 ordinary monster, capable of assisting survivors in battle when encountering danger or when other cloud monsters invade.

Then there is the third item, [Basic Lord’s Cottage]: Defense value 500, can increase defense value of all defensive buildings in the territory by 10%, increase attack power of all attacking buildings by 5%, increase attributes of all friendly units by 5%, increase Sky Island Territory movement speed by 10%).
Seeing the attributes of the Lord’s Cottage, Han Xing wondered aloud, "This Basic Lord’s Cottage seems similar to my Basic Castle, but the enhancement effects fall a lot short!"

chapters.title: Chapter 49: The Era of Teams
paragraphs: The defense building bonus of the Lord’s Castle is 20%. The Lord’s Cottage is only 10%, and all other increases are only half.
Han Xing’s heart was stirred, "It seems the Basic Castle is a more advanced building than the Lord’s Cottage!"
It was worth spending so many materials to build the castle.
Then, Han Xing continued to look at the remaining ranking rewards.

"From 10th to 4th place, rewards include [Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan (Basic)]*1, [Silver Armor Puppet]*1, [Basic Lord’s Cottage Construction Plan]*1, [Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan]*1, [Purple Weapon of Choice]*1, Spirit Core*3000."

"3rd place reward: [Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan (Basic)]*1, [Silver Armor Puppet]*3, [Basic Lord’s Cottage Construction Plan]*1, [Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan]*1, [Purple Weapon of Choice]*1, Spirit Core*5000."

"2nd place reward: [Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan (Basic)]*1, [Silver Armor Puppet]*5, [Basic Lord’s Cottage Construction Plan]*1, [Purple Weapon of Choice]*1, [Golden Treasure Chest*1], [Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan], Spirit Core*8000."

"1st place reward: [Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan (Basic)]*1, [Golden Armor Puppet]*1, [Basic Lord’s Cottage Construction Plan]*1, [Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan], [Golden Weapon Selection Blueprint]*1, [Golden Treasure Chest*1], Spirit Core*10000."
[Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan]: A territorial building, can be constructed within the territory.

[Function]: Can be used to teleport to other Survivor’s territory teleportation arrays. Before teleportation, it is necessary to record the Survivor’s teleportation array number, and only with the other Lord’s permission can other Survivors proceed with teleportation.
[Silver Armor Puppet lv10 (Elite Level)]: Enhanced defense puppet, can only operate within the territory.
[Attributes]: Power 74, Agility 53, Spirit 46, Constitution 71.
[Skills]: Copper Skin Iron Bone, Flame Breath, Sawtooth Cutting, Heavy Hammer Impact
[Golden Armor Puppet (Leader Level)]: Specially enhanced puppet, can only operate within the territory.
[Attributes]: Power 108, Agility 74, Spirit 86, Constitution 109.
[Skills]: Steel Bones, Flame Spray, Blood Cutting, Heavy Hammer Strike, Metal Burst.
The chat channel suddenly fell into silence, followed by a tidal wave of messages.
"Whoa, Lord’s Cottage, Teleportation Array, and so many powerful attribute puppets! Just getting any ranking would be a huge gain!"

"The Silver Armor Puppet is equivalent to the strength of a Level 10 Elite Monster, but the Golden Armor Puppet is even more terrifying, actually at Leader Level! At the current stage, a single Golden Armor Puppet could sweep the entire field, right?"
"Not only that, there are Golden Treasure Chests and Golden Weapons, oh my God!"
The rewards were so abundant that the Survivors couldn’t believe it.
They even wished they could instantly level up to 10 and grab the first-place reward!
Meanwhile, in District 107, several teams of considerable scale began giving speeches again.

At this time, the Whisperer took the lead on the Divine Whisper discussion group: "Ladies and gentlemen, the regional protection mechanism has been lifted. Our days of going it alone are about to end; next comes the era of team collaboration!"

"We can quickly unite not only for safety but, more importantly, so that everyone can team up for battles in the future, not only speeding up the leveling process but also significantly increasing resource acquisition!
"The last leaderboard failure doesn’t matter; this time, Divine Whisper must secure a spot!"
Other discussion group members shouted in unison, "Yes!"
The team members were filled with enthusiasm.
Within the Plane Boy Group discussion, Papaya Star Spirit also spoke.
"The leaderboard rewards are very generous and will probably entice many people. From the competition on the last leaderboard, I’ve already seen that there are a lot of experts in District 107."
"Now, with the game version changes, only by uniting can we achieve greater results."
"These people should also see this, and they should have the idea of joining a team now, so this is the perfect time for us to recruit."
"Everyone take this opportunity to recruit people in the chat channel and make our Plane Boy Group bigger and stronger!"
The team members each took up the task.
Papaya Star Spirit wasn’t wrong. In the chat channel now, many Survivors were seeking to join teams.
"Which teams in our district are recruiting? Level 5 Holy Profession, half Green Armor seeking to join!"
"Level 4 Warrior, 20 Power, any team want me?"
"Level 5 Mage..."
Han Xing also received many messages, all inviting him to join teams, but Han Xing directly refused them all.
The game version did change, that’s true.
But the system also reminded, gathering too many people would attract attacks from those powerful monsters.
At this junction, it’s most important to seize the time to enhance one’s own strength.
Meanwhile, Han Xing also began preparations to level up.
He looked at the little wolf cub napping lazily beside him and called out, "Coal Ball, time to get to work!"
Coal Ball instantly lifted its head from the couch and jumped down joyfully.
Han Xing noticed that after these days of feeding, Coal Ball had obviously grown larger, from a puppy only the size of two palms to a little wolf cub as long as an arm.
With its current size, it could no longer be placed on his shoulder.
Hearing that Han Xing was finally taking it out to move around, Coal Ball excitedly dashed around the territory.
Ten minutes later.
A cloud as large as over forty square meters appeared before them, and the system prompt appeared.
"A group of jungle creatures is active inside, would you like to enter?"
Without hesitation, Han Xing clicked yes.
Upon entering, they found a group of Level 4 and 5 wild boars.
With his current attributes, plus Coal Ball’s powerful melee capability, these Level 4 and 5 monsters could no longer pose any threat to him.
A few minutes later, the system prompt appeared.
[You have killed Jungle Wild Boar lv5*8, gained Experience Value 400, pet Coal Ball gained Experience Value 320.]
[Your territory size has increased.]

[You have killed Steel Needle Porcupine lv5*4, gained Experience Value 200, pet Coal Ball gained Experience Value 160.]
[You have killed...]
As system prompts kept appearing, after a morning of exploration.
A white light successively rose over Han Xing and Coal Ball.
"Finally reached Level 6!" Han Xing’s voice was excited.
Level 6 is a critical point.
Because it means he can now equip the [Fierce Beast Hide Armor] and the [Warrior’s Ring], these two pieces of Blue Equipment.
And most importantly, the Purple Weapon Design Map he obtained when securing the top spot on the territory points leaderboard!
A Purple Weapon can boost his attack by several notches.
Combined with the bonuses of those few pieces of Blue Armor, by then, Han Xing’s overall strength will undergo a transformation!

The Lord’s Cottage is only 10%, and all other increases are only half.

It was worth spending so many materials to build the castle.

Our days of going it alone are about to end; next comes the era of team collaboration!"

"We can quickly unite not only for safety but, more importantly, so that everyone can team up for battles in the future, not only speeding up the leveling process but also significantly increasing resource acquisition!
"The last leaderboard failure doesn’t matter; this time, Divine Whisper must secure a spot!"
Other discussion group members shouted in unison, "Yes!"
The team members were filled with enthusiasm.
Within the Plane Boy Group discussion, Papaya Star Spirit also spoke.
"The leaderboard rewards are very generous and will probably entice many people.
From the competition on the last leaderboard, I’ve already seen that there are a lot of experts in District 107."
"Now, with the game version changes, only by uniting can we achieve greater results."
"These people should also see this, and they should have the idea of joining a team now, so this is the perfect time for us to recruit."
"Everyone take this opportunity to recruit people in the chat channel and make our Plane Boy Group bigger and stronger!"

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Legendary Effect!
paragraphs: Han Xing eagerly looked at his blueprint tab.
The purple weapon blueprint, [Moon Crown Longbow] was already in a craftable state.
With trembling fingers, Han Xing clicked the crafting button, exclaiming excitedly, "This is my first piece of purple equipment in my life, hope the attributes aren’t too poor!"
Then, he clicked on craft directly.
A 120-second progress bar appeared.
Crafting purple equipment takes longer than blue equipment.
After patiently waiting for two minutes, a dazzling purple light suddenly appeared before Han Xing.
Clatter.
The next moment, a silver-white longbow fell onto the grass.
The bow was entirely bright silver, intricately carved with many secret patterns, and Han Xing saw five diamond-like glowing gems inlaid on it, which should be the five moon crystal stones.
The appearance of the longbow already looked extraordinary, with a bowstring as thick as a pinky, showcasing its powerful destructive force.
Han Xing bent down to pick up the longbow, feeling its cold touch.
"Great bow!"
Han Xing sincerely praised. A good weapon in hand exudes strong power.
Meanwhile, the longbow’s attributes also appeared before him.
[Moon Crown Longbow (Purple) lv6, Quality - Treasure, Attack Power 75~85, Agility +10, Attached Effect - Moonlight Flow, Moon Curse.]
[Moonlight Flow: When attacking, there is a 50% chance to convert 10 points of spirit and constitution into agility attributes.]
[Moon Curse: When attacking, inflicts the moon curse effect on the enemy, reducing healing effect by -10% and movement speed by -10%.]
"Moonlight Flow and Moon Curse?"

Han Xing pondered, "The first Moonlight Flow effect has a chance to convert 10 points of spirit and constitution into agility, which means that when the effect is triggered, I can at least gain 20 points of agility, which translates to almost 40 points of attack power."
"The second curse effect, actually reduces healing, can that be combined with Coal Ball’s Power of the Void to further weaken the enemy?"
He remembered Power of the Void in Coal Ball’s skills could also suppress enemy healing effects by 60%, along with Moon Curse, reducing by a total of 70%!
Thought of this, Han Xing’s heart was stirred, "This bow has really nice attributes!"
Just the attack power exceeds his current green longbow by more than three times, plus the additional 10 points of agility and those two effects.
As long as he equips it, his current attack power would multiply several times.
However, upon seeing the Quality - Treasure on the attribute panel, Han Xing suddenly had another idea.
"Purple equipment, at best, can be crafted into legendary quality, although the probability is a bit low, but with my current material reserves, I can still craft three Moon Crown Longbows."
Han Xing instantly lifted his head, "It’s worth a try!"
With this thought, he continued crafting.
Four minutes later.
Clatter!
Clatter!
Two more Moon Crown Longbows were crafted, but both were of treasure quality.
The probability of legendary quality appearing seems much lower.
However, as expected.
Ordinary purple equipment is commonly rare quality, and treasure quality is extremely rare.
And legendary quality purple gear, perhaps even the original inhabitants of this world haven’t seen two pieces.
Those are the ultimate masterpieces that only a truly grandmaster-level artisan can create!
Han Xing looked at the blueprint interface and said, "Now, only the last set of materials is left, let’s try again."
He clicked on craft.
However, the moment after he clicked.
A blinding purple beam suddenly shot up into the sky.
Han Xing even saw this purple beam extend several hundred meters high into the sky, dyeing the surrounding clouds purple, making a big commotion!
When this commotion appeared, Han Xing knew, it was likely a success.
The Moon Crown Longbow crafted this time is very probably of legendary quality!
In his expectant gaze, the 120 seconds quickly passed.
Han Xing saw a silver-white longbow appear again, but unlike before, this longbow’s body had a starlight shimmer, adding more mystery and beauty.
Bending down to pick it up, the longbow’s attributes appeared before him.
[Moon Crown Longbow (Purple) lv6, Quality - Legend, Attack Power 101~113, Agility +15, Attached Effect - Moonlight Flow, Moon Curse, Dark Moon Descent (Legendary Effect)]
[Dark Moon Descent (Legendary Effect): After the Survivor uses the Moon Crown Longbow to continuously kill five enemies, the Dark Moon Descent effect is triggered!

A black full moon illuminates overhead, when within the shroud of the dark moon, the Survivor’s attack speed increases by 50%, allies’ attack speed increases by 30%, the effect lasts 20 seconds, and when the dark moon descent state ends, the dark moon automatically explodes, dealing agility * 300% damage to surrounding enemies!]
"Holy crap!"
Han Xing was overwhelmed with shock after looking at the introduction of the last effect.
"50% increase in attack speed, can also increase allies’ speed by 30%, and has an area damage when the effect ends. Is this the legendary level effect? It’s terrifying!
Han Xing eagerly picked it up, delighted, "With the attributes of this longbow, even the usual golden equipment can’t compare!"
Han Xing was right; same-level golden equipment only has about a 20% edge over purple equipment in attributes, and the leap from treasure to legendary is far more than 20% in strength.
Plus the legendary level effect, this Moon Crown Longbow can definitely overpower same-level golden equipment.
At this moment, the silver-white longbow was emitting gentle moonlight.
Han Xing vaguely felt, the Moon Crown Longbow with the Dark Moon Descent legendary effect seems to be its complete form.
Han Xing immediately equipped the legendary quality Moon Crown Longbow, and then slipped the Power Ring onto his other hand.
Following that, he took off the Python Hide Cloak that had accompanied him for many days and replaced it with the dark yellow Fierce Beast Hide Armor.
In an instant, his attributes skyrocketed.
He glanced at his personal panel.
[Name: Han Xing]
[Race: Human Race]
[Profession: Hunter]
[Level: LV6]

[Power: 10+20 (Warrior Pendant +6, Traveler’s Ring +2, Power Ring +12), Agility: 15+32 (Space Backpack +4, Beast Hide Short Boots +6, Traveler’s Ring +2, Fierce Beast Hide Armor +5, Moon Crown Longbow +15), Spirit: 9+8 (Traveler’s Ring +2, Warrior Pendant +1, Spirit +5), Constitution: 12+13 (Space Backpack +4, Warrior Pendant +2, Traveler’s Ring +2, Fierce Beast Hide Armor +5)]
Note: Survivors can wear up to two rings and one necklace at a time.
"With these attributes, I’m afraid those level 5 elite monsters aren’t even as high as mine!"
Looking at his panel, Han Xing exclaimed eagerly, "I’m so damn awesome!"
Leveling from 5 to 6 is indeed a huge watershed, the attribute boost is just insanely strong!
At the same time, Coal Ball’s attributes also received a significant boost upon reaching level 5.
The agility attribute has already exceeded 30, adding the 200% speed boost from Void Flashes; even Han Xing can’t catch up with it now.
Strengthened, Han Xing decided to explore the more powerful sky islands nearby.
Not far ahead, he saw a cloud with an area of over a hundred square meters.
Han Xing maneuvered to bring his territory closer.
The system prompt appeared: "A group of shadowy cave-dwelling creatures are gathered inside, vast in number, do you wish to enter?"
"Cave-dwelling creatures? Is this a new race?"
Driven by curiosity, Han Xing clicked to enter.
